text: And if his understanding fail, have patience with him; and despise him not when thou art in thy full strength.
text_marked: And if his understanding fail, have patience with him; and despise him not when thou art in thy full strength.

text: For the relieving of thy father shall not be forgotten: and instead of sins it shall be added to build thee up.
text_marked: For the relieving of thy father shall not be forgotten: and instead of sins it shall be added to build thee up.

text: In the day of thine affliction it shall be remembered; thy sins also shall melt away, as the ice in the fair warm weather.
text_marked: In the day of thine affliction it shall be remembered; thy sins also shall melt away, as the ice in the fair warm weather.

text: He that forsaketh his father is as a blasphemer; and he that angereth his mother is cursed: of God.
text_marked: He that forsaketh his father is as a blasphemer; and he that angereth his mother is cursed: of God.

text: My son, go on with thy business in meekness; so shalt thou be beloved of him that is approved.
text_marked: My son, go on with thy business in meekness; so shalt thou be beloved of him that is approved.

text: The greater thou art, the more humble thyself, and thou shalt find favour before the Lord.
text_marked: The greater thou art, the more humble thyself, and thou shalt find favour before the Lord.

text: Many are in high place, and of renown: but mysteries are revealed unto the meek.
text_marked: Many are in high place, and of renown: but mysteries are revealed unto the meek.

text: For the power of the Lord is great, and he is honoured of the lowly.
text_marked: For the power of the Lord is great, and he is honoured of the lowly.

text: Seek not out things that are too hard for thee, neither search the things that are above thy strength.
text_marked: Seek not out things that are too hard for thee, neither search the things that are above thy strength.

text: But what is commanded thee, think thereupon with reverence, for it is not needful for thee to see with thine eyes the things that are in secret.
text_marked: But what is commanded thee, think thereupon with reverence, for it is not needful for thee to see with thine eyes the things that are in secret.

text: Be not curious in unnecessary matters: for more things are shewed unto thee than men understand.
text_marked: Be not curious in unnecessary matters: for more things are shewed unto thee than men understand.

text: For many are deceived by their own vain opinion; and an evil suspicion hath overthrown their judgment.
text_marked: For many are deceived by their own vain opinion; and an evil suspicion hath overthrown their judgment.

text: Without eyes thou shalt want light: profess not the knowledge therefore that thou hast not.
text_marked: Without eyes thou shalt want light: profess not the knowledge therefore that thou hast not.

text: A stubborn heart shall fare evil at the last; and he that loveth danger shall perish therein.
text_marked: A stubborn heart shall fare evil at the last; and he that loveth danger shall perish therein.

text: An obstinate heart shall be laden with sorrows; and the wicked man shall heap sin upon sin.
text_marked: An obstinate heart shall be laden with sorrows; and the wicked man shall heap sin upon sin.

text: In the punishment of the proud there is no remedy; for the plant of wickedness hath taken root in him.
text_marked: In the punishment of the proud there is no remedy; for the plant of wickedness hath taken root in him.

text: The heart of the prudent will understand a parable; and an attentive ear is the desire of a wise man.
text_marked: The heart of the prudent will understand a parable; and an attentive ear is the desire of a wise man.

text: Water will quench a flaming fire; and alms maketh an atonement for sins.
text_marked: Water will quench a flaming fire; and alms maketh an atonement for sins.

text: And he that requiteth good turns is mindful of that which may come hereafter; and when he falleth, he shall find a stay.
text_marked: And he that requiteth good turns is mindful of that which may come hereafter; and when he falleth, he shall find a stay.

text: My son, defraud not the poor of his living, and make not the needy eyes to wait long.
text_marked: My son, defraud not the poor of his living, and make not the needy eyes to wait long.

text: Make not an hungry soul sorrowful; neither provoke a man in his distress.
text_marked: Make not an hungry soul sorrowful; neither provoke a man in his distress.

text: Add not more trouble to an heart that is vexed; and defer not to give to him that is in need.
text_marked: Add not more trouble to an heart that is vexed; and defer not to give to him that is in need.

text: Reject not the supplication of the afflicted; neither turn away thy face from a poor man.
text_marked: Reject not the supplication of the afflicted; neither turn away thy face from a poor man.

text: Turn not away thine eye from the needy, and give him none occasion to curse thee:
text_marked: Turn not away thine eye from the needy, and give him none occasion to curse thee:

text: For if he curse thee in the bitterness of his soul, his prayer shall be heard of him that made him.
text_marked: For if he curse thee in the bitterness of his soul, his prayer shall be heard of him that made him.

text: Get thyself the love of the congregation, and bow thy head to a great man.
text_marked: Get thyself the love of the congregation, and bow thy head to a great man.

text: Let it not grieve thee to bow down thine ear to the poor, and give him a friendly answer with meekness.
text_marked: Let it not grieve thee to bow down thine ear to the poor, and give him a friendly answer with meekness.

text: Deliver him that suffereth wrong from the hand of the oppressor; and be not fainthearted when thou sittest in judgment.
text_marked: Deliver him that suffereth wrong from the hand of the oppressor; and be not fainthearted when thou sittest in judgment.

text: Be as a father unto the fatherless, and instead of an husband unto their mother: so shalt thou be as the son of the most High, and he shall love thee more than thy mother doth.
text_marked: Be as a father unto the fatherless, and instead of an husband unto their mother: so shalt thou be as the son of the most High, and he shall love thee more than thy mother doth.

text: Wisdom exalteth her children, and layeth hold of them that seek her.
text_marked: Wisdom exalteth her children, and layeth hold of them that seek her.

text: He that loveth her loveth life; and they that seek to her early shall be filled with joy.
text_marked: He that loveth her loveth life; and they that seek to her early shall be filled with joy.

text: He that holdeth her fast shall inherit glory; and wheresoever she entereth, the Lord will bless.
text_marked: He that holdeth her fast shall inherit glory; and wheresoever she entereth, the Lord will bless.

text: They that serve her shall minister to the Holy One: and them that love her the Lord doth love.
text_marked: They that serve her shall minister to the Holy One: and them that love her the Lord doth love.

text: Whoso giveth ear unto her shall judge the nations: and he that attendeth unto her shall dwell securely.
text_marked: Whoso giveth ear unto her shall judge the nations: and he that attendeth unto her shall dwell securely.

text: If a man commit himself unto her, he shall inherit her; and his generation shall hold her in possession.
text_marked: If a man commit himself unto her, he shall inherit her; and his generation shall hold her in possession.

text: For at the first she will walk with him by crooked ways, and bring fear and dread upon him, and torment him with her discipline, until she may trust his soul, and try him by her laws.
text_marked: For at the first she will walk with him by crooked ways, and bring fear and dread upon him, and torment him with her discipline, until she may trust his soul, and try him by her laws.

text: Then will she return the straight way unto him, and comfort him, and shew him her secrets.

text: But if he go wrong, she will forsake him, and give him over to his own ruin.
text_marked: But if he go wrong, she will forsake him, and give him over to his own ruin.

text: Observe the opportunity, and beware of evil; and be not ashamed when it concerneth thy soul.
text_marked: Observe the opportunity, and beware of evil; and be not ashamed when it concerneth thy soul.

text: For there is a shame that bringeth sin; and there is a shame which is glory and grace.

text: Accept no person against thy soul, and let not the reverence of any man cause thee to fall.
text_marked: Accept no person against thy soul, and let not the reverence of any man cause thee to fall.

text: And refrain not to speak, when there is occasion to do good, and hide not thy wisdom in her beauty.
text_marked: And refrain not to speak, when there is occasion to do good, and hide not thy wisdom in her beauty.

text: For by speech wisdom shall be known: and learning by the word of the tongue.
text_marked: For by speech wisdom shall be known: and learning by the word of the tongue.

text: In no wise speak against the truth; but be abashed of the error of thine ignorance.
text_marked: In no wise speak against the truth; but be abashed of the error of thine ignorance.

text: Be not ashamed to confess thy sins; and force not the course of the river.
text_marked: Be not ashamed to confess thy sins; and force not the course of the river.

text: Make not thyself an underling to a foolish man; neither accept the person of the mighty.
text_marked: Make not thyself an underling to a foolish man; neither accept the person of the mighty.

text: Strive for the truth unto death, and the Lord shall fight for thee.
text_marked: Strive for the truth unto death, and the Lord shall fight for thee.

text: Be not hasty in thy tongue, and in thy deeds slack and remiss.
text_marked: Be not hasty in thy tongue, and in thy deeds slack and remiss.

text: Be not as a lion in thy house, nor frantick among thy servants.
text_marked: Be not as a lion in thy house, nor frantick among thy servants.

text: Let not thine hand be stretched out to receive, and shut when thou shouldest repay.
text_marked: Let not thine hand be stretched out to receive, and shut when thou shouldest repay.

text: Set thy heart upon thy goods; and say not, I have enough for my life.
text_marked: Set thy heart upon thy goods; and say not, I have enough for my life.

text: Follow not thine own mind and thy strength, to walk in the ways of thy heart:
text_marked: Follow not thine own mind and thy strength, to walk in the ways of thy heart:

text: And say not, Who shall controul me for my works? for the Lord will surely revenge thy pride.
text_marked: And say not, Who shall controul me for my works? for the Lord will surely revenge thy pride.

text: Say not, I have sinned, and what harm hath happened unto me? for the Lord is longsuffering, he will in no wise let thee go.
text_marked: Say not, I have sinned, and what harm hath happened unto me? for the Lord is longsuffering, he will in no wise let thee go.

text: Concerning propitiation, be not without fear to add sin unto sin:
text_marked: Concerning propitiation, be not without fear to add sin unto sin:

text: And say not His mercy is great; he will be pacified for the multitude of my sins: for mercy and wrath come from him, and his indignation resteth upon sinners.
text_marked: And say not His mercy is great; he will be pacified for the multitude of my sins: for mercy and wrath come from him, and his indignation resteth upon sinners.

text: Make no tarrying to turn to the Lord, and put not off from day to day: for suddenly shall the wrath of the Lord come forth, and in thy security thou shalt be destroyed, and perish in the day of vengeance.
text_marked: Make no tarrying to turn to the Lord, and put not off from day to day: for suddenly shall the wrath of the Lord come forth, and in thy security thou shalt be destroyed, and perish in the day of vengeance.

text: Set not thine heart upon goods unjustly gotten, for they shall not profit thee in the day of calamity.
text_marked: Set not thine heart upon goods unjustly gotten, for they shall not profit thee in the day of calamity.

text: Winnow not with every wind, and go not into every way: for so doth the sinner that hath a double tongue.
text_marked: Winnow not with every wind, and go not into every way: for so doth the sinner that hath a double tongue.

text: Be stedfast in thy understanding; and let thy word be the same.
text_marked: Be stedfast in thy understanding; and let thy word be the same.

text: Be swift to hear; and let thy life be sincere; and with patience give answer.
text_marked: Be swift to hear; and let thy life be sincere; and with patience give answer.

text: If thou hast understanding, answer thy neighbour; if not, lay thy hand upon thy mouth.
text_marked: If thou hast understanding, answer thy neighbour; if not, lay thy hand upon thy mouth.

text: Honour and shame is in talk: and the tongue of man is his fall.
text_marked: Honour and shame is in talk: and the tongue of man is his fall.

text: Be not called a whisperer, and lie not in wait with thy tongue: for a foul shame is upon the thief, and an evil condemnation upon the double tongue.
text_marked: Be not called a whisperer, and lie not in wait with thy tongue: for a foul shame is upon the thief, and an evil condemnation upon the double tongue.

text: Be not ignorant of any thing in a great matter or a small.
text_marked: Be not ignorant of any thing in a great matter or a small.

text: Instead of a friend become not an enemy; for thereby thou shalt inherit an ill name, shame, and reproach: even so shall a sinner that hath a double tongue.
text_marked: Instead of a friend become not an enemy; for [thereby] thou shalt inherit an ill name, shame, and reproach: even so shall a sinner that hath a double tongue.

text: Extol not thyself in the counsel of thine own heart; that thy soul be not torn in pieces as a bull straying alone.
text_marked: Extol not thyself in the counsel of thine own heart; that thy soul be not torn in pieces as a bull [straying alone].

text: Thou shalt eat up thy leaves, and lose thy fruit, and leave thyself as a dry tree.
text_marked: Thou shalt eat up thy leaves, and lose thy fruit, and leave thyself as a dry tree.

text: A wicked soul shall destroy him that hath it, and shall make him to be laughed to scorn of his enemies.
text_marked: A wicked soul shall destroy him that hath it, and shall make him to be laughed to scorn of his enemies.

text: Sweet language will multiply friends: and a fairspeaking tongue will increase kind greetings.
text_marked: Sweet language will multiply friends: and a fairspeaking tongue will increase kind greetings.

text: Be in peace with many: nevertheless have but one counsellor of a thousand.
text_marked: Be in peace with many: nevertheless have but one counsellor of a thousand.

text: If thou wouldest get a friend, prove him first and be not hasty to credit him.
text_marked: If thou wouldest get a friend, prove him first and be not hasty to credit him.

text: For some man is a friend for his own occasion, and will not abide in the day of thy trouble.
text_marked: For some man is a friend for his own occasion, and will not abide in the day of thy trouble.

text: And there is a friend, who being turned to enmity, and strife will discover thy reproach.
text_marked: And there is a friend, who being turned to enmity, and strife will discover thy reproach.

text: Again, some friend is a companion at the table, and will not continue in the day of thy affliction.
text_marked: Again, some friend is a companion at the table, and will not continue in the day of thy affliction.

text: But in thy prosperity he will be as thyself, and will be bold over thy servants.
text_marked: But in thy prosperity he will be as thyself, and will be bold over thy servants.

text: If thou be brought low, he will be against thee, and will hide himself from thy face.
text_marked: If thou be brought low, he will be against thee, and will hide himself from thy face.

text: Separate thyself from thine enemies, and take heed of thy friends.
text_marked: Separate thyself from thine enemies, and take heed of thy friends.

text: A faithfull friend is a strong defence: and he that hath found such an one hath found a treasure.
text_marked: A faithfull friend is a strong defence: and he that hath found such an one hath found a treasure.

text: Nothing doth countervail a faithful friend, and his excellency is invaluable.
text_marked: Nothing doth countervail a faithful friend, and his excellency is invaluable.

text: A faithful friend is the medicine of life; and they that fear the Lord shall find him.
text_marked: A faithful friend is the medicine of life; and they that fear the Lord shall find him.

text: Whoso feareth the Lord shall direct his friendship aright: for as he is, so shall his neighbour be also.
text_marked: Whoso feareth the Lord shall direct his friendship aright: for as he is, so shall his neighbour be also.

text: My son, gather instruction from thy youth up: so shalt thou find wisdom till thine old age.
text_marked: My son, gather instruction from thy youth up: so shalt thou find wisdom till thine old age.

text: Come unto her as one that ploweth and soweth, and wait for her good fruits: for thou shalt not toil much in labouring about her, but thou shalt eat of her fruits right soon.
text_marked: Come unto her as one that ploweth and soweth, and wait for her good fruits: for thou shalt not toil much in labouring about her, but thou shalt eat of her fruits right soon.

text: She is very unpleasant to the unlearned: he that is without understanding will not remain with her.
text_marked: She is very unpleasant to the unlearned: he that is without understanding will not remain with her.

text: She will lie upon him as a mighty stone of trial; and he will cast her from him ere it be long.
text_marked: She will lie upon him as a mighty stone of trial; and he will cast her from him ere it be long.

text: For wisdom is according to her name, and she is not manifest unto many.
text_marked: For wisdom is according to her name, and she is not manifest unto many.

text: Give ear, my son, receive my advice, and refuse not my counsel,
text_marked: Give ear, my son, receive my advice, and refuse not my counsel,

text: And put thy feet into her fetters, and thy neck into her chain.
text_marked: And put thy feet into her fetters, and thy neck into her chain.

text: Bow down thy shoulder, and bear her, and be not grieved with her bonds.
text_marked: Bow down thy shoulder, and bear her, and be not grieved with her bonds.

text: Come unto her with thy whole heart, and keep her ways with all thy power.
text_marked: Come unto her with thy whole heart, and keep her ways with all thy power.

text: Search, and seek, and she shall be made known unto thee: and when thou hast got hold of her, let her not go.
text_marked: Search, and seek, and she shall be made known unto thee: and when thou hast got hold of her, let her not go.

text: For at the last thou shalt find her rest, and that shall be turned to thy joy.
text_marked: For at the last thou shalt find her rest, and that shall be turned to thy joy.

text: Then shall her fetters be a strong defence for thee, and her chains a robe of glory.
text_marked: Then shall her fetters be a strong defence for thee, and her chains a robe of glory.

text: For there is a golden ornament upon her, and her bands are purple lace.
text_marked: For there is a golden ornament upon her, and her bands are purple lace.

text: Thou shalt put her on as a robe of honour, and shalt put her about thee as a crown of joy.
text_marked: Thou shalt put her on as a robe of honour, and shalt put her about thee as a crown of joy.

text: My son, if thou wilt, thou shalt be taught: and if thou wilt apply thy mind, thou shalt be prudent.
text_marked: My son, if thou wilt, thou shalt be taught: and if thou wilt apply thy mind, thou shalt be prudent.

text: If thou love to hear, thou shalt receive understanding: and if thou bow thine ear, thou shalt be wise,
text_marked: If thou love to hear, thou shalt receive understanding: and if thou bow thine ear, thou shalt be wise,

text: Stand in the multitude of the elders; and cleave unto him that is wise.
text_marked: Stand in the multitude of the elders; and cleave unto him that is wise.

text: Be willing to hear every godly discourse; and let not the parables of understanding escape thee.
text_marked: Be willing to hear every godly discourse; and let not the parables of understanding escape thee.

text: And if thou seest a man of understanding, get thee betimes unto him, and let thy foot wear the steps of his door.
text_marked: And if thou seest a man of understanding, get thee betimes unto him, and let thy foot wear the steps of his door.

text: Let thy mind be upon the ordinances of the Lord and meditate continually in his commandments: he shall establish thine heart, and give thee wisdom at thine owns desire.
text_marked: Let thy mind be upon the ordinances of the Lord and meditate continually in his commandments: he shall establish thine heart, and give thee wisdom at thine owns desire.

text: Do no evil, so shall no harm come unto thee.
text_marked: Do no evil, so shall no harm come unto thee.

text: Depart from the unjust, and iniquity shall turn away from thee.
text_marked: Depart from the unjust, and iniquity shall turn away from thee.

text: My son, sow not upon the furrows of unrighteousness, and thou shalt not reap them sevenfold.
text_marked: My son, sow not upon the furrows of unrighteousness, and thou shalt not reap them sevenfold.

text: Seek not of the Lord preeminence, neither of the king the seat of honour.
text_marked: Seek not of the Lord preeminence, neither of the king the seat of honour.

text: justify not thyself before the Lord; and boast not of thy wisdom before the king.
text_marked: justify not thyself before the Lord; and boast not of thy wisdom before the king.

text: Seek not to be judge, being not able to take away iniquity; lest at any time thou fear the person of the mighty, an stumblingblock in the way of thy uprightness.
text_marked: Seek not to be judge, being not able to take away iniquity; lest at any time thou fear the person of the mighty, an stumblingblock in the way of thy uprightness.

text: Offend not against the multitude of a city, and then thou shalt not cast thyself down among the people.
text_marked: Offend not against the multitude of a city, and then thou shalt not cast thyself down among the people.

text: Bind not one sin upon another; for in one thou shalt not be unpunished.
text_marked: Bind not one sin upon another; for in one thou shalt not be unpunished.

text: Say not, God will look upon the multitude of my oblations, and when I offer to the most high God, he will accept it.
text_marked: Say not, God will look upon the multitude of my oblations, and when I offer to the most high God, he will accept it.

text: Be not fainthearted when thou makest thy prayer, and neglect not to give alms.
text_marked: Be not fainthearted when thou makest thy prayer, and neglect not to give alms.

text: Laugh no man to scorn in the bitterness of his soul: for there is one which humbleth and exalteth.
text_marked: Laugh no man to scorn in the bitterness of his soul: for there is one which humbleth and exalteth.

text: Devise not a lie against thy brother; neither do the like to thy friend.
text_marked: Devise not a lie against thy brother; neither do the like to thy friend.

text: Use not to make any manner of lie: for the custom thereof is not good.
text_marked: Use not to make any manner of lie: for the custom thereof is not good.

text: Use not many words in a multitude of elders, and make not much babbling when thou prayest.
text_marked: Use not many words in a multitude of elders, and make not much babbling when thou prayest.

text: Hate not laborious work, neither husbandry, which the most High hath ordained.
text_marked: Hate not laborious work, neither husbandry, which the most High hath ordained.

text: Number not thyself among the multitude of sinners, but remember that wrath will not tarry long.
text_marked: Number not thyself among the multitude of sinners, but remember that wrath will not tarry long.

text: Humble thyself greatly: for the vengeance of the ungodly is fire and worms.
text_marked: Humble thyself greatly: for the vengeance of the ungodly is fire and worms.

text: Change not a friend for any good by no means; neither a faithful brother for the gold of Ophir.
text_marked: Change not a friend for any good by no means; neither a faithful brother for the gold of Ophir.

text: Forego not a wise and good woman: for her grace is above gold.
text_marked: Forego not a wise and good woman: for her grace is above gold.

text: Whereas thy servant worketh truly, entreat him not evil, nor the hireling that bestoweth himself wholly for thee.
text_marked: Whereas thy servant worketh truly, entreat him not evil, nor the hireling that bestoweth himself wholly for thee.

text: Let thy soul love a good servant, and defraud him not of liberty.
text_marked: Let thy soul love a good servant, and defraud him not of liberty.

text: Hast thou cattle? have an eye to them: and if they be for thy profit, keep them with thee.
text_marked: Hast thou cattle? have an eye to them: and if they be for thy profit, keep them with thee.

text: Hast thou children? instruct them, and bow down their neck from their youth.
text_marked: Hast thou children? instruct them, and bow down their neck from their youth.

text: Hast thou daughters? have a care of their body, and shew not thyself cheerful toward them.
text_marked: Hast thou daughters? have a care of their body, and shew not thyself cheerful toward them.

text: Marry thy daughter, and so shalt thou have performed a weighty matter: but give her to a man of understanding.
text_marked: Marry thy daughter, and so shalt thou have performed a weighty matter: but give her to a man of understanding.

text: Hast thou a wife after thy mind? forsake her not: but give not thyself over to a light woman.
text_marked: Hast thou a wife after thy mind? forsake her not: but give not thyself over to a light woman.

text: Honour thy father with thy whole heart, and forget not the sorrows of thy mother.
text_marked: Honour thy father with thy whole heart, and forget not the sorrows of thy mother.

text: Remember that thou wast begotten of them; and how canst thou recompense them the things that they have done for thee?
text_marked: Remember that thou wast begotten of them; and how canst thou recompense them the things that they have done for thee?

text: Fear the Lord with all thy soul, and reverence his priests.
text_marked: Fear the Lord with all thy soul, and reverence his priests.

text: Love him that made thee with all thy strength, and forsake not his ministers.
text_marked: Love him that made thee with all thy strength, and forsake not his ministers.

text: Fear the Lord, and honor the priest; and give him his portion, as it is commanded thee; the firstfruits, and the trespass offering, and the gift of the shoulders, and the sacrifice of sanctification, and the firstfruits of the holy things.
text_marked: Fear the Lord, and honor the priest; and give him his portion, as it is commanded thee; the firstfruits, and the trespass offering, and the gift of the shoulders, and the sacrifice of sanctification, and the firstfruits of the holy things.

text: And stretch thine hand unto the poor, that thy blessing may be perfected.
text_marked: And stretch thine hand unto the poor, that thy blessing may be perfected.

text: A gift hath grace in the sight of every man living; and for the dead detain it not.
text_marked: A gift hath grace in the sight of every man living; and for the dead detain it not.

text: Fail not to be with them that weep, and mourn with them that mourn.
text_marked: Fail not to be with them that weep, and mourn with them that mourn.

text: Be not slow to visit the sick: for that shall make thee to be beloved.
text_marked: Be not slow to visit the sick: for that shall make thee to be beloved.

text: Whatsoever thou takest in hand, remember the end, and thou shalt never do amiss.
text_marked: Whatsoever thou takest in hand, remember the end, and thou shalt never do amiss.

text: Strive not with a mighty man’ lest thou fall into his hands.
text_marked: Strive not with a mighty man’ lest thou fall into his hands.

text: Be not at variance with a rich man, lest he overweigh thee: for gold hath destroyed many, and perverted the hearts of kings.
text_marked: Be not at variance with a rich man, lest he overweigh thee: for gold hath destroyed many, and perverted the hearts of kings.

text: Strive not with a man that is full of tongue, and heap not wood upon his fire.
text_marked: Strive not with a man that is full of tongue, and heap not wood upon his fire.

text: Jest not with a rude man, lest thy ancestors be disgraced.
text_marked: Jest not with a rude man, lest thy ancestors be disgraced.

text: Reproach not a man that turneth from sin, but remember that we are all worthy of punishment.
text_marked: Reproach not a man that turneth from sin, but remember that we are all worthy of punishment.

text: Dishonour not a man in his old age: for even some of us wax old.
text_marked: Dishonour not a man in his old age: for even some of us wax old.

text: Rejoice not over thy greatest enemy being dead, but remember that we die all.
text_marked: Rejoice not over thy greatest enemy being dead, but remember that we die all.

text: Despise not the discourse of the wise, but acquaint thyself with their proverbs: for of them thou shalt learn instruction, and how to serve great men with ease.
text_marked: Despise not the discourse of the wise, but acquaint thyself with their proverbs: for of them thou shalt learn instruction, and how to serve great men with ease.

text: Miss not the discourse of the elders: for they also learned of their fathers, and of them thou shalt learn understanding, and to give answer as need requireth.
text_marked: Miss not the discourse of the elders: for they also learned of their fathers, and of them thou shalt learn understanding, and to give answer as need requireth.

text: Kindle not the coals of a sinner, lest thou be burnt with the flame of his fire.
text_marked: Kindle not the coals of a sinner, lest thou be burnt with the flame of his fire.

text: Rise not up in anger at the presence of an injurious person, lest he lie in wait to entrap thee in thy words
text_marked: Rise not up [in anger] at the presence of an injurious person, lest he lie in wait to entrap thee in thy words

text: Lend not unto him that is mightier than thyself; for if thou lendest him, count it but lost.
text_marked: Lend not unto him that is mightier than thyself; for if thou lendest him, count it but lost.

text: Be not surety above thy power: for if thou be surety, take care to pay it.
text_marked: Be not surety above thy power: for if thou be surety, take care to pay it.

text: Go not to law with a judge; for they will judge for him according to his honour.
text_marked: Go not to law with a judge; for they will judge for him according to his honour.

text: Travel not by the way with a bold fellow, lest he become grievous unto thee: for he will do according to his own will, and thou shalt perish with him through his folly.
text_marked: Travel not by the way with a bold fellow, lest he become grievous unto thee: for he will do according to his own will, and thou shalt perish with him through his folly.

text: Strive not with an angry man, and go not with him into a solitary place: for blood is as nothing in his sight, and where there is no help, he will overthrow thee.
text_marked: Strive not with an angry man, and go not with him into a solitary place: for blood is as nothing in his sight, and where there is no help, he will overthrow thee.

text: Consult not with a fool; for he cannot keep counsel.
text_marked: Consult not with a fool; for he cannot keep counsel.

text: Do no secret thing before a stranger; for thou knowest not what he will bring forth.
text_marked: Do no secret thing before a stranger; for thou knowest not what he will bring forth.

text: Open not thine heart to every man, lest he requite thee with a shrewd turn.
text_marked: Open not thine heart to every man, lest he requite thee with a shrewd turn.

text: Be not jealous over the wife of thy bosom, and teach her not an evil lesson against thyself.
text_marked: Be not jealous over the wife of thy bosom, and teach her not an evil lesson against thyself.

text: Give not thy soul unto a woman to set her foot upon thy substance.
text_marked: Give not thy soul unto a woman to set her foot upon thy substance.

text: Meet not with an harlot, lest thou fall into her snares.
text_marked: Meet not with an harlot, lest thou fall into her snares.

text: Use not much the company of a woman that is a singer, lest thou be taken with her attempts.
text_marked: Use not much the company of a woman that is a singer, lest thou be taken with her attempts.

text: Gaze not on a maid, that thou fall not by those things that are precious in her.
text_marked: Gaze not on a maid, that thou fall not by those things that are precious in her.

text: Give not thy soul unto harlots, that thou lose not thine inheritance.
text_marked: Give not thy soul unto harlots, that thou lose not thine inheritance.

text: Look not round about thee in the streets of the city, neither wander thou in the solitary place thereof.
text_marked: Look not round about thee in the streets of the city, neither wander thou in the solitary place thereof.

text: Turn away thine eye from a beautiful woman, and look not upon another’s beauty; for many have been deceived by the beauty of a woman; for herewith love is kindled as a fire.
text_marked: Turn away thine eye from a beautiful woman, and look not upon another’s beauty; for many have been deceived by the beauty of a woman; for herewith love is kindled as a fire.

text: Sit not at all with another man’s wife, nor sit down with her in thine arms, and spend not thy money with her at the wine; lest thine heart incline unto her, and so through thy desire thou fall into destruction.
text_marked: Sit not at all with another man’s wife, nor sit down with her in thine arms, and spend not thy money with her at the wine; lest thine heart incline unto her, and so through thy desire thou fall into destruction.

text: Forsake not an old friend; for the new is not comparable to him: a new friend is as new wine; when it is old, thou shalt drink it with pleasure.
text_marked: Forsake not an old friend; for the new is not comparable to him: a new friend is as new wine; when it is old, thou shalt drink it with pleasure.

text: Envy not the glory of a sinner: for thou knowest not what shall be his end.
text_marked: Envy not the glory of a sinner: for thou knowest not what shall be his end.

text: Delight not in the thing that the ungodly have pleasure in; but remember they shall not go unpunished unto their grave.
text_marked: Delight not in the thing that the ungodly have pleasure in; but remember they shall not go unpunished unto their grave.

text: Keep thee far from the man that hath power to kill; so shalt thou not doubt the fear of death: and if thou come unto him, make no fault, lest he take away thy life presently: remember that thou goest in the midst of snares, and that thou walkest upon the battlements of the city.
text_marked: Keep thee far from the man that hath power to kill; so shalt thou not doubt the fear of death: and if thou come unto him, make no fault, lest he take away thy life presently: remember that thou goest in the midst of snares, and that thou walkest upon the battlements of the city.

text: As near as thou canst, guess at thy neighbour, and consult with the wise.
text_marked: As near as thou canst, guess at thy neighbour, and consult with the wise.

text: Let thy talk be with the wise, and all thy communication in the law of the most High.
text_marked: Let thy talk be with the wise, and all thy communication in the law of the most High.

text: And let just men eat and drink with thee; and let thy glorying be in the fear of the Lord.
text_marked: And let just men eat and drink with thee; and let thy glorying be in the fear of the Lord.

text: For the hand of the artificer the work shall be commended: and the wise ruler of the people for his speech.
text_marked: For the hand of the artificer the work shall be commended: and the wise ruler of the people for his speech.

text: A man of an ill tongue is dangerous in his city; and he that is rash in his talk shall be hated.
text_marked: A man of an ill tongue is dangerous in his city; and he that is rash in his talk shall be hated.

text: A wise judge will instruct his people; and the government of a prudent man is well ordered.
text_marked: A wise judge will instruct his people; and the government of a prudent man is well ordered.

text: As the judge of the people is himself, so are his officers; and what manner of man the ruler of the city is, such are all they that dwell therein.
text_marked: As the judge of the people is himself, so are his officers; and what manner of man the ruler of the city is, such are all they that dwell therein.

text: An unwise king destroyeth his people; but through the prudence of them which are in authority the city shall be inhabited.
text_marked: An unwise king destroyeth his people; but through the prudence of them which are in authority the city shall be inhabited.

text: The power of the earth is in the hand of the Lord, and in due time he will set over it one that is profitable.
text_marked: The power of the earth is in the hand of the Lord, and in due time he will set over it one that is profitable.

text: In the hand of God is the prosperity of man: and upon the person of the scribe shall he lay his honour.
text_marked: In the hand of God is the prosperity of man: and upon the person of the scribe shall he lay his honour.

text: Bear not hatred to thy neighbour for every wrong; and do nothing at all by injurious practices.
text_marked: Bear not hatred to thy neighbour for every wrong; and do nothing at all by injurious practices.

text: Pride is hateful before God and man: and by both doth one commit iniquity.
text_marked: Pride is hateful before God and man: and by both doth one commit iniquity.

text: Because of unrighteous dealings, injuries, and riches got by deceit, the kingdom is translated from one people to another.
text_marked: Because of unrighteous dealings, injuries, and riches got by deceit, the kingdom is translated from one people to another.

text: Why is earth and ashes proud? There is not a more wicked thing than a covetous man: for such an one setteth his own soul to sale; because while he liveth he casteth away his bowels.
text_marked: Why is earth and ashes proud? There is not a more wicked thing than a covetous man: for such an one setteth his own soul to sale; because while he liveth he casteth away his bowels.

text: The physician cutteth off a long disease; and he that is to day a king to morrow shall die.
text_marked: The physician cutteth off a long disease; and he that is to day a king to morrow shall die.

text: For when a man is dead, he shall inherit creeping things, beasts, and worms.
text_marked: For when a man is dead, he shall inherit creeping things, beasts, and worms.

text: The beginning of pride is when one departeth from God, and his heart is turned away from his Maker.
text_marked: The beginning of pride is when one departeth from God, and his heart is turned away from his Maker.

text: For pride is the beginning of sin, and he that hath it shall pour out abomination: and therefore the Lord brought upon them strange calamities, and overthrew them utterly.
text_marked: For pride is the beginning of sin, and he that hath it shall pour out abomination: and therefore the Lord brought upon them strange calamities, and overthrew them utterly.

text: The Lord hath cast down the thrones of proud princes, and set up the meek in their stead.
text_marked: The Lord hath cast down the thrones of proud princes, and set up the meek in their stead.

text: The Lord hath plucked up the roots of the proud nations, and planted the lowly in their place.
text_marked: The Lord hath plucked up the roots of the proud nations, and planted the lowly in their place.

text: The Lord overthrew countries of the heathen, and destroyed them to the foundations of the earth.
text_marked: The Lord overthrew countries of the heathen, and destroyed them to the foundations of the earth.

text: He took some of them away, and destroyed them, and hath made their memorial to cease from the earth.
text_marked: He took some of them away, and destroyed them, and hath made their memorial to cease from the earth.

text: Pride was not made for men, nor furious anger for them that are born of a woman.
text_marked: Pride was not made for men, nor furious anger for them that are born of a woman.

text: They that fear the Lord are a sure seed, and they that love him an honourable plant: they that regard not the law are a dishonourable seed; they that transgress the commandments are a deceivable seed.
text_marked: They that fear the Lord are a sure seed, and they that love him an honourable plant: they that regard not the law are a dishonourable seed; they that transgress the commandments are a deceivable seed.

text: Among brethren he that is chief is honorable; so are they that fear the Lord in his eyes.
text_marked: Among brethren he that is chief is honorable; so are they that fear the Lord in his eyes.

text: The fear of the Lord goeth before the obtaining of authority: but roughness and pride is the losing thereof.
text_marked: The fear of the Lord goeth before the obtaining of authority: but roughness and pride is the losing thereof.

text: Whether he be rich, noble, or poor, their glory is the fear of the Lord.
text_marked: Whether he be rich, noble, or poor, their glory is the fear of the Lord.

text: It is not meet to despise the poor man that hath understanding; neither is it convenient to magnify a sinful man.
text_marked: It is not meet to despise the poor man that hath understanding; neither is it convenient to magnify a sinful man.

text: Great men, and judges, and potentates, shall be honoured; yet is there none of them greater than he that feareth the Lord.
text_marked: Great men, and judges, and potentates, shall be honoured; yet is there none of them greater than he that feareth the Lord.

text: Unto the servant that is wise shall they that are free do service: and he that hath knowledge will not grudge when he is reformed.
text_marked: Unto the servant that is wise shall they that are free do service: and he that hath knowledge will not grudge when he is reformed.

text: Be not overwise in doing thy business; and boast not thyself in the time of thy distress.
text_marked: Be not overwise in doing thy business; and boast not thyself in the time of thy distress.

text: Better is he that laboureth, and aboundeth in all things, than he that boasteth himself, and wanteth bread.
text_marked: Better is he that laboureth, and aboundeth in all things, than he that boasteth himself, and wanteth bread.

text: My son, glorify thy soul in meekness, and give it honour according to the dignity thereof.
text_marked: My son, glorify thy soul in meekness, and give it honour according to the dignity thereof.

text: Who will justify him that sinneth against his own soul? and who will honour him that dishonoureth his own life?
text_marked: Who will justify him that sinneth against his own soul? and who will honour him that dishonoureth his own life?

text: The poor man is honoured for his skill, and the rich man is honoured for his riches.
text_marked: The poor man is honoured for his skill, and the rich man is honoured for his riches.

text: He that is honoured in poverty, how much more in riches? and he that is dishonourable in riches, how much more in poverty?
text_marked: He that is honoured in poverty, how much more in riches? and he that is dishonourable in riches, how much more in poverty?

text: Wisdom lifteth up the head of him that is of low degree, and maketh him to sit among great men.
text_marked: Wisdom lifteth up the head of him that is of low degree, and maketh him to sit among great men.

text: Commend not a man for his beauty; neither abhor a man for his outward appearance.
text_marked: Commend not a man for his beauty; neither abhor a man for his outward appearance.

text: The bee is little among such as fly; but her fruit is the chief of sweet things.
text_marked: The bee is little among such as fly; but her fruit is the chief of sweet things.

text: Boast not of thy clothing and raiment, and exalt not thyself in the day of honour: for the works of the Lord are wonderful, and his works among men are hidden.
text_marked: Boast not of thy clothing and raiment, and exalt not thyself in the day of honour: for the works of the Lord are wonderful, and his works among men are hidden.

text: Many kings have sat down upon the ground; and one that was never thought of hath worn the crown.
text_marked: Many kings have sat down upon the ground; and one that was never thought of hath worn the crown.

text: Many mighty men have been greatly disgraced; and the honourable delivered into other men’s hands.
text_marked: Many mighty men have been greatly disgraced; and the honourable delivered into other men’s hands.

text: Blame not before thou hast examined the truth: understand first, and then rebuke.
text_marked: Blame not before thou hast examined the truth: understand first, and then rebuke.

text: Answer not before thou hast heard the cause: neither interrupt men in the midst of their talk.
text_marked: Answer not before thou hast heard the cause: neither interrupt men in the midst of their talk.

text: Strive not in a matter that concerneth thee not; and sit not in judgment with sinners.
text_marked: Strive not in a matter that concerneth thee not; and sit not in judgment with sinners.

text: My son, meddle not with many matters: for if thou meddle much, thou shalt not be innocent; and if thou follow after, thou shalt not obtain, neither shalt thou escape by fleeing.
text_marked: My son, meddle not with many matters: for if thou meddle much, thou shalt not be innocent; and if thou follow after, thou shalt not obtain, neither shalt thou escape by fleeing.

text: There is one that laboureth, and taketh pains, and maketh haste, and is so much the more behind.
text_marked: There is one that laboureth, and taketh pains, and maketh haste, and is so much the more behind.

text: Again, there is another that is slow, and hath need of help, wanting ability, and full of poverty; yet the eye of the Lord looked upon him for good, and set him up from his low estate,
text_marked: Again, there is another that is slow, and hath need of help, wanting ability, and full of poverty; yet the eye of the Lord looked upon him for good, and set him up from his low estate,

text: And lifted up his head from misery; so that many that saw it marvelled at him.
text_marked: And lifted up his head from misery; so that many that saw it marvelled at him.

text: Prosperity and adversity, life and death, poverty and riches, come of the Lord.
text_marked: Prosperity and adversity, life and death, poverty and riches, come of the Lord.

text: Wisdom, knowledge, and understanding of the law, are of the Lord: love, and the way of good works, are from him.
text_marked: Wisdom, knowledge, and understanding of the law, are of the Lord: love, and the way of good works, are from him.

text: Error and darkness had their beginning together with sinners: and evil shall wax old with them that glory therein.
text_marked: Error and darkness had their beginning together with sinners: and evil shall wax old with them that glory therein.

text: The gift of the Lord remaineth with the ungodly, and his favour bringeth prosperity for ever.
text_marked: The gift of the Lord remaineth with the ungodly, and his favour bringeth prosperity for ever.

text: There is that waxeth rich by his wariness and pinching, and this is the portion of his reward:
text_marked: There is that waxeth rich by his wariness and pinching, and this is the portion of his reward:

text: Whereas he saith, I have found rest, and now will eat continually of my goods; and yet he knoweth not what time shall come upon him, and that he must leave those things to others, and die.
text_marked: Whereas he saith, I have found rest, and now will eat continually of my goods; and yet he knoweth not what time shall come upon him, and that he must leave those things to others, and die.

text: Be stedfast in thy covenant, and be conversant therein, and wax old in thy work.
text_marked: Be stedfast in thy covenant, and be conversant therein, and wax old in thy work.

text: Marvel not at the works of sinners; but trust in the Lord, and abide in thy labour: for it is an easy thing in the sight of the Lord on the sudden to make a poor man rich.
text_marked: Marvel not at the works of sinners; but trust in the Lord, and abide in thy labour: for it is an easy thing in the sight of the Lord on the sudden to make a poor man rich.

text: The blessing of the Lord is in the reward of the godly, and suddenly he maketh his blessing flourish.
text_marked: The blessing of the Lord is in the reward of the godly, and suddenly he maketh his blessing flourish.

text: Say not, What profit is there of my service? and what good things shall I have hereafter?
text_marked: Say not, What profit is there of my service? and what good things shall I have hereafter?

text: Again, say not, I have enough, and possess many things, and what evil shall I have hereafter?
text_marked: Again, say not, I have enough, and possess many things, and what evil shall I have hereafter?

text: In the day of prosperity there is a forgetfulness of affliction: and in the day of affliction there is no more remembrance of prosperity.
text_marked: In the day of prosperity there is a forgetfulness of affliction: and in the day of affliction there is no more remembrance of prosperity.

text: For it is an easy thing unto the Lord in the day of death to reward a man according to his ways.
text_marked: For it is an easy thing unto the Lord in the day of death to reward a man according to his ways.

text: The affliction of an hour maketh a man forget pleasure: and in his end his deeds shall be discovered.
text_marked: The affliction of an hour maketh a man forget pleasure: and in his end his deeds shall be discovered.

text: Judge none blessed before his death: for a man shall be known in his children.
text_marked: Judge none blessed before his death: for a man shall be known in his children.

text: Bring not every man into thine house: for the deceitful man hath many trains.
text_marked: Bring not every man into thine house: for the deceitful man hath many trains.

text: Like as a partridge taken and kept in a cage, so is the heart of the proud; and like as a spy, watcheth he for thy fall:
text_marked: Like as a partridge taken [and kept] in a cage, so is the heart of the proud; and like as a spy, watcheth he for thy fall:

text: For he lieth in wait, and turneth good into evil, and in things worthy praise will lay blame upon thee.
text_marked: For he lieth in wait, and turneth good into evil, and in things worthy praise will lay blame upon thee.

text: Of a spark of fire a heap of coals is kindled: and a sinful man layeth wait for blood.
text_marked: Of a spark of fire a heap of coals is kindled: and a sinful man layeth wait for blood.

text: Take heed of a mischievous man, for he worketh wickedness; lest he bring upon thee a perpetual blot.
text_marked: Take heed of a mischievous man, for he worketh wickedness; lest he bring upon thee a perpetual blot.

text: Receive a stranger into thine house, and he will disturb thee, and turn thee out of thine own.
text_marked: Receive a stranger into thine house, and he will disturb thee, and turn thee out of thine own.

text: When thou wilt do good know to whom thou doest it; so shalt thou be thanked for thy benefits.
text_marked: When thou wilt do good know to whom thou doest it; so shalt thou be thanked for thy benefits.

text: Do good to the godly man, and thou shalt find a recompence; and if not from him, yet from the most High.
text_marked: Do good to the godly man, and thou shalt find a recompence; and if not from him, yet from the most High.

text: There can no good come to him that is always occupied in evil, nor to him that giveth no alms.
text_marked: There can no good come to him that is always occupied in evil, nor to him that giveth no alms.

text: Give to the godly man, and help not a sinner.
text_marked: Give to the godly man, and help not a sinner.

text: Do well unto him that is lowly, but give not to the ungodly: hold back thy bread, and give it not unto him, lest he overmaster thee thereby: for else thou shalt receive twice as much evil for all the good thou shalt have done unto him.
text_marked: Do well unto him that is lowly, but give not to the ungodly: hold back thy bread, and give it not unto him, lest he overmaster thee thereby: for [else] thou shalt receive twice as much evil for all the good thou shalt have done unto him.

text: For the most High hateth sinners, and will repay vengeance unto the ungodly, and keepeth them against the mighty day of their punishment.
text_marked: For the most High hateth sinners, and will repay vengeance unto the ungodly, and keepeth them against the mighty day of their punishment.

text: Give unto the good, and help not the sinner.
text_marked: Give unto the good, and help not the sinner.

text: A friend cannot be known in prosperity: and an enemy cannot be hidden in adversity.
text_marked: A friend cannot be known in prosperity: and an enemy cannot be hidden in adversity.

text: In the prosperity of a man enemies will be grieved: but in his adversity even a friend will depart.
text_marked: In the prosperity of a man enemies will be grieved: but in his adversity even a friend will depart.

text: Never trust thine enemy: for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.
text_marked: Never trust thine enemy: for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.

text: Though he humble himself, and go crouching, yet take good heed and beware of him, and thou shalt be unto him as if thou hadst wiped a lookingglass, and thou shalt know that his rust hath not been altogether wiped away.
text_marked: Though he humble himself, and go crouching, yet take good heed and beware of him, and thou shalt be unto him as if thou hadst wiped a lookingglass, and thou shalt know that his rust hath not been altogether wiped away.

text: Set him not by thee, lest, when he hath overthrown thee, he stand up in thy place; neither let him sit at thy right hand, lest he seek to take thy seat, and thou at the last remember my words, and be pricked therewith.
text_marked: Set him not by thee, lest, when he hath overthrown thee, he stand up in thy place; neither let him sit at thy right hand, lest he seek to take thy seat, and thou at the last remember my words, and be pricked therewith.

text: Who will pity a charmer that is bitten with a serpent, or any such as come nigh wild beasts?
text_marked: Who will pity a charmer that is bitten with a serpent, or any such as come nigh wild beasts?

text: So one that goeth to a sinner, and is defiled with him in his sins, who will pity?
text_marked: So one that goeth to a sinner, and is defiled with him in his sins, who will pity?

text: For a while he will abide with thee, but if thou begin to fall, he will not tarry.
text_marked: For a while he will abide with thee, but if thou begin to fall, he will not tarry.

text: An enemy speaketh sweetly with his lips, but in his heart he imagineth how to throw thee into a pit: he will weep with his eyes, but if he find opportunity, he will not be satisfied with blood.
text_marked: An enemy speaketh sweetly with his lips, but in his heart he imagineth how to throw thee into a pit: he will weep with his eyes, but if he find opportunity, he will not be satisfied with blood.

text: If adversity come upon thee, thou shalt find him there first; and though he pretend to help thee, yet shall he undermine thee.
text_marked: If adversity come upon thee, thou shalt find him there first; and though he pretend to help thee, yet shall he undermine thee.

text: He will shake his head, and clap his hands, and whisper much, and change his countenance.
text_marked: He will shake his head, and clap his hands, and whisper much, and change his countenance.

text: He that toucheth pitch shall be defiled therewith; and he that hath fellowship with a proud man shall be like unto him.
text_marked: He that toucheth pitch shall be defiled therewith; and he that hath fellowship with a proud man shall be like unto him.

text: Burden not thyself above thy power while thou livest; and have no fellowship with one that is mightier and richer than thyself: for how agree the kettle and the earthen pot together? for if the one be smitten against the other, it shall be broken.
text_marked: Burden not thyself above thy power while thou livest; and have no fellowship with one that is mightier and richer than thyself: for how agree the kettle and the earthen pot together? for if the one be smitten against the other, it shall be broken.

text: The rich man hath done wrong, and yet he threateneth withal: the poor is wronged, and he must intreat also.
text_marked: The rich man hath done wrong, and yet he threateneth withal: the poor is wronged, and he must intreat also.

text: If thou be for his profit, he will use thee: but if thou have nothing, he will forsake thee.
text_marked: If thou be for his profit, he will use thee: but if thou have nothing, he will forsake thee.

text: If thou have any thing, he will live with thee: yea, he will make thee bare, and will not be sorry for it.
text_marked: If thou have any thing, he will live with thee: yea, he will make thee bare, and will not be sorry for it.

text: If he have need of thee, he will deceive thee, and smile upon thee, and put thee in hope; he will speak thee fair, and say, What wantest thou?
text_marked: If he have need of thee, he will deceive thee, and smile upon thee, and put thee in hope; he will speak thee fair, and say, What wantest thou?

text: And he will shame thee by his meats, until he have drawn thee dry twice or thrice, and at the last he will laugh thee to scorn afterward, when he seeth thee, he will forsake thee, and shake his head at thee.
text_marked: And he will shame thee by his meats, until he have drawn thee dry twice or thrice, and at the last he will laugh thee to scorn afterward, when he seeth thee, he will forsake thee, and shake his head at thee.

text: Beware that thou be not deceived and brought down in thy jollity.
text_marked: Beware that thou be not deceived and brought down in thy jollity.

text: If thou be invited of a mighty man, withdraw thyself, and so much the more will he invite thee.
text_marked: If thou be invited of a mighty man, withdraw thyself, and so much the more will he invite thee.

text: Press thou not upon him, lest thou be put back; stand not far off, lest thou be forgotten.
text_marked: Press thou not upon him, lest thou be put back; stand not far off, lest thou be forgotten.

text: Affect not to be made equal unto him in talk, and believe not his many words: for with much communication will he tempt thee, and smiling upon thee will get out thy secrets:
text_marked: Affect not to be made equal unto him in talk, and believe not his many words: for with much communication will he tempt thee, and smiling upon thee will get out thy secrets:

text: But cruelly he will lay up thy words, and will not spare to do thee hurt, and to put thee in prison.
text_marked: But cruelly he will lay up thy words, and will not spare to do thee hurt, and to put thee in prison.

text: Observe, and take good heed, for thou walkest in peril of thy overthrowing: when thou hearest these things, awake in thy sleep.
text_marked: Observe, and take good heed, for thou walkest in peril of thy overthrowing: when thou hearest these things, awake in thy sleep.

text: Love the Lord all thy life, and call upon him for thy salvation.
text_marked: Love the Lord all thy life, and call upon him for thy salvation.

text: Every beast loveth his like, and every man loveth his neighbor.
text_marked: Every beast loveth his like, and every man loveth his neighbor.

text: All flesh consorteth according to kind, and a man will cleave to his like.
text_marked: All flesh consorteth according to kind, and a man will cleave to his like.

text: What fellowship hath the wolf with the lamb? so the sinner with the godly.
text_marked: What fellowship hath the wolf with the lamb? so the sinner with the godly.

text: What agreement is there between the hyena and a dog? and what peace between the rich and the poor?
text_marked: What agreement is there between the hyena and a dog? and what peace between the rich and the poor?

text: As the wild ass is the lion’s prey in the wilderness: so the rich eat up the poor.
text_marked: As the wild ass is the lion’s prey in the wilderness: so the rich eat up the poor.

text: As the proud hate humility: so doth the rich abhor the poor.
text_marked: As the proud hate humility: so doth the rich abhor the poor.

text: A rich man beginning to fall is held up of his friends: but a poor man being down is thrust away by his friends.
text_marked: A rich man beginning to fall is held up of his friends: but a poor man being down is thrust away by his friends.

text: When a rich man is fallen, he hath many helpers: he speaketh things not to be spoken, and yet men justify him: the poor man slipped, and yet they rebuked him too; he spake wisely, and could have no place.
text_marked: When a rich man is fallen, he hath many helpers: he speaketh things not to be spoken, and yet men justify him: the poor man slipped, and yet they rebuked him too; he spake wisely, and could have no place.

text: When a rich man speaketh, every man holdeth his tongue, and, look, what he saith, they extol it to the clouds: but if the poor man speak, they say, What fellow is this? and if he stumble, they will help to overthrow him.
text_marked: When a rich man speaketh, every man holdeth his tongue, and, look, what he saith, they extol it to the clouds: but if the poor man speak, they say, What fellow is this? and if he stumble, they will help to overthrow him.

text: Riches are good unto him that hath no sin, and poverty is evil in the mouth of the ungodly.
text_marked: Riches are good unto him that hath no sin, and poverty is evil in the mouth of the ungodly.

text: The heart of a man changeth his countenance, whether it be for good or evil: and a merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance.
text_marked: The heart of a man changeth his countenance, whether it be for good or evil: and a merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance.

text: A cheerful countenance is a token of a heart that is in prosperity; and the finding out of parables is a wearisome labour of the mind.
text_marked: A cheerful countenance is a token of a heart that is in prosperity; and the finding out of parables is a wearisome labour of the mind.

text: Blessed is the man that hath not slipped with his mouth, and is not pricked with the multitude of sins.
text_marked: Blessed is the man that hath not slipped with his mouth, and is not pricked with the multitude of sins.

text: Blessed is he whose conscience hath not condemned him, and who is not fallen from his hope in the Lord.
text_marked: Blessed is he whose conscience hath not condemned him, and who is not fallen from his hope in the Lord.

text: Riches are not comely for a niggard: and what should an envious man do with money?
text_marked: Riches are not comely for a niggard: and what should an envious man do with money?

text: He that gathereth by defrauding his own soul gathereth for others, that shall spend his goods riotously.
text_marked: He that gathereth by defrauding his own soul gathereth for others, that shall spend his goods riotously.

text: He that is evil to himself, to whom will he be good? he shall not take pleasure in his goods.
text_marked: He that is evil to himself, to whom will he be good? he shall not take pleasure in his goods.

text: There is none worse than he that envieth himself; and this is a recompence of his wickedness.
text_marked: There is none worse than he that envieth himself; and this is a recompence of his wickedness.

text: And if he doeth good, he doeth it unwillingly; and at the last he will declare his wickedness.
text_marked: And if he doeth good, he doeth it unwillingly; and at the last he will declare his wickedness.

text: The envious man hath a wicked eye; he turneth away his face, and despiseth men.
text_marked: The envious man hath a wicked eye; he turneth away his face, and despiseth men.

text: A covetous man’s eye is not satisfied with his portion; and the iniquity of the wicked drieth up his soul.
text_marked: A covetous man’s eye is not satisfied with his portion; and the iniquity of the wicked drieth up his soul.

text: A wicked eye envieth his bread, and he is a niggard at his table.
text_marked: A wicked eye envieth [his] bread, and he is a niggard at his table.

text: My son, according to thy ability do good to thyself, and give the Lord his due offering.
text_marked: My son, according to thy ability do good to thyself, and give the Lord his due offering.

text: Remember that death will not be long in coming, and that the covenant of the grave is not shewed unto thee.
text_marked: Remember that death will not be long in coming, and that the covenant of the grave is not shewed unto thee.

text: Do good unto thy friend before thou die, and according to thy ability stretch out thy hand and give to him.
text_marked: Do good unto thy friend before thou die, and according to thy ability stretch out thy hand and give to him.

text: Defraud not thyself of the good day, and let not the part of a good desire overpass thee.
text_marked: Defraud not thyself of the good day, and let not the part of a good desire overpass thee.

text: Shalt thou not leave thy travails unto another? and thy labours to be divided by lot?
text_marked: Shalt thou not leave thy travails unto another? and thy labours to be divided by lot?

text: Give, and take, and sanctify thy soul; for there is no seeking of dainties in the grave.
text_marked: Give, and take, and sanctify thy soul; for there is no seeking of dainties in the grave.

text: All flesh waxeth old as a garment: for the covenant from the beginning is, Thou shalt die the death.
text_marked: All flesh waxeth old as a garment: for the covenant from the beginning is, Thou shalt die the death.

text: As of the green leaves on a thick tree, some fall, and some grow; so is the generation of flesh and blood, one cometh to an end, and another is born.
text_marked: As of the green leaves on a thick tree, some fall, and some grow; so is the generation of flesh and blood, one cometh to an end, and another is born.

text: Every work rotteth and consumeth away, and the worker thereof shall go withal.
text_marked: Every work rotteth and consumeth away, and the worker thereof shall go withal.

text: Blessed is the man that doth meditate good things in wisdom, and that reasoneth of holy things by his understanding.
text_marked: Blessed is the man that doth meditate good things in wisdom, and that reasoneth of holy things by his understanding.

text: He that considereth her ways in his heart shall also have understanding in her secrets.
text_marked: He that considereth her ways in his heart shall also have understanding in her secrets.

text: Go after her as one that traceth, and lie in wait in her ways.
text_marked: Go after her as one that traceth, and lie in wait in her ways.

text: He that prieth in at her windows shall also hearken at her doors.
text_marked: He that prieth in at her windows shall also hearken at her doors.

text: He that doth lodge near her house shall also fasten a pin in her walls.
text_marked: He that doth lodge near her house shall also fasten a pin in her walls.

text: He shall pitch his tent nigh unto her, and shall lodge in a lodging where good things are.
text_marked: He shall pitch his tent nigh unto her, and shall lodge in a lodging where good things are.

text: He shall set his children under her shelter, and shall lodge under her branches.
text_marked: He shall set his children under her shelter, and shall lodge under her branches.

text: By her he shall be covered from heat, and in her glory shall he dwell.
text_marked: By her he shall be covered from heat, and in her glory shall he dwell.

text: He that feareth the Lord will do good, and he that hath the knowledge of the law shall obtain her.
text_marked: He that feareth the Lord will do good, and he that hath the knowledge of the law shall obtain her.

text: And as a mother shall she meet him, and receive him as a wife married of a virgin.
text_marked: And as a mother shall she meet him, and receive him as a wife married of a virgin.

text: With the bread of understanding shall she feed him, and give him the water of wisdom to drink.
text_marked: With the bread of understanding shall she feed him, and give him the water of wisdom to drink.

text: He shall be stayed upon her, and shall not be moved; and shall rely upon her, and shall not be confounded.
text_marked: He shall be stayed upon her, and shall not be moved; and shall rely upon her, and shall not be confounded.

text: She shall exalt him above his neighbours, and in the midst of the congregation shall she open his mouth.
text_marked: She shall exalt him above his neighbours, and in the midst of the congregation shall she open his mouth.

text: He shall find joy and a crown of gladness, and she shall cause him to inherit an everlasting name.
text_marked: He shall find joy and a crown of gladness, and she shall cause him to inherit an everlasting name.

text: But foolish men shall not attain unto her, and sinners shall not see her.
text_marked: But foolish men shall not attain unto her, and sinners shall not see her.

text: For she is far from pride, and men that are liars cannot remember her.
text_marked: For she is far from pride, and men that are liars cannot remember her.

text: Praise is not seemly in the mouth of a sinner, for it was not sent him of the Lord.
text_marked: Praise is not seemly in the mouth of a sinner, for it was not sent him of the Lord.

text: For praise shall be uttered in wisdom, and the Lord will prosper it.
text_marked: For praise shall be uttered in wisdom, and the Lord will prosper it.

text: Say not thou, It is through the Lord that I fell away: for thou oughtest not to do the things that he hateth.
text_marked: Say not thou, It is through the Lord that I fell away: for thou oughtest not to do the things that he hateth.

text: Say not thou, He hath caused me to err: for he hath no need of the sinful man.
text_marked: Say not thou, He hath caused me to err: for he hath no need of the sinful man.

text: The Lord hateth all abomination; and they that fear God love it not.
text_marked: The Lord hateth all abomination; and they that fear God love it not.

text: He himself made man from the beginning, and left him in the hand of his counsel;
text_marked: He himself made man from the beginning, and left him in the hand of his counsel;

text: If thou wilt, to keep the commandments, and to perform acceptable faithfulness.
text_marked: If thou wilt, to keep the commandments, and to perform acceptable faithfulness.

text: He hath set fire and water before thee: stretch forth thy hand unto whether thou wilt.
text_marked: He hath set fire and water before thee: stretch forth thy hand unto whether thou wilt.

text: Before man is life and death; and whether him liketh shall be given him.
text_marked: Before man is life and death; and whether him liketh shall be given him.

text: For the wisdom of the Lord is great, and he is mighty in power, and beholdeth all things:
text_marked: For the wisdom of the Lord is great, and he is mighty in power, and beholdeth all things:

text: And his eyes are upon them that fear him, and he knoweth every work of man.
text_marked: And his eyes are upon them that fear him, and he knoweth every work of man.

text: He hath commanded no man to do wickedly, neither hath he given any man licence to sin.
text_marked: He hath commanded no man to do wickedly, neither hath he given any man licence to sin.

text: Desire not a multitude of unprofitable children, neither delight in ungodly sons.
text_marked: Desire not a multitude of unprofitable children, neither delight in ungodly sons.

text: Though they multiply, rejoice not in them, except the fear of the Lord be with them.
text_marked: Though they multiply, rejoice not in them, except the fear of the Lord be with them.

text: Trust not thou in their life, neither respect their multitude: for one that is just is better than a thousand; and better it is to die without children, than to have them that are ungodly.
text_marked: Trust not thou in their life, neither respect their multitude: for one that is just is better than a thousand; and better it is to die without children, than to have them that are ungodly.

text: For by one that hath understanding shall the city be replenished: but the kindred of the wicked shall speedily become desolate.
text_marked: For by one that hath understanding shall the city be replenished: but the kindred of the wicked shall speedily become desolate.

text: Many such things have I seen with mine eyes, and mine ear hath heard greater things than these.
text_marked: Many such things have I seen with mine eyes, and mine ear hath heard greater things than these.

text: In the congregation of the ungodly shall a fire be kindled; and in a rebellious nation wrath is set on fire.
text_marked: In the congregation of the ungodly shall a fire be kindled; and in a rebellious nation wrath is set on fire.

text: He was not pacified toward the old giants, who fell away in the strength of their foolishness.
text_marked: He was not pacified toward the old giants, who fell away in the strength of their foolishness.

text: Neither spared he the place where Lot sojourned, but abhorred them for their pride.
text_marked: Neither spared he the place where Lot sojourned, but abhorred them for their pride.

text: He pitied not the people of perdition, who were taken away in their sins:
text_marked: He pitied not the people of perdition, who were taken away in their sins:

text: Nor the six hundred thousand footmen, who were gathered together in the hardness of their hearts.
text_marked: Nor the six hundred thousand footmen, who were gathered together in the hardness of their hearts.

text: And if there be one stiffnecked among the people, it is marvel if he escape unpunished: for mercy and wrath are with him; he is mighty to forgive, and to pour out displeasure.
text_marked: And if there be one stiffnecked among the people, it is marvel if he escape unpunished: for mercy and wrath are with him; he is mighty to forgive, and to pour out displeasure.

text: As his mercy is great, so is his correction also: he judgeth a man according to his works
text_marked: As his mercy is great, so is his correction also: he judgeth a man according to his works

text: The sinner shall not escape with his spoils: and the patience of the godly shall not be frustrate.
text_marked: The sinner shall not escape with his spoils: and the patience of the godly shall not be frustrate.

text: Make way for every work of mercy: for every man shall find according to his works.
text_marked: Make way for every work of mercy: for every man shall find according to his works.

text: The Lord hardened Pharaoh, that he should not know him, that his powerful works might be known to the world.
text_marked: The Lord hardened Pharaoh, that he should not know him, that his powerful works might be known to the world.

text: His mercy is manifest to every creature; and he hath separated his light from the darkness with an adamant.
text_marked: His mercy is manifest to every creature; and he hath separated his light from the darkness with an adamant.

text: Say not thou, I will hide myself from the Lord: shall any remember me from above? I shall not be remembered among so many people: for what is my soul among such an infinite number of creatures?
text_marked: Say not thou, I will hide myself from the Lord: shall any remember me from above? I shall not be remembered among so many people: for what is my soul among such an infinite number of creatures?

text: Behold, the heaven, and the heaven of heavens, the deep, and the earth, and all that therein is, shall be moved when he shall visit.
text_marked: Behold, the heaven, and the heaven of heavens, the deep, and the earth, and all that therein is, shall be moved when he shall visit.

text: The mountains also and foundations of the earth be shaken with trembling, when the Lord looketh upon them.
text_marked: The mountains also and foundations of the earth be shaken with trembling, when the Lord looketh upon them.

text: No heart can think upon these things worthily: and who is able to conceive his ways?
text_marked: No heart can think upon these things worthily: and who is able to conceive his ways?

text: It is a tempest which no man can see: for the most part of his works are hid.
text_marked: It is a tempest which no man can see: for the most part of his works are hid.

text: Who can declare the works of his justice? or who can endure them? for his covenant is afar off, and the trial of all things is in the end.
text_marked: Who can declare the works of his justice? or who can endure them? for his covenant is afar off, and the trial of all things is in the end.

text: He that wanteth understanding will think upon vain things: and a foolish man erring imagineth follies.
text_marked: He that wanteth understanding will think upon vain things: and a foolish man erring imagineth follies.

text: My son, hearken unto me, and learn knowledge, and mark my words with thy heart.
text_marked: My son, hearken unto me, and learn knowledge, and mark my words with thy heart.

text: I will shew forth doctrine in weight, and declare his knowledge exactly.
text_marked: I will shew forth doctrine in weight, and declare his knowledge exactly.

text: The works of the Lord are done in judgment from the beginning: and from the time he made them he disposed the parts thereof.
text_marked: The works of the Lord are done in judgment from the beginning: and from the time he made them he disposed the parts thereof.

text: He garnished his works for ever, and in his hand are the chief of them unto all generations: they neither labour, nor are weary, nor cease from their works.
text_marked: He garnished his works for ever, and in his hand are the chief of them unto all generations: they neither labour, nor are weary, nor cease from their works.

text: None of them hindereth another, and they shall never disobey his word.
text_marked: None of them hindereth another, and they shall never disobey his word.

text: After this the Lord looked upon the earth, and filled it with his blessings.
