text: Who cast him into the lions’ den: where he was six days.
text_marked: Who cast him into the lions’ den: where he was six days.

text: And in the den there were seven lions, and they had given them every day two carcases, and two sheep: which then were not given to them, to the intent they might devour Daniel.
text_marked: And in the den there were seven lions, and they had given them every day two carcases, and two sheep: which then were not given to them, to the intent they might devour Daniel.

text: Now there was in Jewry a prophet, called Habbacuc, who had made pottage, and had broken bread in a bowl, and was going into the field, for to bring it to the reapers.
text_marked: Now there was in Jewry a prophet, called Habbacuc, who had made pottage, and had broken bread in a bowl, and was going into the field, for to bring it to the reapers.

text: But the angel of the Lord said unto Habbacuc, Go, carry the dinner that thou hast into Babylon unto Daniel, who is in the lions’ den.
text_marked: But the angel of the Lord said unto Habbacuc, Go, carry the dinner that thou hast into Babylon unto Daniel, who is in the lions’ den.

text: And Habbacuc said, Lord, I never saw Babylon; neither do I know where the den is.
text_marked: And Habbacuc said, Lord, I never saw Babylon; neither do I know where the den is.

text: Then the angel of the Lord took him by the crown, and bare him by the hair of his head, and through the vehemency of his spirit set him in Babylon over the den.
text_marked: Then the angel of the Lord took him by the crown, and bare him by the hair of his head, and through the vehemency of his spirit set him in Babylon over the den.

text: And Habbacuc cried, saying, O Daniel, Daniel, take the dinner which God hath sent thee.
text_marked: And Habbacuc cried, saying, O Daniel, Daniel, take the dinner which God hath sent thee.

text: And Daniel said, Thou hast remembered me, O God: neither hast thou forsaken them that seek thee and love thee.
text_marked: And Daniel said, Thou hast remembered me, O God: neither hast thou forsaken them that seek thee and love thee.

text: So Daniel arose, and did eat: and the angel of the Lord set Habbacuc in his own place again immediately.
text_marked: So Daniel arose, and did eat: and the angel of the Lord set Habbacuc in his own place again immediately.

text: Upon the seventh day the king went to bewail Daniel: and when he came to the den, he looked in, and behold, Daniel was sitting.
text_marked: Upon the seventh day the king went to bewail Daniel: and when he came to the den, he looked in, and behold, Daniel was sitting.

text: Then cried the king with a loud voice, saying, Great art thou, O Lord God of Daniel, and there is none other beside thee.
text_marked: Then cried the king with a loud voice, saying, Great art thou, O Lord God of Daniel, and there is none other beside thee.

text: And he drew him out, and cast those that were the cause of his destruction into the den: and they were devoured in a moment before his face.
text_marked: And he drew him out, and cast those that were the cause of his destruction into the den: and they were devoured in a moment before his face.

text: And it happened, after that Alexander son of Philip, the Macedonian, who came out of the land of Chettiim, had smitten Darius king of the Persians and Medes, that he reigned in his stead, the first over Greece,
text_marked: And it happened, after that Alexander son of Philip, the Macedonian, who came out of the land of Chettiim, had smitten Darius king of the Persians and Medes, that he reigned in his stead, the first over Greece,

text: And made many wars, and won many strong holds, and slew the kings of the earth,
text_marked: And made many wars, and won many strong holds, and slew the kings of the earth,

text: And went through to the ends of the earth, and took spoils of many nations, insomuch that the earth was quiet before him; whereupon he was exalted and his heart was lifted up.
text_marked: And went through to the ends of the earth, and took spoils of many nations, insomuch that the earth was quiet before him; whereupon he was exalted and his heart was lifted up.

text: And he gathered a mighty strong host and ruled over countries, and nations, and kings, who became tributaries unto him.
text_marked: And he gathered a mighty strong host and ruled over countries, and nations, and kings, who became tributaries unto him.

text: And after these things he fell sick, and perceived that he should die.
text_marked: And after these things he fell sick, and perceived that he should die.

text: Wherefore he called his servants, such as were honourable, and had been brought up with him from his youth, and parted his kingdom among them, while he was yet alive.
text_marked: Wherefore he called his servants, such as were honourable, and had been brought up with him from his youth, and parted his kingdom among them, while he was yet alive.

text: So Alexander reigned twelve years, and then died.
text_marked: So Alexander reigned twelve years, and then died.

text: And his servants bare rule every one in his place.
text_marked: And his servants bare rule every one in his place.

text: And after his death they all put crowns upon themselves; so did their sons after them many years: and evils were multiplied in the earth.
text_marked: And after his death they all put crowns upon themselves; so did their sons after them many years: and evils were multiplied in the earth.

text: And there came out of them a wicked root Antiochus surnamed Epiphanes, son of Antiochus the king, who had been an hostage at Rome, and he reigned in the hundred and thirty and seventh year of the kingdom of the Greeks.
text_marked: And there came out of them a wicked root Antiochus surnamed Epiphanes, son of Antiochus the king, who had been an hostage at Rome, and he reigned in the hundred and thirty and seventh year of the kingdom of the Greeks.

text: In those days went there out of Israel wicked men, who persuaded many, saying, Let us go and make a covenant with the heathen that are round about us: for since we departed from them we have had much sorrow.
text_marked: In those days went there out of Israel wicked men, who persuaded many, saying, Let us go and make a covenant with the heathen that are round about us: for since we departed from them we have had much sorrow.

text: So this device pleased them well.
text_marked: So this device pleased them well.

text: Then certain of the people were so forward herein, that they went to the king, who gave them licence to do after the ordinances of the heathen:
text_marked: Then certain of the people were so forward herein, that they went to the king, who gave them licence to do after the ordinances of the heathen:

text: Whereupon they built a place of exercise at Jerusalem according to the customs of the heathen:
text_marked: Whereupon they built a place of exercise at Jerusalem according to the customs of the heathen:

text: And made themselves uncircumcised, and forsook the holy covenant, and joined themselves to the heathen, and were sold to do mischief.
text_marked: And made themselves uncircumcised, and forsook the holy covenant, and joined themselves to the heathen, and were sold to do mischief.

text: Now when the kingdom was established before Antiochus, he thought to reign over Egypt that he might have the dominion of two realms.
text_marked: Now when the kingdom was established before Antiochus, he thought to reign over Egypt that he might have the dominion of two realms.

text: Wherefore he entered into Egypt with a great multitude, with chariots, and elephants, and horsemen, and a great navy,
text_marked: Wherefore he entered into Egypt with a great multitude, with chariots, and elephants, and horsemen, and a great navy,

text: And made war against Ptolemee king of Egypt: but Ptolemee was afraid of him, and fled; and many were wounded to death.
text_marked: And made war against Ptolemee king of Egypt: but Ptolemee was afraid of him, and fled; and many were wounded to death.

text: Thus they got the strong cities in the land of Egypt and he took the spoils thereof.
text_marked: Thus they got the strong cities in the land of Egypt and he took the spoils thereof.

text: And after that Antiochus had smitten Egypt, he returned again in the hundred forty and third year, and went up against Israel and Jerusalem with a great multitude,
text_marked: And after that Antiochus had smitten Egypt, he returned again in the hundred forty and third year, and went up against Israel and Jerusalem with a great multitude,

text: And entered proudly into the sanctuary, and took away the golden altar, and the candlestick of light, and all the vessels thereof,
text_marked: And entered proudly into the sanctuary, and took away the golden altar, and the candlestick of light, and all the vessels thereof,

text: And the table of the shewbread, and the pouring vessels, and the vials. and the censers of gold, and the veil, and the crown, and the golden ornaments that were before the temple, all which he pulled off.
text_marked: And the table of the shewbread, and the pouring vessels, and the vials. and the censers of gold, and the veil, and the crown, and the golden ornaments that were before the temple, all which he pulled off.

text: He took also the silver and the gold, and the precious vessels: also he took the hidden treasures which he found.
text_marked: He took also the silver and the gold, and the precious vessels: also he took the hidden treasures which he found.

text: And when he had taken all away, he went into his own land, having made a great massacre, and spoken very proudly.
text_marked: And when he had taken all away, he went into his own land, having made a great massacre, and spoken very proudly.

text: Therefore there was a great mourning in Israel, in every place where they were;
text_marked: Therefore there was a great mourning in Israel, in every place where they were;

text: So that the princes and elders mourned, the virgins and young men were made feeble, and the beauty of women was changed.
text_marked: So that the princes and elders mourned, the virgins and young men were made feeble, and the beauty of women was changed.

text: Every bridegroom took up lamentation, and she that sat in the marriage chamber was in heaviness,
text_marked: Every bridegroom took up lamentation, and she that sat in the marriage chamber was in heaviness,

text: The land also was moved for the inhabitants thereof, and all the house of Jacob was covered with confusion.
text_marked: The land also was moved for the inhabitants thereof, and all the house of Jacob was covered with confusion.

text: And after two years fully expired the king sent his chief collector of tribute unto the cities of Juda, who came unto Jerusalem with a great multitude,
text_marked: And after two years fully expired the king sent his chief collector of tribute unto the cities of Juda, who came unto Jerusalem with a great multitude,

text: And spake peaceable words unto them, but all was deceit: for when they had given him credence, he fell suddenly upon the city, and smote it very sore, and destroyed much people of Israel.
text_marked: And spake peaceable words unto them, but all was deceit: for when they had given him credence, he fell suddenly upon the city, and smote it very sore, and destroyed much people of Israel.

text: And when he had taken the spoils of the city, he set it on fire, and pulled down the houses and walls thereof on every side.
text_marked: And when he had taken the spoils of the city, he set it on fire, and pulled down the houses and walls thereof on every side.

text: But the women and children took they captive, and possessed the cattle.
text_marked: But the women and children took they captive, and possessed the cattle.

text: Then builded they the city of David with a great and strong wall, and with mighty towers, and made it a strong hold for them.
text_marked: Then builded they the city of David with a great and strong wall, and with mighty towers, and made it a strong hold for them.

text: And they put therein a sinful nation, wicked men, and fortified themselves therein.
text_marked: And they put therein a sinful nation, wicked men, and fortified themselves therein.

text: They stored it also with armour and victuals, and when they had gathered together the spoils of Jerusalem, they laid them up there, and so they became a sore snare:
text_marked: They stored it also with armour and victuals, and when they had gathered together the spoils of Jerusalem, they laid them up there, and so they became a sore snare:

text: For it was a place to lie in wait against the sanctuary, and an evil adversary to Israel.
text_marked: For it was a place to lie in wait against the sanctuary, and an evil adversary to Israel.

text: Thus they shed innocent blood on every side of the sanctuary, and defiled it:
text_marked: Thus they shed innocent blood on every side of the sanctuary, and defiled it:

text: Insomuch that the inhabitants of Jerusalem fled because of them: whereupon the city was made an habitation of strangers, and became strange to those that were born in her; and her own children left her.
text_marked: Insomuch that the inhabitants of Jerusalem fled because of them: whereupon the city was made an habitation of strangers, and became strange to those that were born in her; and her own children left her.

text: Her sanctuary was laid waste like a wilderness, her feasts were turned into mourning, her sabbaths into reproach her honour into contempt.
text_marked: Her sanctuary was laid waste like a wilderness, her feasts were turned into mourning, her sabbaths into reproach her honour into contempt.

text: As had been her glory, so was her dishonour increased, and her excellency was turned into mourning.
text_marked: As had been her glory, so was her dishonour increased, and her excellency was turned into mourning.

text: Moreover king Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom, that all should be one people,
text_marked: Moreover king Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom, that all should be one people,

text: And every one should leave his laws: so all the heathen agreed according to the commandment of the king.
text_marked: And every one should leave his laws: so all the heathen agreed according to the commandment of the king.

text: Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion, and sacrificed unto idols, and profaned the sabbath.
text_marked: Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion, and sacrificed unto idols, and profaned the sabbath.

text: For the king had sent letters by messengers unto Jerusalem and the cities of Juda that they should follow the strange laws of the land,
text_marked: For the king had sent letters by messengers unto Jerusalem and the cities of Juda that they should follow the strange laws of the land,

text: And forbid burnt offerings, and sacrifice, and drink offerings, in the temple; and that they should profane the sabbaths and festival days:
text_marked: And forbid burnt offerings, and sacrifice, and drink offerings, in the temple; and that they should profane the sabbaths and festival days:

text: And pollute the sanctuary and holy people:
text_marked: And pollute the sanctuary and holy people:

text: Set up altars, and groves, and chapels of idols, and sacrifice swine’s flesh, and unclean beasts:
text_marked: Set up altars, and groves, and chapels of idols, and sacrifice swine’s flesh, and unclean beasts:

text: That they should also leave their children uncircumcised, and make their souls abominable with all manner of uncleanness and profanation:
text_marked: That they should also leave their children uncircumcised, and make their souls abominable with all manner of uncleanness and profanation:

text: To the end they might forget the law, and change all the ordinances.

text: And whosoever would not do according to the commandment of the king, he said, he should die.
text_marked: And whosoever would not do according to the commandment of the king, he said, he should die.

text: In the selfsame manner wrote he to his whole kingdom, and appointed overseers over all the people, commanding the cities of Juda to sacrifice, city by city.

text: Then many of the people were gathered unto them, to wit every one that forsook the law; and so they committed evils in the land;
text_marked: Then many of the people were gathered unto them, to wit every one that forsook the law; and so they committed evils in the land;

text_marked: And drove the Israelites into secret places, even wheresoever they could flee for succour.

text_marked: Now the fifteenth day of the month Casleu, in the hundred forty and fifth year, they set up the abomination of desolation upon the altar, and builded idol altars throughout the cities of Juda on every side;

text: And burnt incense at the doors of their houses, and in the streets.

text: And whosoever was found with any the book of the testament, or if any committed to the law, the king’s commandment was, that they should put him to death.
text_marked: And whosoever was found with any the book of the testament, or if any committed to the law, the king’s commandment was, that they should put him to death.

text_marked: In those days arose Mattathias the son of John, the son of Simeon, a priest of the sons of Joarib, from Jerusalem, and dwelt in Modin.

text: And when he saw the blasphemies that were committed in Juda and Jerusalem,
text_marked: And when he saw the blasphemies that were committed in Juda and Jerusalem,

text: He said, Woe is me! wherefore was I born to see this misery of my people, and of the holy city, and to dwell there, when it was delivered into the hand of the enemy, and the sanctuary into the hand of strangers?
text_marked: He said, Woe is me! wherefore was I born to see this misery of my people, and of the holy city, and to dwell there, when it was delivered into the hand of the enemy, and the sanctuary into the hand of strangers?

text_marked: Her temple is become as a man without glory.

text: Her glorious vessels are carried away into captivity, her infants are slain in the streets, her young men with the sword of the enemy.
text_marked: Her glorious vessels are carried away into captivity, her infants are slain in the streets, her young men with the sword of the enemy.

text: What nation hath not had a part in her kingdom and gotten of her spoils?

text: To what end therefore shall we live any longer?

text_marked: Then Mattathias and his sons rent their clothes, and put on sackcloth, and mourned very sore.

text: In the mean while the king’s officers, such as compelled the people to revolt, came into the city Modin, to make them sacrifice.

text: Then answered the king’s officers, and said to Mattathias on this wise, Thou art a ruler, and an honourable and great man in this city, and strengthened with sons and brethren:
text_marked: Then answered the king’s officers, and said to Mattathias on this wise, Thou art a ruler, and an honourable and great man in this city, and strengthened with sons and brethren:

text: Now therefore come thou first, and fulfil the king’s commandment, like as all the heathen have done, yea, and the men of Juda also, and such as remain at Jerusalem: so shalt thou and thy house be in the number of the king’s friends, and thou and thy children shall be honoured with silver and gold, and many rewards.
text_marked: Now therefore come thou first, and fulfil the king’s commandment, like as all the heathen have done, yea, and the men of Juda also, and such as remain at Jerusalem: so shalt thou and thy house be in the number of the king’s friends, and thou and thy children shall be honoured with silver and gold, and many rewards.

text: Then Mattathias answered and spake with a loud voice, Though all the nations that are under the king’s dominion obey him, and fall away every one from the religion of their fathers, and give consent to his commandments:

text: God forbid that we should forsake the law and the ordinances.

text: Now when he had left speaking these words, there came one of the Jews in the sight of all to sacrifice on the altar which was at Modin, according to the king’s commandment.

text_marked: And Mattathias cried throughout the city with a loud voice, saying, Whosoever is zealous of the law, and maintaineth the covenant, let him follow me.

text: Both they, and their children, and their wives; and their cattle; because afflictions increased sore upon them.

text_marked: And they said unto them, Let that which ye have done hitherto suffice; come forth, and do according to the commandment of the king, and ye shall live.

text_marked: So they rose up against them in battle on the sabbath, and they slew them, with their wives and children and their cattle, to the number of a thousand people.

text: And one of them said to another, If we all do as our brethren have done, and fight not for our lives and laws against the heathen, they will now quickly root us out of the earth.
text_marked: And one of them said to another, If we all do as our brethren have done, and fight not for our lives and laws against the heathen, they will now quickly root us out of the earth.

text_marked: Now therefore, my sons, be ye zealous for the law, and give your lives for the covenant of your fathers.

text: And thus consider ye throughout all ages, that none that put their trust in him shall be overcome.

text: To day he shall be lifted up and to morrow he shall not be found, because he is returned into his dust, and his thought is come to nothing.
text_marked: To day he shall be lifted up and to morrow he shall not be found, because he is returned into his dust, and his thought is come to nothing.

text: Wherefore, ye my sons, be valiant and shew yourselves men in the behalf of the law; for by it shall ye obtain glory.
text_marked: Wherefore, ye my sons, be valiant and shew yourselves men in the behalf of the law; for by it shall ye obtain glory.

text: And behold, I know that your brother Simon is a man of counsel, give ear unto him alway: he shall be a father unto you.
text_marked: And behold, I know that your brother Simon is a man of counsel, give ear unto him alway: he shall be a father unto you.

text: As for Judas Maccabeus, he hath been mighty and strong, even from his youth up: let him be your captain, and fight the battle of the people.
text_marked: As for Judas Maccabeus, he hath been mighty and strong, even from his youth up: let him be your captain, and fight the battle of the people.

text: Take also unto you all those that observe the law, and avenge ye the wrong of your people.
text_marked: Take also unto you all those that observe the law, and avenge ye the wrong of your people.

text: So he gat his people great honour, and put on a breastplate as a giant, and girt his warlike harness about him, and he made battles, protecting the host with his sword.
text_marked: So he gat his people great honour, and put on a breastplate as a giant, and girt his warlike harness about him, and he made battles, protecting the host with his sword.

text: Moreover he went through the cities of Juda, destroying the ungodly out of them, and turning away wrath from Israel:

text: Which thing when Judas perceived, he went forth to meet him, and so he smote him, and slew him: many also fell down slain, but the rest fled.
text_marked: Which thing when Judas perceived, he went forth to meet him, and so he smote him, and slew him: many also fell down slain, but the rest fled.

text: Wherefore Judas took their spoils, and Apollonius’ sword also, and therewith he fought all his life long.
text_marked: Wherefore Judas took their spoils, and Apollonius’ sword also, and therewith he fought all his life long.

text: Now when Seron, a prince of the army of Syria, heard say that Judas had gathered unto him a multitude and company of the faithful to go out with him to war;
text_marked: Now when Seron, a prince of the army of Syria, heard say that Judas had gathered unto him a multitude and company of the faithful to go out with him to war;

text: He said, I will get me a name and honour in the kingdom; for I will go fight with Judas and them that are with him, who despise the king’s commandment.
text_marked: He said, I will get me a name and honour in the kingdom; for I will go fight with Judas and them that are with him, who despise the king’s commandment.

text: So he made him ready to go up, and there went with him a mighty host of the ungodly to help him, and to be avenged of the children of Israel.
text_marked: So he made him ready to go up, and there went with him a mighty host of the ungodly to help him, and to be avenged of the children of Israel.

text: And when he came near to the going up of Bethhoron, Judas went forth to meet him with a small company:
text_marked: And when he came near to the going up of Bethhoron, Judas went forth to meet him with a small company:

text: Who, when they saw the host coming to meet them, said unto Judas, How shall we be able, being so few, to fight against so great a multitude and so strong, seeing we are ready to faint with fasting all this day?
text_marked: Who, when they saw the host coming to meet them, said unto Judas, How shall we be able, being so few, to fight against so great a multitude and so strong, seeing we are ready to faint with fasting all this day?

text: Unto whom Judas answered, It is no hard matter for many to be shut up in the hands of a few; and with the God of heaven it is all one, to deliver with a great multitude, or a small company:

text: For the victory of battle standeth not in the multitude of an host; but strength cometh from heaven.

text: They come against us in much pride and iniquity to destroy us, and our wives and children, and to spoil us:

text: Wherefore the Lord himself will overthrow them before our face: and as for you, be ye not afraid of them.

text: Now as soon as he had left off speaking, he leapt suddenly upon them, and so Seron and his host was overthrown before him.
text_marked: Now as soon as he had left off speaking, he leapt suddenly upon them, and so Seron and his host was overthrown before him.

text: And they pursued them from the going down of Bethhoron unto the plain, where were slain about eight hundred men of them; and the residue fled into the land of the Philistines.
text_marked: And they pursued them from the going down of Bethhoron unto the plain, where were slain about eight hundred men of them; and the residue fled into the land of the Philistines.

text: Then began the fear of Judas and his brethren, and an exceeding great dread, to fall upon the nations round about them:

text: Now when king Antiochus heard these things, he was full of indignation: wherefore he sent and gathered together all the forces of his realm, even a very strong army.
text_marked: Now when king Antiochus heard these things, he was full of indignation: wherefore he sent and gathered together all the forces of his realm, even a very strong army.

text: He opened also his treasure, and gave his soldiers pay for a year, commanding them to be ready whensoever he should need them.
text_marked: He opened also his treasure, and gave his soldiers pay for a year, commanding them to be ready whensoever he should need them.

text: Nevertheless, when he saw that the money of his treasures failed and that the tributes in the country were small, because of the dissension and plague, which he had brought upon the land in taking away the laws which had been of old time;

text_marked: He feared that he should not be able to bear the charges any longer, nor to have such gifts to give so liberally as he did before: for he had abounded above the kings that were before him.
