text: So I answered and said, Couldest thou not make those that have been made, and be now, and that are for to come, at once; that thou mightest shew thy judgment the sooner?
text_marked: So I answered and said, Couldest thou not make those that have been made, and be now, and that are for to come, at once; that thou mightest shew thy judgment the sooner?

text: Then answered he me, and said, The creature may not haste above the maker; neither may the world hold them at once that shall be created therein.
text_marked: Then answered he me, and said, The creature may not haste above the maker; neither may the world hold them at once that shall be created therein.

text: And I said, As thou hast said unto thy servant, that thou, which givest life to all, hast given life at once to the creature that thou hast created, and the creature bare it: even so it might now also bear them that now be present at once.
text_marked: And I said, As thou hast said unto thy servant, that thou, which givest life to all, hast given life at once to the creature that thou hast created, and the creature bare it: even so it might now also bear them that now be present at once.

text: And he said unto me, Ask the womb of a woman, and say unto her, If thou bringest forth children, why dost thou it not together, but one after another? pray her therefore to bring forth ten children at once.
text_marked: And he said unto me, Ask the womb of a woman, and say unto her, If thou bringest forth children, why dost thou it not together, but one after another? pray her therefore to bring forth ten children at once.

text: And I said, She cannot: but must do it by distance of time.
text_marked: And I said, She cannot: but must do it by distance of time.

text: Then said he unto me, Even so have I given the womb of the earth to those that be sown in it in their times.
text_marked: Then said he unto me, Even so have I given the womb of the earth to those that be sown in it in their times.

text: For like as a young child may not bring forth the things that belong to the aged, even so have I disposed the world which I created.
text_marked: For like as a young child may not bring forth the things that belong to the aged, even so have I disposed the world which I created.

text: And I asked, and said, Seeing thou hast now given me the way, I will proceed to speak before thee: for our mother, of whom thou hast told me that she is young, draweth now nigh unto age.
text_marked: And I asked, and said, Seeing thou hast now given me the way, I will proceed to speak before thee: for our mother, of whom thou hast told me that she is young, draweth now nigh unto age.

text: He answered me, and said, Ask a woman that beareth children, and she shall tell thee.
text_marked: He answered me, and said, Ask a woman that beareth children, and she shall tell thee.

text: Say unto her, Wherefore are unto they whom thou hast now brought forth like those that were before, but less of stature?
text_marked: Say unto her, Wherefore are unto they whom thou hast now brought forth like those that were before, but less of stature?

text: And she shall answer thee, They that be born in the strength of youth are of one fashion, and they that are born in the time of age, when the womb faileth, are otherwise.
text_marked: And she shall answer thee, They that be born in the strength of youth are of one fashion, and they that are born in the time of age, when the womb faileth, are otherwise.

text: Consider thou therefore also, how that ye are less of stature than those that were before you.
text_marked: Consider thou therefore also, how that ye are less of stature than those that were before you.

text: And so are they that come after you less than ye, as the creatures which now begin to be old, and have passed over the strength of youth.
text_marked: And so are they that come after you less than ye, as the creatures which now begin to be old, and have passed over the strength of youth.

text: Then said I, Lord, I beseech thee, if I have found favour in thy sight, shew thy servant by whom thou visitest thy creature.
text_marked: Then said I, Lord, I beseech thee, if I have found favour in thy sight, shew thy servant by whom thou visitest thy creature.

text: And he said unto me, In the beginning, when the earth was made, before the borders of the world stood, or ever the winds blew,
text_marked: And he said unto me, In the beginning, when the earth was made, before the borders of the world stood, or ever the winds blew,

text: Before it thundered and lightened, or ever the foundations of paradise were laid,
text_marked: Before it thundered and lightened, or ever the foundations of paradise were laid,

text: Before the fair flowers were seen, or ever the moveable powers were established, before the innumerable multitude of angels were gathered together,
text_marked: Before the fair flowers were seen, or ever the moveable powers were established, before the innumerable multitude of angels were gathered together,

text: Or ever the heights of the air were lifted up, before the measures of the firmament were named, or ever the chimneys in Sion were hot,
text_marked: Or ever the heights of the air were lifted up, before the measures of the firmament were named, or ever the chimneys in Sion were hot,

text: And ere the present years were sought out, and or ever the inventions of them that now sin were turned, before they were sealed that have gathered faith for a treasure:
text_marked: And ere the present years were sought out, and or ever the inventions of them that now sin were turned, before they were sealed that have gathered faith for a treasure:

text: Then did I consider these things, and they all were made through me alone, and through none other: by me also they shall be ended, and by none other.
text_marked: Then did I consider these things, and they all were made through me alone, and through none other: by me also they shall be ended, and by none other.

text: Then answered I and said, What shall be the parting asunder of the times? or when shall be the end of the first, and the beginning of it that followeth?
text_marked: Then answered I and said, What shall be the parting asunder of the times? or when shall be the end of the first, and the beginning of it that followeth?

text: And he said unto me, From Abraham unto Isaac, when Jacob and Esau were born of him, Jacob’s hand held first the heel of Esau.
text_marked: And he said unto me, From Abraham unto Isaac, when Jacob and Esau were born of him, Jacob’s hand held first the heel of Esau.

text: For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth.
text_marked: For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth.

text: The hand of man is betwixt the heel and the hand: other question, Esdras, ask thou not.
text_marked: The hand of man is betwixt the heel and the hand: other question, Esdras, ask thou not.

text: I answered then and said, O Lord that bearest rule, if I have found favour in thy sight,
text_marked: I answered then and said, O Lord that bearest rule, if I have found favour in thy sight,

text: I beseech thee, shew thy servant the end of thy tokens, whereof thou shewedst me part the last night.
text_marked: I beseech thee, shew thy servant the end of thy tokens, whereof thou shewedst me part the last night.

text: So he answered and said unto me, Stand up upon thy feet, and hear a mighty sounding voice.
text_marked: So he answered and said unto me, Stand up upon thy feet, and hear a mighty sounding voice.

text: And it shall be as it were a great motion; but the place where thou standest shall not be moved.
text_marked: And it shall be as it were a great motion; but the place where thou standest shall not be moved.

text: And therefore when it speaketh be not afraid: for the word is of the end, and the foundation of the earth is understood.
text_marked: And therefore when it speaketh be not afraid: for the word is of the end, and the foundation of the earth is understood.

text: And why? because the speech of these things trembleth and is moved: for it knoweth that the end of these things must be changed.
text_marked: And why? because the speech of these things trembleth and is moved: for it knoweth that the end of these things must be changed.

text: And it happened, that when I had heard it I stood up upon my feet, and hearkened, and, behold, there was a voice that spake, and the sound of it was like the sound of many waters.
text_marked: And it happened, that when I had heard it I stood up upon my feet, and hearkened, and, behold, there was a voice that spake, and the sound of it was like the sound of many waters.

text: And it said, Behold, the days come, that I will begin to draw nigh, and to visit them that dwell upon the earth,
text_marked: And it said, Behold, the days come, that I will begin to draw nigh, and to visit them that dwell upon the earth,

text: And will begin to make inquisition of them, what they be that have hurt unjustly with their unrighteousness, and when the affliction of Sion shall be fulfilled;
text_marked: And will begin to make inquisition of them, what they be that have hurt unjustly with their unrighteousness, and when the affliction of Sion shall be fulfilled;

text: And when the world, that shall begin to vanish away, shall be finished, then will I shew these tokens: the books shall be opened before the firmament, and they shall see all together:
text_marked: And when the world, that shall begin to vanish away, shall be finished, then will I shew these tokens: the books shall be opened before the firmament, and they shall see all together:

text: And the children of a year old shall speak with their voices, the women with child shall bring forth untimely children of three or four months old, and they shall live, and be raised up.
text_marked: And the children of a year old shall speak with their voices, the women with child shall bring forth untimely children of three or four months old, and they shall live, and be raised up.

text: And suddenly shall the sown places appear unsown, the full storehouses shall suddenly be found empty:
text_marked: And suddenly shall the sown places appear unsown, the full storehouses shall suddenly be found empty:

text: And the trumpet shall give a sound, which when every man heareth, they shall be suddenly afraid.
text_marked: And the trumpet shall give a sound, which when every man heareth, they shall be suddenly afraid.

text: At that time shall friends fight one against another like enemies, and the earth shall stand in fear with those that dwell therein, the springs of the fountains shall stand still, and in three hours they shall not run.
text_marked: At that time shall friends fight one against another like enemies, and the earth shall stand in fear with those that dwell therein, the springs of the fountains shall stand still, and in three hours they shall not run.

text: Whosoever remaineth from all these that I have told thee shall escape, and see my salvation, and the end of your world.
text_marked: Whosoever remaineth from all these that I have told thee shall escape, and see my salvation, and the end of your world.

text: And the men that are received shall see it, who have not tasted death from their birth: and the heart of the inhabitants shall be changed, and turned into another meaning.
text_marked: And the men that are received shall see it, who have not tasted death from their birth: and the heart of the inhabitants shall be changed, and turned into another meaning.

text: For evil shall be put out, and deceit shall be quenched.
text_marked: For evil shall be put out, and deceit shall be quenched.

text: As for faith, it shall flourish, corruption shall be overcome, and the truth, which hath been so long without fruit, shall be declared.
text_marked: As for faith, it shall flourish, corruption shall be overcome, and the truth, which hath been so long without fruit, shall be declared.

text: And when he talked with me, behold, I looked by little and little upon him before whom I stood.
text_marked: And when he talked with me, behold, I looked by little and little upon him before whom I stood.

text: And these words said he unto me; I am come to shew thee the time of the night to come.
text_marked: And these words said he unto me; I am come to shew thee the time of the night to come.

text: If thou wilt pray yet more, and fast seven days again, I shall tell thee greater things by day than I have heard.
text_marked: If thou wilt pray yet more, and fast seven days again, I shall tell thee greater things by day than I have heard.

text: For thy voice is heard before the most High: for the Mighty hath seen thy righteous dealing, he hath seen also thy chastity, which thou hast had ever since thy youth.
text_marked: For thy voice is heard before the most High: for the Mighty hath seen thy righteous dealing, he hath seen also thy chastity, which thou hast had ever since thy youth.

text: And therefore hath he sent me to shew thee all these things, and to say unto thee, Be of good comfort and fear not
text_marked: And therefore hath he sent me to shew thee all these things, and to say unto thee, Be of good comfort and fear not

text: And hasten not with the times that are past, to think vain things, that thou mayest not hasten from the latter times.
text_marked: And hasten not with the times that are past, to think vain things, that thou mayest not hasten from the latter times.

text: And it came to pass after this, that I wept again, and fasted seven days in like manner, that I might fulfil the three weeks which he told me.
text_marked: And it came to pass after this, that I wept again, and fasted seven days in like manner, that I might fulfil the three weeks which he told me.

text: And in the eighth night was my heart vexed within me again, and I began to speak before the most High.
text_marked: And in the eighth night was my heart vexed within me again, and I began to speak before the most High.

text: For my spirit was greatly set on fire, and my soul was in distress.
text_marked: For my spirit was greatly set on fire, and my soul was in distress.

text: And I said, O Lord, thou spakest from the beginning of the creation, even the first day, and saidst thus; Let heaven and earth be made; and thy word was a perfect work.
text_marked: And I said, O Lord, thou spakest from the beginning of the creation, even the first day, and saidst thus; Let heaven and earth be made; and thy word was a perfect work.

text: And then was the spirit, and darkness and silence were on every side; the sound of man’s voice was not yet formed.
text_marked: And then was the spirit, and darkness and silence were on every side; the sound of man’s voice was not yet formed.

text: Then commandedst thou a fair light to come forth of thy treasures, that thy work might appear.
text_marked: Then commandedst thou a fair light to come forth of thy treasures, that thy work might appear.

text: Upon the second day thou madest the spirit of the firmament, and commandedst it to part asunder, and to make a division betwixt the waters, that the one part might go up, and the other remain beneath.
text_marked: Upon the second day thou madest the spirit of the firmament, and commandedst it to part asunder, and to make a division betwixt the waters, that the one part might go up, and the other remain beneath.

text: Upon the third day thou didst command that the waters should be gathered in the seventh part of the earth: six parts hast thou dried up, and kept them, to the intent that of these some being planted of God and tilled might serve thee.
text_marked: Upon the third day thou didst command that the waters should be gathered in the seventh part of the earth: six parts hast thou dried up, and kept them, to the intent that of these some being planted of God and tilled might serve thee.

text: For as soon as thy word went forth the work was made.
text_marked: For as soon as thy word went forth the work was made.

text: For immediately there was great and innumerable fruit, and many and divers pleasures for the taste, and flowers of unchangeable colour, and odours of wonderful smell: and this was done the third day.
text_marked: For immediately there was great and innumerable fruit, and many and divers pleasures for the taste, and flowers of unchangeable colour, and odours of wonderful smell: and this was done the third day.

text: Upon the fourth day thou commandedst that the sun should shine, and the moon give her light, and the stars should be in order:
text_marked: Upon the fourth day thou commandedst that the sun should shine, and the moon give her light, and the stars should be in order:

text: And gavest them a charge to do service unto man, that was to be made.
text_marked: And gavest them a charge to do service unto man, that was to be made.

text: Upon the fifth day thou saidst unto the seventh part, where the waters were gathered that it should bring forth living creatures, fowls and fishes: and so it came to pass.
text_marked: Upon the fifth day thou saidst unto the seventh part, where the waters were gathered that it should bring forth living creatures, fowls and fishes: and so it came to pass.

text: For the dumb water and without life brought forth living things at the commandment of God, that all people might praise thy wondrous works.
text_marked: For the dumb water and without life brought forth living things at the commandment of God, that all people might praise thy wondrous works.

text: Then didst thou ordain two living creatures, the one thou calledst Enoch, and the other Leviathan;
text_marked: Then didst thou ordain two living creatures, the one thou calledst Enoch, and the other Leviathan;

text: And didst separate the one from the other: for the seventh part, namely, where the water was gathered together, might not hold them both.
text_marked: And didst separate the one from the other: for the seventh part, namely, where the water was gathered together, might not hold them both.

text: Unto Enoch thou gavest one part, which was dried up the third day, that he should dwell in the same part, wherein are a thousand hills:
text_marked: Unto Enoch thou gavest one part, which was dried up the third day, that he should dwell in the same part, wherein are a thousand hills:

text: But unto Leviathan thou gavest the seventh part, namely, the moist; and hast kept him to be devoured of whom thou wilt, and when.
text_marked: But unto Leviathan thou gavest the seventh part, namely, the moist; and hast kept him to be devoured of whom thou wilt, and when.

text: Upon the sixth day thou gavest commandment unto the earth, that before thee it should bring forth beasts, cattle, and creeping things:
text_marked: Upon the sixth day thou gavest commandment unto the earth, that before thee it should bring forth beasts, cattle, and creeping things:

text: And after these, Adam also, whom thou madest lord of all thy creatures: of him come we all, and the people also whom thou hast chosen.
text_marked: And after these, Adam also, whom thou madest lord of all thy creatures: of him come we all, and the people also whom thou hast chosen.

text: All this have I spoken before thee, O Lord, because thou madest the world for our sakes
text_marked: All this have I spoken before thee, O Lord, because thou madest the world for our sakes

text: As for the other people, which also come of Adam, thou hast said that they are nothing, but be like unto spittle: and hast likened the abundance of them unto a drop that falleth from a vessel.
text_marked: As for the other people, which also come of Adam, thou hast said that they are nothing, but be like unto spittle: and hast likened the abundance of them unto a drop that falleth from a vessel.

text: And now, O Lord, behold, these heathen, which have ever been reputed as nothing, have begun to be lords over us, and to devour us.
text_marked: And now, O Lord, behold, these heathen, which have ever been reputed as nothing, have begun to be lords over us, and to devour us.

text: But we thy people, whom thou hast called thy firstborn, thy only begotten, and thy fervent lover, are given into their hands.
text_marked: But we thy people, whom thou hast called thy firstborn, thy only begotten, and thy fervent lover, are given into their hands.

text: If the world now be made for our sakes, why do we not possess an inheritance with the world? how long shall this endure?
text_marked: If the world now be made for our sakes, why do we not possess an inheritance with the world? how long shall this endure?

text: And when I had made an end of speaking these words, there was sent unto me the angel which had been sent unto me the nights afore:
text_marked: And when I had made an end of speaking these words, there was sent unto me the angel which had been sent unto me the nights afore:

text: And he said unto me, Up, Esdras, and hear the words that I am come to tell thee.
text_marked: And he said unto me, Up, Esdras, and hear the words that I am come to tell thee.

text: And I said, Speak on, my God. Then said he unto me, The sea is set in a wide place, that it might be deep and great.
text_marked: And I said, Speak on, my God. Then said he unto me, The sea is set in a wide place, that it might be deep and great.

text: But put the case the entrance were narrow, and like a river;
text_marked: But put the case the entrance were narrow, and like a river;

text: Who then could go into the sea to look upon it, and to rule it? if he went not through the narrow, how could he come into the broad?
text_marked: Who then could go into the sea to look upon it, and to rule it? if he went not through the narrow, how could he come into the broad?

text: There is also another thing; A city is builded, and set upon a broad field, and is full of all good things:
text_marked: There is also another thing; A city is builded, and set upon a broad field, and is full of all good things:

text: The entrance thereof is narrow, and is set in a dangerous place to fall, like as if there were a fire on the right hand, and on the left a deep water:
text_marked: The entrance thereof is narrow, and is set in a dangerous place to fall, like as if there were a fire on the right hand, and on the left a deep water:

text: And one only path between them both, even between the fire and the water, so small that there could but one man go there at once.
text_marked: And one only path between them both, even between the fire and the water, so small that there could but one man go there at once.

text: If this city now were given unto a man for an inheritance, if he never shall pass the danger set before it, how shall he receive this inheritance?
text_marked: If this city now were given unto a man for an inheritance, if he never shall pass the danger set before it, how shall he receive this inheritance?

text: And I said, It is so, Lord. Then said he unto me, Even so also is Israel’s portion.
text_marked: And I said, It is so, Lord. Then said he unto me, Even so also is Israel’s portion.

text: Because for their sakes I made the world: and when Adam transgressed my statutes, then was decreed that now is done.
text_marked: Because for their sakes I made the world: and when Adam transgressed my statutes, then was decreed that now is done.

text: Then were the entrances of this world made narrow, full of sorrow and travail: they are but few and evil, full of perils, and very painful.
text_marked: Then were the entrances of this world made narrow, full of sorrow and travail: they are but few and evil, full of perils, and very painful.

text: For the entrances of the elder world were wide and sure, and brought immortal fruit.
text_marked: For the entrances of the elder world were wide and sure, and brought immortal fruit.

text: If then they that live labour not to enter these strait and vain things, they can never receive those that are laid up for them.
text_marked: If then they that live labour not to enter these strait and vain things, they can never receive those that are laid up for them.

text: Now therefore why disquietest thou thyself, seeing thou art but a corruptible man? and why art thou moved, whereas thou art but mortal?
text_marked: Now therefore why disquietest thou thyself, seeing thou art but a corruptible man? and why art thou moved, whereas thou art but mortal?

text: Why hast thou not considered in thy mind this thing that is to come, rather than that which is present?
text_marked: Why hast thou not considered in thy mind this thing that is to come, rather than that which is present?

text: Then answered I and said, O Lord that bearest rule, thou hast ordained in thy law, that the righteous should inherit these things, but that the ungodly should perish.
text_marked: Then answered I and said, O Lord that bearest rule, thou hast ordained in thy law, that the righteous should inherit these things, but that the ungodly should perish.

text: Nevertheless the righteous shall suffer strait things, and hope for wide: for they that have done wickedly have suffered the strait things, and yet shall not see the wide.
text_marked: Nevertheless the righteous shall suffer strait things, and hope for wide: for they that have done wickedly have suffered the strait things, and yet shall not see the wide.

text: And he said unto me. There is no judge above God, and none that hath understanding above the Highest.
text_marked: And he said unto me. There is no judge above God, and none that hath understanding above the Highest.

text: For there be many that perish in this life, because they despise the law of God that is set before them.
text_marked: For there be many that perish in this life, because they despise the law of God that is set before them.

text: For God hath given strait commandment to such as came, what they should do to live, even as they came, and what they should observe to avoid punishment.
text_marked: For God hath given strait commandment to such as came, what they should do to live, even as they came, and what they should observe to avoid punishment.

text: Nevertheless they were not obedient unto him; but spake against him, and imagined vain things;
text_marked: Nevertheless they were not obedient unto him; but spake against him, and imagined vain things;

text: And deceived themselves by their wicked deeds; and said of the most High, that he is not; and knew not his ways:
text_marked: And deceived themselves by their wicked deeds; and said of the most High, that he is not; and knew not his ways:

text: But his law have they despised, and denied his covenants; in his statutes have they not been faithful, and have not performed his works.
text_marked: But his law have they despised, and denied his covenants; in his statutes have they not been faithful, and have not performed his works.

text: And therefore, Esdras, for the empty are empty things, and for the full are the full things.
text_marked: And therefore, Esdras, for the empty are empty things, and for the full are the full things.

text: Behold, the time shall come, that these tokens which I have told thee shall come to pass, and the bride shall appear, and she coming forth shall be seen, that now is withdrawn from the earth.
text_marked: Behold, the time shall come, that these tokens which I have told thee shall come to pass, and the bride shall appear, and she coming forth shall be seen, that now is withdrawn from the earth.

text: And whosoever is delivered from the foresaid evils shall see my wonders.
text_marked: And whosoever is delivered from the foresaid evils shall see my wonders.

text: For my son Jesus shall be revealed with those that be with him, and they that remain shall rejoice within four hundred years.
text_marked: For my son Jesus shall be revealed with those that be with him, and they that remain shall rejoice within four hundred years.

text: After these years shall my son Christ die, and all men that have life.
text_marked: After these years shall my son Christ die, and all men that have life.

text: And the world shall be turned into the old silence seven days, like as in the former judgments: so that no man shall remain.
text_marked: And the world shall be turned into the old silence seven days, like as in the former judgments: so that no man shall remain.

text: And after seven days the world, that yet awaketh not, shall be raised up, and that shall die that is corrupt
text_marked: And after seven days the world, that yet awaketh not, shall be raised up, and that shall die that is corrupt

text: And the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her, and so shall the dust those that dwell in silence, and the secret places shall deliver those souls that were committed unto them.
text_marked: And the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her, and so shall the dust those that dwell in silence, and the secret places shall deliver those souls that were committed unto them.

text: And the most High shall appear upon the seat of judgment, and misery shall pass away, and the long suffering shall have an end:
text_marked: And the most High shall appear upon the seat of judgment, and misery shall pass away, and the long suffering shall have an end:

text: But judgment only shall remain, truth shall stand, and faith shall wax strong:
text_marked: But judgment only shall remain, truth shall stand, and faith shall wax strong:

text: And the work shall follow, and the reward shall be shewed, and the good deeds shall be of force, and wicked deeds shall bear no rule.
text_marked: And the work shall follow, and the reward shall be shewed, and the good deeds shall be of force, and wicked deeds shall bear no rule.

text: Then said I, Abraham prayed first for the Sodomites, and Moses for the fathers that sinned in the wilderness:
text_marked: Then said I, Abraham prayed first for the Sodomites, and Moses for the fathers that sinned in the wilderness:

text: And Jesus after him for Israel in the time of Achan:
text_marked: And Jesus after him for Israel in the time of Achan:

text: And Samuel and David for the destruction: and Solomon for them that should come to the sanctuary:
text_marked: And Samuel and David for the destruction: and Solomon for them that should come to the sanctuary:

text: And Helias for those that received rain; and for the dead, that he might live:
text_marked: And Helias for those that received rain; and for the dead, that he might live:

text: And Ezechias for the people in the time of Sennacherib: and many for many.
text_marked: And Ezechias for the people in the time of Sennacherib: and many for many.

text: Even so now, seeing corruption is grown up, and wickedness increased, and the righteous have prayed for the ungodly: wherefore shall it not be so now also?
text_marked: Even so now, seeing corruption is grown up, and wickedness increased, and the righteous have prayed for the ungodly: wherefore shall it not be so now also?

text: He answered me, and said, This present life is not the end where much glory doth abide; therefore have they prayed for the weak.
text_marked: He answered me, and said, This present life is not the end where much glory doth abide; therefore have they prayed for the weak.

text: But the day of doom shall be the end of this time, and the beginning of the immortality for to come, wherein corruption is past,
text_marked: But the day of doom shall be the end of this time, and the beginning of the immortality for to come, wherein corruption is past,

text: Intemperance is at an end, infidelity is cut off, righteousness is grown, and truth is sprung up.
text_marked: Intemperance is at an end, infidelity is cut off, righteousness is grown, and truth is sprung up.

text: Then shall no man be able to save him that is destroyed, nor to oppress him that hath gotten the victory.
text_marked: Then shall no man be able to save him that is destroyed, nor to oppress him that hath gotten the victory.

text: I answered then and said, This is my first and last saying, that it had been better not to have given the earth unto Adam: or else, when it was given him, to have restrained him from sinning.
text_marked: I answered then and said, This is my first and last saying, that it had been better not to have given the earth unto Adam: or else, when it was given him, to have restrained him from sinning.

text: For what profit is it for men now in this present time to live in heaviness, and after death to look for punishment?
text_marked: For what profit is it for men now in this present time to live in heaviness, and after death to look for punishment?

text: O thou Adam, what hast thou done? for though it was thou that sinned, thou art not fallen alone, but we all that come of thee.
text_marked: O thou Adam, what hast thou done? for though it was thou that sinned, thou art not fallen alone, but we all that come of thee.

text: For what profit is it unto us, if there be promised us an immortal time, whereas we have done the works that bring death?
text_marked: For what profit is it unto us, if there be promised us an immortal time, whereas we have done the works that bring death?

text: And that there is promised us an everlasting hope, whereas ourselves being most wicked are made vain?
text_marked: And that there is promised us an everlasting hope, whereas ourselves being most wicked are made vain?

text: And that there are laid up for us dwellings of health and safety, whereas we have lived wickedly?
text_marked: And that there are laid up for us dwellings of health and safety, whereas we have lived wickedly?

text: And that the glory of the most High is kept to defend them which have led a wary life, whereas we have walked in the most wicked ways of all?
text_marked: And that the glory of the most High is kept to defend them which have led a wary life, whereas we have walked in the most wicked ways of all?

text: And that there should be shewed a paradise, whose fruit endureth for ever, wherein is security and medicine, since we shall not enter into it?
text_marked: And that there should be shewed a paradise, whose fruit endureth for ever, wherein is security and medicine, since we shall not enter into it?

text: (For we have walked in unpleasant places.)
text_marked: (For we have walked in unpleasant places.)

text: And that the faces of them which have used abstinence shall shine above the stars, whereas our faces shall be blacker than darkness?
text_marked: And that the faces of them which have used abstinence shall shine above the stars, whereas our faces shall be blacker than darkness?

text: For while we lived and committed iniquity, we considered not that we should begin to suffer for it after death.
text_marked: For while we lived and committed iniquity, we considered not that we should begin to suffer for it after death.

text: Then answered he me, and said, This is the condition of the battle, which man that is born upon the earth shall fight;
text_marked: Then answered he me, and said, This is the condition of the battle, which man that is born upon the earth shall fight;

text: That, if he be overcome, he shall suffer as thou hast said: but if he get the victory, he shall receive the thing that I say.
text_marked: That, if he be overcome, he shall suffer as thou hast said: but if he get the victory, he shall receive the thing that I say.

text: For this is the life whereof Moses spake unto the people while he lived, saying, Choose thee life, that thou mayest live.
text_marked: For this is the life whereof Moses spake unto the people while he lived, saying, Choose thee life, that thou mayest live.

text: Nevertheless they believed not him, nor yet the prophets after him, no nor me which have spoken unto them,
text_marked: Nevertheless they believed not him, nor yet the prophets after him, no nor me which have spoken unto them,

text: That there should not be such heaviness in their destruction, as shall be joy over them that are persuaded to salvation.
text_marked: That there should not be such heaviness in their destruction, as shall be joy over them that are persuaded to salvation.

text: I answered then, and said, I know, Lord, that the most High is called merciful, in that he hath mercy upon them which are not yet come into the world,
text_marked: I answered then, and said, I know, Lord, that the most High is called merciful, in that he hath mercy upon them which are not yet come into the world,

text: And upon those also that turn to his law;
text_marked: And upon those also that turn to his law;

text: And that he is patient, and long suffereth those that have sinned, as his creatures;
text_marked: And that he is patient, and long suffereth those that have sinned, as his creatures;

text: And that he is bountiful, for he is ready to give where it needeth;
text_marked: And that he is bountiful, for he is ready to give where it needeth;

text: And that he is of great mercy, for he multiplieth more and more mercies to them that are present, and that are past, and also to them which are to come.
text_marked: And that he is of great mercy, for he multiplieth more and more mercies to them that are present, and that are past, and also to them which are to come.

text: For if he shall not multiply his mercies, the world would not continue with them that inherit therein.
text_marked: For if he shall not multiply his mercies, the world would not continue with them that inherit therein.

text: And he pardoneth; for if he did not so of his goodness, that they which have committed iniquities might be eased of them, the ten thousandth part of men should not remain living.
text_marked: And he pardoneth; for if he did not so of his goodness, that they which have committed iniquities might be eased of them, the ten thousandth part of men should not remain living.

text: And being judge, if he should not forgive them that are cured with his word, and put out the multitude of contentions,
text_marked: And being judge, if he should not forgive them that are cured with his word, and put out the multitude of contentions,

text: There should be very few left peradventure in an innumerable multitude.
text_marked: There should be very few left peradventure in an innumerable multitude.

text: And he answered me, saying, The most High hath made this world for many, but the world to come for few.
text_marked: And he answered me, saying, The most High hath made this world for many, but the world to come for few.

text: I will tell thee a similitude, Esdras; As when thou askest the earth, it shall say unto thee, that it giveth much mould whereof earthen vessels are made, but little dust that gold cometh of: even so is the course of this present world.
text_marked: I will tell thee a similitude, Esdras; As when thou askest the earth, it shall say unto thee, that it giveth much mould whereof earthen vessels are made, but little dust that gold cometh of: even so is the course of this present world.

text: There be many created, but few shall be saved.
text_marked: There be many created, but few shall be saved.

text: So answered I and said, Swallow then down, O my soul, understanding, and devour wisdom.
text_marked: So answered I and said, Swallow then down, O my soul, understanding, and devour wisdom.

text: For thou hast agreed to give ear, and art willing to prophesy: for thou hast no longer space than only to live.
text_marked: For thou hast agreed to give ear, and art willing to prophesy: for thou hast no longer space than only to live.

text: O Lord, if thou suffer not thy servant, that we may pray before thee, and thou give us seed unto our heart, and culture to our understanding, that there may come fruit of it; how shall each man live that is corrupt, who beareth the place of a man?
text_marked: O Lord, if thou suffer not thy servant, that we may pray before thee, and thou give us seed unto our heart, and culture to our understanding, that there may come fruit of it; how shall each man live that is corrupt, who beareth the place of a man?

text: For thou art alone, and we all one workmanship of thine hands, like as thou hast said.
text_marked: For thou art alone, and we all one workmanship of thine hands, like as thou hast said.

text: For when the body is fashioned now in the mother’s womb, and thou givest it members, thy creature is preserved in fire and water, and nine months doth thy workmanship endure thy creature which is created in her.
text_marked: For when the body is fashioned now in the mother’s womb, and thou givest it members, thy creature is preserved in fire and water, and nine months doth thy workmanship endure thy creature which is created in her.

text: But that which keepeth and is kept shall both be preserved: and when the time cometh, the womb preserved delivereth up the things that grew in it.
text_marked: But that which keepeth and is kept shall both be preserved: and when the time cometh, the womb preserved delivereth up the things that grew in it.

text: For thou hast commanded out of the parts of the body, that is to say, out of the breasts, milk to be given, which is the fruit of the breasts,
text_marked: For thou hast commanded out of the parts of the body, that is to say, out of the breasts, milk to be given, which is the fruit of the breasts,

text: That the thing which is fashioned may be nourished for a time, till thou disposest it to thy mercy.
text_marked: That the thing which is fashioned may be nourished for a time, till thou disposest it to thy mercy.

text: Thou broughtest it up with thy righteousness, and nurturedst it in thy law, and reformedst it with thy judgment.
text_marked: Thou broughtest it up with thy righteousness, and nurturedst it in thy law, and reformedst it with thy judgment.

text: And thou shalt mortify it as thy creature, and quicken it as thy work.
text_marked: And thou shalt mortify it as thy creature, and quicken it as thy work.

text: If therefore thou shalt destroy him which with so great labour was fashioned, it is an easy thing to be ordained by thy commandment, that the thing which was made might be preserved.
text_marked: If therefore thou shalt destroy him which with so great labour was fashioned, it is an easy thing to be ordained by thy commandment, that the thing which was made might be preserved.

text: Now therefore, Lord, I will speak; touching man in general, thou knowest best; but touching thy people, for whose sake I am sorry;
text_marked: Now therefore, Lord, I will speak; touching man in general, thou knowest best; but touching thy people, for whose sake I am sorry;

text: And for thine inheritance, for whose cause I mourn; and for Israel, for whom I am heavy; and for Jacob, for whose sake I am troubled;
text_marked: And for thine inheritance, for whose cause I mourn; and for Israel, for whom I am heavy; and for Jacob, for whose sake I am troubled;

text: Therefore will I begin to pray before thee for myself and for them: for I see the falls of us that dwell in the land.
text_marked: Therefore will I begin to pray before thee for myself and for them: for I see the falls of us that dwell in the land.

text: But I have heard the swiftness of the judge which is to come.
text_marked: But I have heard the swiftness of the judge which is to come.

text: Therefore hear my voice, and understand my words, and I shall speak before thee. This is the beginning of the words of Esdras, before he was taken up: and I said,
text_marked: Therefore hear my voice, and understand my words, and I shall speak before thee. This is the beginning of the words of Esdras, before he was taken up: and I said,

text: O Lord, thou that dwellest in everlastingness which beholdest from above things in the heaven and in the air;
text_marked: O Lord, thou that dwellest in everlastingness which beholdest from above things in the heaven and in the air;

text: Whose throne is inestimable; whose glory may not be comprehended; before whom the hosts of angels stand with trembling,
text_marked: Whose throne is inestimable; whose glory may not be comprehended; before whom the hosts of angels stand with trembling,

text: Whose service is conversant in wind and fire; whose word is true, and sayings constant; whose commandment is strong, and ordinance fearful;
text_marked: Whose service is conversant in wind and fire; whose word is true, and sayings constant; whose commandment is strong, and ordinance fearful;

text: Whose look drieth up the depths, and indignation maketh the mountains to melt away; which the truth witnesseth:
text_marked: Whose look drieth up the depths, and indignation maketh the mountains to melt away; which the truth witnesseth:

text: O hear the prayer of thy servant, and give ear to the petition of thy creature.
text_marked: O hear the prayer of thy servant, and give ear to the petition of thy creature.

text: For while I live I will speak, and so long as I have understanding I will answer.
text_marked: For while I live I will speak, and so long as I have understanding I will answer.

text: O look not upon the sins of thy people; but on them which serve thee in truth.
text_marked: O look not upon the sins of thy people; but on them which serve thee in truth.

text: Regard not the wicked inventions of the heathen, but the desire of those that keep thy testimonies in afflictions.
text_marked: Regard not the wicked inventions of the heathen, but the desire of those that keep thy testimonies in afflictions.

text: Think not upon those that have walked feignedly before thee: but remember them, which according to thy will have known thy fear.
text_marked: Think not upon those that have walked feignedly before thee: but remember them, which according to thy will have known thy fear.

text: Let it not be thy will to destroy them which have lived like beasts; but to look upon them that have clearly taught thy law.
text_marked: Let it not be thy will to destroy them which have lived like beasts; but to look upon them that have clearly taught thy law.

text: Take thou no indignation at them which are deemed worse than beasts; but love them that always put their trust in thy righteousness and glory.
text_marked: Take thou no indignation at them which are deemed worse than beasts; but love them that always put their trust in thy righteousness and glory.

text: For we and our fathers do languish of such diseases: but because of us sinners thou shalt be called merciful.
text_marked: For we and our fathers do languish of such diseases: but because of us sinners thou shalt be called merciful.

text: For if thou hast a desire to have mercy upon us, thou shalt be called merciful, to us namely, that have no works of righteousness.
text_marked: For if thou hast a desire to have mercy upon us, thou shalt be called merciful, to us namely, that have no works of righteousness.

text: For the just, which have many good works laid up with thee, shall out of their own deeds receive reward.
text_marked: For the just, which have many good works laid up with thee, shall out of their own deeds receive reward.

text: For what is man, that thou shouldest take displeasure at him? or what is a corruptible generation, that thou shouldest be so bitter toward it?
text_marked: For what is man, that thou shouldest take displeasure at him? or what is a corruptible generation, that thou shouldest be so bitter toward it?

text: For in truth them is no man among them that be born, but he hath dealt wickedly; and among the faithful there is none which hath not done amiss.
text_marked: For in truth them is no man among them that be born, but he hath dealt wickedly; and among the faithful there is none which hath not done amiss.

text: For in this, O Lord, thy righteousness and thy goodness shall be declared, if thou be merciful unto them which have not the confidence of good works.
text_marked: For in this, O Lord, thy righteousness and thy goodness shall be declared, if thou be merciful unto them which have not the confidence of good works.

text: Then answered he me, and said, Some things hast thou spoken aright, and according unto thy words it shall be.
text_marked: Then answered he me, and said, Some things hast thou spoken aright, and according unto thy words it shall be.

text: For indeed I will not think on the disposition of them which have sinned before death, before judgment, before destruction:
text_marked: For indeed I will not think on the disposition of them which have sinned before death, before judgment, before destruction:

text: But I will rejoice over the disposition of the righteous, and I will remember also their pilgrimage, and the salvation, and the reward, that they shall have.
text_marked: But I will rejoice over the disposition of the righteous, and I will remember also their pilgrimage, and the salvation, and the reward, that they shall have.

text: Like as I have spoken now, so shall it come to pass.
text_marked: Like as I have spoken now, so shall it come to pass.

text: For as the husbandman soweth much seed upon the ground, and planteth many trees, and yet the thing that is sown good in his season cometh not up, neither doth all that is planted take root: even so is it of them that are sown in the world; they shall not all be saved.
text_marked: For as the husbandman soweth much seed upon the ground, and planteth many trees, and yet the thing that is sown good in his season cometh not up, neither doth all that is planted take root: even so is it of them that are sown in the world; they shall not all be saved.

text: I answered then and said, If I have found grace, let me speak.
text_marked: I answered then and said, If I have found grace, let me speak.

text: Like as the husbandman’s seed perisheth, if it come not up, and receive not thy rain in due season; or if there come too much rain, and corrupt it:
text_marked: Like as the husbandman’s seed perisheth, if it come not up, and receive not thy rain in due season; or if there come too much rain, and corrupt it:

text: Even so perisheth man also, which is formed with thy hands, and is called thine own image, because thou art like unto him, for whose sake thou hast made all things, and likened him unto the husbandman’s seed.
text_marked: Even so perisheth man also, which is formed with thy hands, and is called thine own image, because thou art like unto him, for whose sake thou hast made all things, and likened him unto the husbandman’s seed.

text: Be not wroth with us but spare thy people, and have mercy upon thine own inheritance: for thou art merciful unto thy creature.
text_marked: Be not wroth with us but spare thy people, and have mercy upon thine own inheritance: for thou art merciful unto thy creature.

text: Then answered he me, and said, Things present are for the present, and things to cometh for such as be to come.
text_marked: Then answered he me, and said, Things present are for the present, and things to cometh for such as be to come.

text: For thou comest far short that thou shouldest be able to love my creature more than I: but I have ofttimes drawn nigh unto thee, and unto it, but never to the unrighteous.
text_marked: For thou comest far short that thou shouldest be able to love my creature more than I: but I have ofttimes drawn nigh unto thee, and unto it, but never to the unrighteous.

text: In this also thou art marvellous before the most High:
text_marked: In this also thou art marvellous before the most High:

text: In that thou hast humbled thyself, as it becometh thee, and hast not judged thyself worthy to be much glorified among the righteous.
text_marked: In that thou hast humbled thyself, as it becometh thee, and hast not judged thyself worthy to be much glorified among the righteous.

text: For many great miseries shall be done to them that in the latter time shall dwell in the world, because they have walked in great pride.
text_marked: For many great miseries shall be done to them that in the latter time shall dwell in the world, because they have walked in great pride.

text: But understand thou for thyself, and seek out the glory for such as be like thee.
text_marked: But understand thou for thyself, and seek out the glory for such as be like thee.

text: For unto you is paradise opened, the tree of life is planted, the time to come is prepared, plenteousness is made ready, a city is builded, and rest is allowed, yea, perfect goodness and wisdom.
text_marked: For unto you is paradise opened, the tree of life is planted, the time to come is prepared, plenteousness is made ready, a city is builded, and rest is allowed, yea, perfect goodness and wisdom.

text: The root of evil is sealed up from you, weakness and the moth is hid from you, and corruption is fled into hell to be forgotten:
text_marked: The root of evil is sealed up from you, weakness and the moth is hid from you, and corruption is fled into hell to be forgotten:

text: Sorrows are passed, and in the end is shewed the treasure of immortality.
text_marked: Sorrows are passed, and in the end is shewed the treasure of immortality.

text: And therefore ask thou no more questions concerning the multitude of them that perish.
text_marked: And therefore ask thou no more questions concerning the multitude of them that perish.

text: For when they had taken liberty, they despised the most High, thought scorn of his law, and forsook his ways.
text_marked: For when they had taken liberty, they despised the most High, thought scorn of his law, and forsook his ways.

text: Moreover they have trodden down his righteous,
text_marked: Moreover they have trodden down his righteous,

text: And said in their heart, that there is no God; yea, and that knowing they must die.
text_marked: And said in their heart, that there is no God; yea, and that knowing they must die.

text: For as the things aforesaid shalt receive you, so thirst and pain are prepared for them: for it was not his will that men should come to nought:
text_marked: For as the things aforesaid shalt receive you, so thirst and pain are prepared for them: for it was not his will that men should come to nought:

text: But they which be created have defiled the name of him that made them, and were unthankful unto him which prepared life for them.
text_marked: But they which be created have defiled the name of him that made them, and were unthankful unto him which prepared life for them.

text: And therefore is my judgment now at hand.
text_marked: And therefore is my judgment now at hand.

text: These things have I not shewed unto all men, but unto thee, and a few like thee. Then answered I and said,
text_marked: These things have I not shewed unto all men, but unto thee, and a few like thee. Then answered I and said,

text: Behold, O Lord, now hast thou shewed me the multitude of the wonders, which thou wilt begin to do in the last times: but at what time, thou hast not shewed me.
text_marked: Behold, O Lord, now hast thou shewed me the multitude of the wonders, which thou wilt begin to do in the last times: but at what time, thou hast not shewed me.

text: He answered me then, and said, Measure thou the time diligently in itself: and when thou seest part of the signs past, which I have told thee before,
text_marked: He answered me then, and said, Measure thou the time diligently in itself: and when thou seest part of the signs past, which I have told thee before,

text: Then shalt thou understand, that it is the very same time, wherein the Highest will begin to visit the world which he made.
text_marked: Then shalt thou understand, that it is the very same time, wherein the Highest will begin to visit the world which he made.

text: Therefore when there shall be seen earthquakes and uproars of the people in the world:
text_marked: Therefore when there shall be seen earthquakes and uproars of the people in the world:

text: Then shalt thou well understand, that the most High spake of those things from the days that were before thee, even from the beginning.
text_marked: Then shalt thou well understand, that the most High spake of those things from the days that were before thee, even from the beginning.

text: For like as all that is made in the world hath a beginning and an end, and the end is manifest:
text_marked: For like as all that is made in the world hath a beginning and an end, and the end is manifest:

text: Even so the times also of the Highest have plain beginnings in wonder and powerful works, and endings in effects and signs.
text_marked: Even so the times also of the Highest have plain beginnings in wonder and powerful works, and endings in effects and signs.

text: And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works, and by faith, whereby ye have believed,
text_marked: And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works, and by faith, whereby ye have believed,

text: Shall be preserved from the said perils, and shall see my salvation in my land, and within my borders: for I have sanctified them for me from the beginning.
text_marked: Shall be preserved from the said perils, and shall see my salvation in my land, and within my borders: for I have sanctified them for me from the beginning.

text: Then shall they be in pitiful case, which now have abused my ways: and they that have cast them away despitefully shall dwell in torments.
text_marked: Then shall they be in pitiful case, which now have abused my ways: and they that have cast them away despitefully shall dwell in torments.

text: For such as in their life have received benefits, and have not known me;
text_marked: For such as in their life have received benefits, and have not known me;

text: And they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty, and, when as yet place of repentance was open unto them, understood not, but despised it;
text_marked: And they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty, and, when as yet place of repentance was open unto them, understood not, but despised it;

text: The same must know it after death by pain.
text_marked: The same must know it after death by pain.

text: And therefore be thou not curious how the ungodly shall be punished, and when: but enquire how the righteous shall be saved, whose the world is, and for whom the world is created.
text_marked: And therefore be thou not curious how the ungodly shall be punished, and when: but enquire how the righteous shall be saved, whose the world is, and for whom the world is created.

text: Then answered I and said,
text_marked: Then answered I and said,

text: I have said before, and now do speak, and will speak it also hereafter, that there be many more of them which perish, than of them which shall be saved:
text_marked: I have said before, and now do speak, and will speak it also hereafter, that there be many more of them which perish, than of them which shall be saved:

text: Like as a wave is greater than a drop.
text_marked: Like as a wave is greater than a drop.

text: And he answered me, saying, Like as the field is, so is also the seed; as the flowers be, such are the colours also; such as the workman is, such also is the work; and as the husbandman is himself, so is his husbandry also: for it was the time of the world.
text_marked: And he answered me, saying, Like as the field is, so is also the seed; as the flowers be, such are the colours also; such as the workman is, such also is the work; and as the husbandman is himself, so is his husbandry also: for it was the time of the world.

text: And now when I prepared the world, which was not yet made, even for them to dwell in that now live, no man spake against me.
text_marked: And now when I prepared the world, which was not yet made, even for them to dwell in that now live, no man spake against me.

text: For then every one obeyed: but now the manners of them which are created in this world that is made are corrupted by a perpetual seed, and by a law which is unsearchable rid themselves.
text_marked: For then every one obeyed: but now the manners of them which are created in this world that is made are corrupted by a perpetual seed, and by a law which is unsearchable rid themselves.

text: So I considered the world, and, behold, there was peril because of the devices that were come into it.
text_marked: So I considered the world, and, behold, there was peril because of the devices that were come into it.

text: And I saw, and spared it greatly, and have kept me a grape of the cluster, and a plant of a great people.
text_marked: And I saw, and spared it greatly, and have kept me a grape of the cluster, and a plant of a great people.

text: Let the multitude perish then, which was born in vain; and let my grape be kept, and my plant; for with great labour have I made it perfect.
text_marked: Let the multitude perish then, which was born in vain; and let my grape be kept, and my plant; for with great labour have I made it perfect.

text: Nevertheless, if thou wilt cease yet seven days more, (but thou shalt not fast in them,
text_marked: Nevertheless, if thou wilt cease yet seven days more, (but thou shalt not fast in them,

text: But go into a field of flowers, where no house is builded, and eat only the flowers of the field; taste no flesh, drink no wine, but eat flowers only;)
text_marked: But go into a field of flowers, where no house is builded, and eat only the flowers of the field; taste no flesh, drink no wine, but eat flowers only;)

text: And pray unto the Highest continually, then will I come and talk with thee.
text_marked: And pray unto the Highest continually, then will I come and talk with thee.

text: So I went my way into the field which is called Ardath, like as he commanded me; and there I sat among the flowers, and did eat of the herbs of the field, and the meat of the same satisfied me.
text_marked: So I went my way into the field which is called Ardath, like as he commanded me; and there I sat among the flowers, and did eat of the herbs of the field, and the meat of the same satisfied me.

text: After seven days I sat upon the grass, and my heart was vexed within me, like as before:
text_marked: After seven days I sat upon the grass, and my heart was vexed within me, like as before:

text: And I opened my mouth, and began to talk before the most High, and said,
text_marked: And I opened my mouth, and began to talk before the most High, and said,

text: O Lord, thou that shewest thyself unto us, thou wast shewed unto our fathers in the wilderness, in a place where no man treadeth, in a barren place, when they came out of Egypt.
text_marked: O Lord, thou that shewest thyself unto us, thou wast shewed unto our fathers in the wilderness, in a place where no man treadeth, in a barren place, when they came out of Egypt.

text: And thou spakest saying, Hear me, O Israel; and mark my words, thou seed of Jacob.
text_marked: And thou spakest saying, Hear me, O Israel; and mark my words, thou seed of Jacob.

text: For, behold, I sow my law in you, and it shall bring fruit in you, and ye shall be honoured in it for ever.
text_marked: For, behold, I sow my law in you, and it shall bring fruit in you, and ye shall be honoured in it for ever.

text: But our fathers, which received the law, kept it not, and observed not thy ordinances: and though the fruit of thy law did not perish, neither could it, for it was thine;
text_marked: But our fathers, which received the law, kept it not, and observed not thy ordinances: and though the fruit of thy law did not perish, neither could it, for it was thine;

text: Yet they that received it perished, because they kept not the thing that was sown in them.
text_marked: Yet they that received it perished, because they kept not the thing that was sown in them.

text: And, lo, it is a custom, when the ground hath received seed, or the sea a ship, or any vessel meat or drink, that, that being perished wherein it was sown or cast into,
text_marked: And, lo, it is a custom, when the ground hath received seed, or the sea a ship, or any vessel meat or drink, that, that being perished wherein it was sown or cast into,

text: That thing also which was sown, or cast therein, or received, doth perish, and remaineth not with us: but with us it hath not happened so.
text_marked: That thing also which was sown, or cast therein, or received, doth perish, and remaineth not with us: but with us it hath not happened so.

text: For we that have received the law perish by sin, and our heart also which received it
text_marked: For we that have received the law perish by sin, and our heart also which received it

text: Notwithstanding the law perisheth not, but remaineth in his force.
text_marked: Notwithstanding the law perisheth not, but remaineth in his force.

text: And when I spake these things in my heart, I looked back with mine eyes, and upon the right side I saw a woman, and, behold, she mourned and wept with a loud voice, and was much grieved in heart, and her clothes were rent, and she had ashes upon her head.
text_marked: And when I spake these things in my heart, I looked back with mine eyes, and upon the right side I saw a woman, and, behold, she mourned and wept with a loud voice, and was much grieved in heart, and her clothes were rent, and she had ashes upon her head.

text: Then let I my thoughts go that I was in, and turned me unto her,
text_marked: Then let I my thoughts go that I was in, and turned me unto her,

text: And said unto her, Wherefore weepest thou? why art thou so grieved in thy mind?
text_marked: And said unto her, Wherefore weepest thou? why art thou so grieved in thy mind?

text: And she said unto me, Sir, let me alone, that I may bewail myself, and add unto my sorrow, for I am sore vexed in my mind, and brought very low.
text_marked: And she said unto me, Sir, let me alone, that I may bewail myself, and add unto my sorrow, for I am sore vexed in my mind, and brought very low.

text: And I said unto her, What aileth thee? tell me.
text_marked: And I said unto her, What aileth thee? tell me.

text: She said unto me, I thy servant have been barren, and had no child, though I had an husband thirty years,
text_marked: She said unto me, I thy servant have been barren, and had no child, though I had an husband thirty years,

text: And those thirty years I did nothing else day and night, and every hour, but make my, prayer to the Highest.
text_marked: And those thirty years I did nothing else day and night, and every hour, but make my, prayer to the Highest.

text: After thirty years God heard me thine handmaid, looked upon my misery, considered my trouble, and gave me a son: and I was very glad of him, so was my husband also, and all my neighbours: and we gave great honour unto the Almighty.
text_marked: After thirty years God heard me thine handmaid, looked upon my misery, considered my trouble, and gave me a son: and I was very glad of him, so was my husband also, and all my neighbours: and we gave great honour unto the Almighty.

text: And I nourished him with great travail.
text_marked: And I nourished him with great travail.

text: So when he grew up, and came to the time that he should have a wife, I made a feast.
text_marked: So when he grew up, and came to the time that he should have a wife, I made a feast.

text: And it so came to pass, that when my son was entered into his wedding chamber, he fell down, and died.
text_marked: And it so came to pass, that when my son was entered into his wedding chamber, he fell down, and died.

text: Then we all overthrew the lights, and all my neighbours rose up to comfort me: so I took my rest unto the second day at night.
text_marked: Then we all overthrew the lights, and all my neighbours rose up to comfort me: so I took my rest unto the second day at night.

text: And it came to pass, when they had all left off to comfort me, to the end I might be quiet; then rose I up by night and fled, and came hither into this field, as thou seest.
text_marked: And it came to pass, when they had all left off to comfort me, to the end I might be quiet; then rose I up by night and fled, and came hither into this field, as thou seest.

text: And I do now purpose not to return into the city, but here to stay, and neither to eat nor drink, but continually to mourn and to fast until I die.
text_marked: And I do now purpose not to return into the city, but here to stay, and neither to eat nor drink, but continually to mourn and to fast until I die.

text: Then left I the meditations wherein I was, and spake to her in anger, saying,
text_marked: Then left I the meditations wherein I was, and spake to her in anger, saying,

text: Thou foolish woman above all other, seest thou not our mourning, and what happeneth unto us?
text_marked: Thou foolish woman above all other, seest thou not our mourning, and what happeneth unto us?

text: How that Sion our mother is full of all heaviness, and much humbled, mourning very sore?
text_marked: How that Sion our mother is full of all heaviness, and much humbled, mourning very sore?

text: And now, seeing we all mourn and are sad, for we are all in heaviness, art thou grieved for one son?
text_marked: And now, seeing we all mourn and are sad, for we are all in heaviness, art thou grieved for one son?

text: For ask the earth, and she shall tell thee, that it is she which ought to mourn for the fall of so many that grow upon her.
text_marked: For ask the earth, and she shall tell thee, that it is she which ought to mourn for the fall of so many that grow upon her.

text: For out of her came all at the first, and out of her shall all others come, and, behold, they walk almost all into destruction, and a multitude of them is utterly rooted out.
text_marked: For out of her came all at the first, and out of her shall all others come, and, behold, they walk almost all into destruction, and a multitude of them is utterly rooted out.

text: Who then should make more mourning than she, that hath lost so great a multitude; and not thou, which art sorry but for one?
text_marked: Who then should make more mourning than she, that hath lost so great a multitude; and not thou, which art sorry but for one?

text: But if thou sayest unto me, My lamentation is not like the earth’s, because I have lost the fruit of my womb, which I brought forth with pains, and bare with sorrows;
text_marked: But if thou sayest unto me, My lamentation is not like the earth’s, because I have lost the fruit of my womb, which I brought forth with pains, and bare with sorrows;

text: But the earth not so: for the multitude present in it according to the course of the earth is gone, as it came:
text_marked: But the earth not so: for the multitude present in it according to the course of the earth is gone, as it came:

text: Then say I unto thee, Like as thou hast brought forth with labour; even so the earth also hath given her fruit, namely, man, ever since the beginning unto him that made her.
text_marked: Then say I unto thee, Like as thou hast brought forth with labour; even so the earth also hath given her fruit, namely, man, ever since the beginning unto him that made her.

text: Now therefore keep thy sorrow to thyself, and bear with a good courage that which hath befallen thee.
text_marked: Now therefore keep thy sorrow to thyself, and bear with a good courage that which hath befallen thee.

text: For if thou shalt acknowledge the determination of God to be just, thou shalt both receive thy son in time, and shalt be commended among women.
text_marked: For if thou shalt acknowledge the determination of God to be just, thou shalt both receive thy son in time, and shalt be commended among women.

text: Go thy way then into the city to thine husband.
text_marked: Go thy way then into the city to thine husband.

text: And she said unto me, That will I not do: I will not go into the city, but here will I die.
text_marked: And she said unto me, That will I not do: I will not go into the city, but here will I die.

text: So I proceeded to speak further unto her, and said,
text_marked: So I proceeded to speak further unto her, and said,

text: Do not so, but be counselled. by me: for how many are the adversities of Sion? be comforted in regard of the sorrow of Jerusalem.
text_marked: Do not so, but be counselled. by me: for how many are the adversities of Sion? be comforted in regard of the sorrow of Jerusalem.

text: For thou seest that our sanctuary is laid waste, our altar broken down, our temple destroyed;
text_marked: For thou seest that our sanctuary is laid waste, our altar broken down, our temple destroyed;

text: Our psaltery is laid on the ground, our song is put to silence, our rejoicing is at an end, the light of our candlestick is put out, the ark of our covenant is spoiled, our holy things are defiled, and the name that is called upon us is almost profaned: our children are put to shame, our priests are burnt, our Levites are gone into captivity, our virgins are defiled, and our wives ravished; our righteous men carried away, our little ones destroyed, our young men are brought in bondage, and our strong men are become weak;
text_marked: Our psaltery is laid on the ground, our song is put to silence, our rejoicing is at an end, the light of our candlestick is put out, the ark of our covenant is spoiled, our holy things are defiled, and the name that is called upon us is almost profaned: our children are put to shame, our priests are burnt, our Levites are gone into captivity, our virgins are defiled, and our wives ravished; our righteous men carried away, our little ones destroyed, our young men are brought in bondage, and our strong men are become weak;

text: And, which is the greatest of all, the seal of Sion hath now lost her honour; for she is delivered into the hands of them that hate us.
text_marked: And, which is the greatest of all, the seal of Sion hath now lost her honour; for she is delivered into the hands of them that hate us.

text: And therefore shake off thy great heaviness, and put away the multitude of sorrows, that the Mighty may be merciful unto thee again, and the Highest shall give thee rest and ease from thy labour.
text_marked: And therefore shake off thy great heaviness, and put away the multitude of sorrows, that the Mighty may be merciful unto thee again, and the Highest shall give thee rest and ease from thy labour.

text: And it came to pass while I was talking with her, behold, her face upon a sudden shined exceedingly, and her countenance glistered, so that I was afraid of her, and mused what it might be.
text_marked: And it came to pass while I was talking with her, behold, her face upon a sudden shined exceedingly, and her countenance glistered, so that I was afraid of her, and mused what it might be.

text: And, behold, suddenly she made a great cry very fearful: so that the earth shook at the noise of the woman.
text_marked: And, behold, suddenly she made a great cry very fearful: so that the earth shook at the noise of the woman.

text: And I looked, and, behold, the woman appeared unto me no more, but there was a city builded, and a large place shewed itself from the foundations: then was I afraid, and cried with a loud voice, and said,
text_marked: And I looked, and, behold, the woman appeared unto me no more, but there was a city builded, and a large place shewed itself from the foundations: then was I afraid, and cried with a loud voice, and said,

text: Where is Uriel the angel, who came unto me at the first? for he hath caused me to fall into many trances, and mine end is turned into corruption, and my prayer to rebuke.
text_marked: Where is Uriel the angel, who came unto me at the first? for he hath caused me to fall into many trances, and mine end is turned into corruption, and my prayer to rebuke.

text: And as I was speaking these words behold, he came unto me, and looked upon me.
text_marked: And as I was speaking these words behold, he came unto me, and looked upon me.

text: And, lo, I lay as one that had been dead, and mine understanding was taken from me: and he took me by the right hand, and comforted me, and set me upon my feet, and said unto me,
text_marked: And, lo, I lay as one that had been dead, and mine understanding was taken from me: and he took me by the right hand, and comforted me, and set me upon my feet, and said unto me,

text: What aileth thee? and why art thou so disquieted? and why is thine understanding troubled, and the thoughts of thine heart?
text_marked: What aileth thee? and why art thou so disquieted? and why is thine understanding troubled, and the thoughts of thine heart?

text: And I said, Because thou hast forsaken me, and yet I did according to thy words, and I went into the field, and, lo, I have seen, and yet see, that I am not able to express.
text_marked: And I said, Because thou hast forsaken me, and yet I did according to thy words, and I went into the field, and, lo, I have seen, and yet see, that I am not able to express.

text: And he said unto me, Stand up manfully, and I will advise thee.
text_marked: And he said unto me, Stand up manfully, and I will advise thee.

text: Then said I, Speak on, my lord, in me; only forsake me not, lest I die frustrate of my hope.
text_marked: Then said I, Speak on, my lord, in me; only forsake me not, lest I die frustrate of my hope.

text: For I have seen that I knew not, and hear that I do not know.
text_marked: For I have seen that I knew not, and hear that I do not know.

text: Or is my sense deceived, or my soul in a dream?
text_marked: Or is my sense deceived, or my soul in a dream?

text: Now therefore I beseech thee that thou wilt shew thy servant of this vision.
text_marked: Now therefore I beseech thee that thou wilt shew thy servant of this vision.

text: He answered me then, and said, Hear me, and I shall inform thee, and tell thee wherefore thou art afraid: for the Highest will reveal many secret things unto thee.
text_marked: He answered me then, and said, Hear me, and I shall inform thee, and tell thee wherefore thou art afraid: for the Highest will reveal many secret things unto thee.

text: He hath seen that thy way is right: for that thou sorrowest continually for thy people, and makest great lamentation for Sion.
text_marked: He hath seen that thy way is right: for that thou sorrowest continually for thy people, and makest great lamentation for Sion.

text: This therefore is the meaning of the vision which thou lately sawest:
text_marked: This therefore is the meaning of the vision which thou lately sawest:

text: Thou sawest a woman mourning, and thou begannest to comfort her:
text_marked: Thou sawest a woman mourning, and thou begannest to comfort her:

text: But now seest thou the likeness of the woman no more, but there appeared unto thee a city builded.
text_marked: But now seest thou the likeness of the woman no more, but there appeared unto thee a city builded.

text: And whereas she told thee of the death of her son, this is the solution:
text_marked: And whereas she told thee of the death of her son, this is the solution:

text: This woman, whom thou sawest is Sion: and whereas she said unto thee, even she whom thou seest as a city builded,
text_marked: This woman, whom thou sawest is Sion: and whereas she said unto thee, even she whom thou seest as a city builded,

text: Whereas, I say, she said unto thee, that she hath been thirty years barren: those are the thirty years wherein there was no offering made in her.
text_marked: Whereas, I say, she said unto thee, that she hath been thirty years barren: those are the thirty years wherein there was no offering made in her.

text: But after thirty years Solomon builded the city and offered offerings: and then bare the barren a son.
