text_marked: But after thirty years Solomon builded the city and offered offerings: and then bare the barren a son.

text: And whereas she told thee that she nourished him with labour: that was the dwelling in Jerusalem.
text_marked: And whereas she told thee that she nourished him with labour: that was the dwelling in Jerusalem.

text: But whereas she said unto thee, That my son coming into his marriage chamber happened to have a fail, and died: this was the destruction that came to Jerusalem.
text_marked: But whereas she said unto thee, That my son coming into his marriage chamber happened to have a fail, and died: this was the destruction that came to Jerusalem.

text: And, behold, thou sawest her likeness, and because she mourned for her son, thou begannest to comfort her: and of these things which have chanced, these are to be opened unto thee.
text_marked: And, behold, thou sawest her likeness, and because she mourned for her son, thou begannest to comfort her: and of these things which have chanced, these are to be opened unto thee.

text: For now the most High seeth that thou art grieved unfeignedly, and sufferest from thy whole heart for her, so hath he shewed thee the brightness of her glory, and the comeliness of her beauty:
text_marked: For now the most High seeth that thou art grieved unfeignedly, and sufferest from thy whole heart for her, so hath he shewed thee the brightness of her glory, and the comeliness of her beauty:

text: And therefore I bade thee remain in the field where no house was builded:
text_marked: And therefore I bade thee remain in the field where no house was builded:

text: For I knew that the Highest would shew this unto thee.
text_marked: For I knew that the Highest would shew this unto thee.

text: Therefore I commanded thee to go into the field, where no foundation of any building was.
text_marked: Therefore I commanded thee to go into the field, where no foundation of any building was.

text: For in the place wherein the Highest beginneth to shew his city, there can no man’s building be able to stand.
text_marked: For in the place wherein the Highest beginneth to shew his city, there can no man’s building be able to stand.

text: And therefore fear not, let not thine heart be affrighted, but go thy way in, and see the beauty and greatness of the building, as much as thine eyes be able to see:
text_marked: And therefore fear not, let not thine heart be affrighted, but go thy way in, and see the beauty and greatness of the building, as much as thine eyes be able to see:

text: And then shalt thou hear as much as thine ears may comprehend.
text_marked: And then shalt thou hear as much as thine ears may comprehend.

text: For thou art blessed above many other, and art called with the Highest; and so are but few.
text_marked: For thou art blessed above many other, and art called with the Highest; and so are but few.

text: But to morrow at night thou shalt remain here;
text_marked: But to morrow at night thou shalt remain here;

text: And so shall the Highest shew thee visions of the high things, which the most High will do unto them that dwell upon the earth in the last days. So I slept that night and another, like as he commanded me.
text_marked: And so shall the Highest shew thee visions of the high things, which the most High will do unto them that dwell upon the earth in the last days. So I slept that night and another, like as he commanded me.

text: Then saw I a dream, and, behold, there came up from the sea an eagle, which had twelve feathered wings, and three heads.
text_marked: Then saw I a dream, and, behold, there came up from the sea an eagle, which had twelve feathered wings, and three heads.

text: And I saw, and, behold, she spread her wings over all the earth, and all the winds of the air blew on her, and were gathered together.
text_marked: And I saw, and, behold, she spread her wings over all the earth, and all the winds of the air blew on her, and were gathered together.

text: And I beheld, and out of her feathers there grew other contrary feathers; and they became little feathers and small.
text_marked: And I beheld, and out of her feathers there grew other contrary feathers; and they became little feathers and small.

text: But her heads were at rest: the head in the midst was greater than the other, yet rested it with the residue.
text_marked: But her heads were at rest: the head in the midst was greater than the other, yet rested it with the residue.

text: Moreover I beheld, and, lo, the eagle flew with her feathers, and reigned upon earth, and over them that dwelt therein.
text_marked: Moreover I beheld, and, lo, the eagle flew with her feathers, and reigned upon earth, and over them that dwelt therein.

text: And I saw that all things under heaven were subject unto her, and no man spake against her, no, not one creature upon earth.
text_marked: And I saw that all things under heaven were subject unto her, and no man spake against her, no, not one creature upon earth.

text: And I beheld, and, lo, the eagle rose upon her talons, and spake to her feathers, saying,
text_marked: And I beheld, and, lo, the eagle rose upon her talons, and spake to her feathers, saying,

text: Watch not all at once: sleep every one in his own place, and watch by course:
text_marked: Watch not all at once: sleep every one in his own place, and watch by course:

text: But let the heads be preserved for the last.
text_marked: But let the heads be preserved for the last.

text: And I beheld, and, lo, the voice went not out of her heads, but from the midst of her body.
text_marked: And I beheld, and, lo, the voice went not out of her heads, but from the midst of her body.

text: And I numbered her contrary feathers, and, behold, there were eight of them.
text_marked: And I numbered her contrary feathers, and, behold, there were eight of them.

text: And I looked, and, behold, on the right side there arose one feather, and reigned over all the earth;
text_marked: And I looked, and, behold, on the right side there arose one feather, and reigned over all the earth;

text: And so it was, that when it reigned, the end of it came, and the place thereof appeared no more: so the next following stood up. and reigned, and had a great time;
text_marked: And so it was, that when it reigned, the end of it came, and the place thereof appeared no more: so the next following stood up. and reigned, and had a great time;

text: And it happened, that when it reigned, the end of it came also, like as the first, so that it appeared no more.
text_marked: And it happened, that when it reigned, the end of it came also, like as the first, so that it appeared no more.

text: Then came there a voice unto it, and said,
text_marked: Then came there a voice unto it, and said,

text: Hear thou that hast borne rule over the earth so long: this I say unto thee, before thou beginnest to appear no more,
text_marked: Hear thou that hast borne rule over the earth so long: this I say unto thee, before thou beginnest to appear no more,

text: There shall none after thee attain unto thy time, neither unto the half thereof.
text_marked: There shall none after thee attain unto thy time, neither unto the half thereof.

text: Then arose the third, and reigned as the other before, and appeared no more also.
text_marked: Then arose the third, and reigned as the other before, and appeared no more also.

text: So went it with all the residue one after another, as that every one reigned, and then appeared no more.
text_marked: So went it with all the residue one after another, as that every one reigned, and then appeared no more.

text: Then I beheld, and, lo, in process of time the feathers that followed stood up upon the right side, that they might rule also; and some of them ruled, but within a while they appeared no more:
text_marked: Then I beheld, and, lo, in process of time the feathers that followed stood up upon the right side, that they might rule also; and some of them ruled, but within a while they appeared no more:

text: For some of them were set up, but ruled not.
text_marked: For some of them were set up, but ruled not.

text: After this I looked, and, behold, the twelve feathers appeared no more, nor the two little feathers:
text_marked: After this I looked, and, behold, the twelve feathers appeared no more, nor the two little feathers:

text: And there was no more upon the eagle’s body, but three heads that rested, and six little wings.
text_marked: And there was no more upon the eagle’s body, but three heads that rested, and six little wings.

text: Then saw I also that two little feathers divided themselves from the six, and remained under the head that was upon the right side: for the four continued in their place.
text_marked: Then saw I also that two little feathers divided themselves from the six, and remained under the head that was upon the right side: for the four continued in their place.

text: And I beheld, and, lo, the feathers that were under the wing thought to set up themselves and to have the rule.
text_marked: And I beheld, and, lo, the feathers that were under the wing thought to set up themselves and to have the rule.

text: And I beheld, and, lo, there was one set up, but shortly it appeared no more.
text_marked: And I beheld, and, lo, there was one set up, but shortly it appeared no more.

text: And the second was sooner away than the first.
text_marked: And the second was sooner away than the first.

text: And I beheld, and, lo, the two that remained thought also in themselves to reign:
text_marked: And I beheld, and, lo, the two that remained thought also in themselves to reign:

text: And when they so thought, behold, there awaked one of the heads that were at rest, namely, it that was in the midst; for that was greater than the two other heads.
text_marked: And when they so thought, behold, there awaked one of the heads that were at rest, namely, it that was in the midst; for that was greater than the two other heads.

text: And then I saw that the two other heads were joined with it.

text_marked: And, behold, the head was turned with them that were with it, and did eat up the two feathers under the wing that would have reigned.

text: But this head put the whole earth in fear, and bare rule in it over all those that dwelt upon the earth with much oppression; and it had the governance of the world more than all the wings that had been.
text_marked: But this head put the whole earth in fear, and bare rule in it over all those that dwelt upon the earth with much oppression; and it had the governance of the world more than all the wings that had been.

text: And after this I beheld, and, lo, the head that was in the midst suddenly appeared no more, like as the wings.

text: But there remained the two heads, which also in like sort ruled upon the earth, and over those that dwelt therein.

text: And I beheld, and, lo, the head upon the right side devoured it that was upon the left side.

text: Then I head a voice, which said unto me, Look before thee, and consider the thing that thou seest.

text: And I beheld, and lo, as it were a roaring lion chased out of the wood: and I saw that he sent out a man’s voice unto the eagle, and said,
text_marked: And I beheld, and lo, as it were a roaring lion chased out of the wood: and I saw that he sent out a man’s voice unto the eagle, and said,

text: Hear thou, I will talk with thee, and the Highest shall say unto thee,

text: Art not thou it that remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them?
text_marked: Art not thou it that remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them?

text: And the fourth came, and overcame all the beasts that were past, and had power over the world with great fearfulness, and over the whole compass of the earth with much wicked oppression; and so long time dwelt he upon the earth with deceit.
text_marked: And the fourth came, and overcame all the beasts that were past, and had power over the world with great fearfulness, and over the whole compass of the earth with much wicked oppression; and so long time dwelt he upon the earth with deceit.

text: For the earth hast thou not judged with truth.
text_marked: For the earth hast thou not judged with truth.

text: For thou hast afflicted the meek, thou hast hurt the peaceable, thou hast loved liars, and destroyed the dwellings of them that brought forth fruit, and hast cast down the walls of such as did thee no harm.
text_marked: For thou hast afflicted the meek, thou hast hurt the peaceable, thou hast loved liars, and destroyed the dwellings of them that brought forth fruit, and hast cast down the walls of such as did thee no harm.

text: Therefore is thy wrongful dealing come up unto the Highest, and thy pride unto the Mighty.
text_marked: Therefore is thy wrongful dealing come up unto the Highest, and thy pride unto the Mighty.

text: The Highest also hath looked upon the proud times, and, behold, they are ended, and his abominations are fulfilled.
text_marked: The Highest also hath looked upon the proud times, and, behold, they are ended, and his abominations are fulfilled.

text: And therefore appear no more, thou eagle, nor thy horrible wings, nor thy wicked feathers nor thy malicious heads, nor thy hurtful claws, nor all thy vain body:
text_marked: And therefore appear no more, thou eagle, nor thy horrible wings, nor thy wicked feathers nor thy malicious heads, nor thy hurtful claws, nor all thy vain body:

text_marked: That all the earth may be refreshed, and may return, being delivered from thy violence, and that she may hope for the judgment and mercy of him that made her.

text_marked: And I said, Lord that bearest rule, if I have found grace before thy sight, and if I am justified with thee before many others, and if my prayer indeed be come up before thy face;

text: Comfort me then, and shew me thy servant the interpretation and plain difference of this fearful vision, that thou mayest perfectly comfort my soul.
text_marked: Comfort me then, and shew me thy servant the interpretation and plain difference of this fearful vision, that thou mayest perfectly comfort my soul.

text: And he said unto me, This is the interpretation of the vision:
text_marked: And he said unto me, This is the interpretation of the vision:

text: The eagle, whom thou sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of thy brother Daniel.
text_marked: The eagle, whom thou sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of thy brother Daniel.

text: But it was not expounded unto him, therefore now I declare it unto thee.
text_marked: But it was not expounded unto him, therefore now I declare it unto thee.

text: Behold, the days will come, that there shall rise up a kingdom upon earth, and it shall be feared above all the kingdoms that were before it.
text_marked: Behold, the days will come, that there shall rise up a kingdom upon earth, and it shall be feared above all the kingdoms that were before it.

text: In the same shall twelve kings reign, one after another:
text_marked: In the same shall twelve kings reign, one after another:

text: Whereof the second shall begin to reign, and shall have more time than any of the twelve.
text_marked: Whereof the second shall begin to reign, and shall have more time than any of the twelve.

text: And this do the twelve wings signify, which thou sawest.
text_marked: And this do the twelve wings signify, which thou sawest.

text: As for the voice which thou heardest speak, and that thou sawest not to go out from the heads but from the midst of the body thereof, this is the interpretation:
text_marked: As for the voice which thou heardest speak, and that thou sawest not to go out from the heads but from the midst of the body thereof, this is the interpretation:

text: That after the time of that kingdom there shall arise great strivings, and it shall stand in peril of failing: nevertheless it shall not then fall, but shall be restored again to his beginning.
text_marked: That after the time of that kingdom there shall arise great strivings, and it shall stand in peril of failing: nevertheless it shall not then fall, but shall be restored again to his beginning.

text: And whereas thou sawest the eight small under feathers sticking to her wings, this is the interpretation:
text_marked: And whereas thou sawest the eight small under feathers sticking to her wings, this is the interpretation:

text: That in him there shall arise eight kings, whose times shall be but small, and their years swift.
text_marked: That in him there shall arise eight kings, whose times shall be but small, and their years swift.

text: And two of them shall perish, the middle time approaching: four shall be kept until their end begin to approach: but two shall be kept unto the end.
text_marked: And two of them shall perish, the middle time approaching: four shall be kept until their end begin to approach: but two shall be kept unto the end.

text: And whereas thou sawest three heads resting, this is the interpretation:
text_marked: And whereas thou sawest three heads resting, this is the interpretation:

text: In his last days shall the most High raise up three kingdoms, and renew many things therein, and they shall have the dominion of the earth,
text_marked: In his last days shall the most High raise up three kingdoms, and renew many things therein, and they shall have the dominion of the earth,

text: And of those that dwell therein, with much oppression, above all those that were before them: therefore are they called the heads of the eagle.
text_marked: And of those that dwell therein, with much oppression, above all those that were before them: therefore are they called the heads of the eagle.

text: For these are they that shall accomplish his wickedness, and that shall finish his last end.
text_marked: For these are they that shall accomplish his wickedness, and that shall finish his last end.

text: And whereas thou sawest that the great head appeared no more, it signifieth that one of them shall die upon his bed, and yet with pain.
text_marked: And whereas thou sawest that the great head appeared no more, it signifieth that one of them shall die upon his bed, and yet with pain.

text: For the two that remain shall be slain with the sword.
text_marked: For the two that remain shall be slain with the sword.

text: For the sword of the one shall devour the other: but at the last shall he fall through the sword himself.
text_marked: For the sword of the one shall devour the other: but at the last shall he fall through the sword himself.

text: And whereas thou sawest two feathers under the wings passing over the head that is on the right side;
text_marked: And whereas thou sawest two feathers under the wings passing over the head that is on the right side;

text: It signifieth that these are they, whom the Highest hath kept unto their end: this is the small kingdom and full of trouble, as thou sawest.
text_marked: It signifieth that these are they, whom the Highest hath kept unto their end: this is the small kingdom and full of trouble, as thou sawest.

text: And the lion, whom thou sawest rising up out of the wood, and roaring, and speaking to the eagle, and rebuking her for her unrighteousness with all the words which thou hast heard;
text_marked: And the lion, whom thou sawest rising up out of the wood, and roaring, and speaking to the eagle, and rebuking her for her unrighteousness with all the words which thou hast heard;

text: This is the anointed, which the Highest hath kept for them and for their wickedness unto the end: he shall reprove them, and shall upbraid them with their cruelty.
text_marked: This is the anointed, which the Highest hath kept for them and for their wickedness unto the end: he shall reprove them, and shall upbraid them with their cruelty.

text: For he shall set them before him alive in judgment, and shall rebuke them, and correct them.
text_marked: For he shall set them before him alive in judgment, and shall rebuke them, and correct them.

text: For the rest of my people shall he deliver with mercy, those that have been pressed upon my borders, and he shall make them joyful until the coming of the day of judgment, whereof I have spoken unto thee from the beginning.
text_marked: For the rest of my people shall he deliver with mercy, those that have been pressed upon my borders, and he shall make them joyful until the coming of the day of judgment, whereof I have spoken unto thee from the beginning.

text: This is the dream that thou sawest, and these are the interpretations.
text_marked: This is the dream that thou sawest, and these are the interpretations.

text: Thou only hast been meet to know this secret of the Highest.
text_marked: Thou only hast been meet to know this secret of the Highest.

text: Therefore write all these things that thou hast seen in a book, and hide them:
text_marked: Therefore write all these things that thou hast seen in a book, and hide them:

text: And teach them to the wise of the people, whose hearts thou knowest may comprehend and keep these secrets.
text_marked: And teach them to the wise of the people, whose hearts thou knowest may comprehend and keep these secrets.

text: But wait thou here thyself yet seven days more, that it may be shewed thee, whatsoever it pleaseth the Highest to declare unto thee. And with that he went his way.
text_marked: But wait thou here thyself yet seven days more, that it may be shewed thee, whatsoever it pleaseth the Highest to declare unto thee. And with that he went his way.

text: And it came to pass, when all the people saw that the seven days were past, and I not come again into the city, they gathered them all together, from the least unto the greatest, and came unto me, and said,
text_marked: And it came to pass, when all the people saw that the seven days were past, and I not come again into the city, they gathered them all together, from the least unto the greatest, and came unto me, and said,

text: What have we offended thee? and what evil have we done against thee, that thou forsakest us, and sittest here in this place?
text_marked: What have we offended thee? and what evil have we done against thee, that thou forsakest us, and sittest here in this place?

text: For of all the prophets thou only art left us, as a cluster of the vintage, and as a candle in a dark place, and as a haven or ship preserved from the tempest.
text_marked: For of all the prophets thou only art left us, as a cluster of the vintage, and as a candle in a dark place, and as a haven or ship preserved from the tempest.

text: Are not the evils which are come to us sufficient?
text_marked: Are not the evils which are come to us sufficient?

text: If thou shalt forsake us, how much better had it been for us, if we also had been burned in the midst of Sion?
text_marked: If thou shalt forsake us, how much better had it been for us, if we also had been burned in the midst of Sion?

text: For we are not better than they that died there. And they wept with a loud voice. Then answered I them, and said,
text_marked: For we are not better than they that died there. And they wept with a loud voice. Then answered I them, and said,

text: Be of good comfort, O Israel; and be not heavy, thou house of Jacob:
text_marked: Be of good comfort, O Israel; and be not heavy, thou house of Jacob:

text: For the Highest hath you in remembrance, and the Mighty hath not forgotten you in temptation.
text_marked: For the Highest hath you in remembrance, and the Mighty hath not forgotten you in temptation.

text: As for me, I have not forsaken you, neither am I departed from you: but am come into this place, to pray for the desolation of Sion, and that I might seek mercy for the low estate of your sanctuary.
text_marked: As for me, I have not forsaken you, neither am I departed from you: but am come into this place, to pray for the desolation of Sion, and that I might seek mercy for the low estate of your sanctuary.

text: And now go your way home every man, and after these days will I come unto you.
text_marked: And now go your way home every man, and after these days will I come unto you.

text: So the people went their way into the city, like as I commanded them:
text_marked: So the people went their way into the city, like as I commanded them:

text: But I remained still in the field seven days, as the angel commanded me; and did eat only in those days of the flowers of the field, and had my meat of the herbs.
text_marked: But I remained still in the field seven days, as the angel commanded me; and did eat only in those days of the flowers of the field, and had my meat of the herbs.

text: And it came to pass after seven days, I dreamed a dream by night:
text_marked: And it came to pass after seven days, I dreamed a dream by night:

text: And, lo, there arose a wind from the sea, that it moved all the waves thereof.
text_marked: And, lo, there arose a wind from the sea, that it moved all the waves thereof.

text: And I beheld, and, lo, that man waxed strong with the thousands of heaven: and when he turned his countenance to look, all the things trembled that were seen under him.
text_marked: And I beheld, and, lo, that man waxed strong with the thousands of heaven: and when he turned his countenance to look, all the things trembled that were seen under him.

text: And whensoever the voice went out of his mouth, all they burned that heard his voice, like as the earth faileth when it feeleth the fire.
text_marked: And whensoever the voice went out of his mouth, all they burned that heard his voice, like as the earth faileth when it feeleth the fire.

text: And after this I beheld, and, lo, there was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea
text_marked: And after this I beheld, and, lo, there was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea

text: But I beheld, and, lo, he had graved himself a great mountain, and flew up upon it.
text_marked: But I beheld, and, lo, he had graved himself a great mountain, and flew up upon it.

text: But I would have seen the region or place whereout the hill was graven, and I could not.
text_marked: But I would have seen the region or place whereout the hill was graven, and I could not.

text: And after this I beheld, and, lo, all they which were gathered together to subdue him were sore afraid, and yet durst fight.
text_marked: And after this I beheld, and, lo, all they which were gathered together to subdue him were sore afraid, and yet durst fight.

text: And, lo, as he saw the violence of the multitude that came, he neither lifted up his hand, nor held sword, nor any instrument of war:
text_marked: And, lo, as he saw the violence of the multitude that came, he neither lifted up his hand, nor held sword, nor any instrument of war:

text: But only I saw that he sent out of his mouth as it had been a blast of fire, and out of his lips a flaming breath, and out of his tongue he cast out sparks and tempests.
text_marked: But only I saw that he sent out of his mouth as it had been a blast of fire, and out of his lips a flaming breath, and out of his tongue he cast out sparks and tempests.

text: And they were all mixed together; the blast of fire, the flaming breath, and the great tempest; and fell with violence upon the multitude which was prepared to fight, and burned them up every one, so that upon a sudden of an innumerable multitude nothing was to be perceived, but only dust and smell of smoke: when I saw this I was afraid.
text_marked: And they were all mixed together; the blast of fire, the flaming breath, and the great tempest; and fell with violence upon the multitude which was prepared to fight, and burned them up every one, so that upon a sudden of an innumerable multitude nothing was to be perceived, but only dust and smell of smoke: when I saw this I was afraid.

text: Afterward saw I the same man come down from the mountain, and call unto him another peaceable Multitude.
text_marked: Afterward saw I the same man come down from the mountain, and call unto him another peaceable Multitude.

text: And there came much people unto him, whereof some were glad, some were sorry, and some of them were bound, and other some brought of them that were offered: then was I sick through great fear, and I awaked, and said,
text_marked: And there came much people unto him, whereof some were glad, some were sorry, and some of them were bound, and other some brought of them that were offered: then was I sick through great fear, and I awaked, and said,

text: Thou hast shewed thy servant these wonders from the beginning, and hast counted me worthy that thou shouldest receive my prayer:
text_marked: Thou hast shewed thy servant these wonders from the beginning, and hast counted me worthy that thou shouldest receive my prayer:

text: Shew me now yet the interpretation of this dream.
text_marked: Shew me now yet the interpretation of this dream.

text: For as I conceive in mine understanding, woe unto them that shall be left in those days and much more woe unto them that are not left behind!
text_marked: For as I conceive in mine understanding, woe unto them that shall be left in those days and much more woe unto them that are not left behind!

text: For they that were not left were in heaviness.
text_marked: For they that were not left were in heaviness.

text: Now understand I the things that are laid up in the latter days, which shall happen unto them, and to those that are left behind.
text_marked: Now understand I the things that are laid up in the latter days, which shall happen unto them, and to those that are left behind.

text: Therefore are they come into great perils and many necessities, like as these dreams declare.
text_marked: Therefore are they come into great perils and many necessities, like as these dreams declare.

text: Yet is it easier for him that is in danger to come into these things, than to pass away as a cloud out of the world, and not to see the things that happen in the last days. And he answered unto me, and said,
text_marked: Yet is it easier for him that is in danger to come into these things, than to pass away as a cloud out of the world, and not to see the things that happen in the last days. And he answered unto me, and said,

text: The interpretation of the vision shall I shew thee, and I will open unto thee the thing that thou hast required.
text_marked: The interpretation of the vision shall I shew thee, and I will open unto thee the thing that thou hast required.

text: Whereas thou hast spoken of them that are left behind, this is the interpretation:
text_marked: Whereas thou hast spoken of them that are left behind, this is the interpretation:

text: He that shall endure the peril in that time hath kept himself: they that be fallen into danger are such as have works, and faith toward the Almighty.
text_marked: He that shall endure the peril in that time hath kept himself: they that be fallen into danger are such as have works, and faith toward the Almighty.

text: Know this therefore, that they which be left behind are more blessed than they that be dead.
text_marked: Know this therefore, that they which be left behind are more blessed than they that be dead.

text: This is the meaning of the vision: Whereas thou sawest a man coming up from the midst of the sea:
text_marked: This is the meaning of the vision: Whereas thou sawest a man coming up from the midst of the sea:

text: The same is he whom God the Highest hath kept a great season, which by his own self shall deliver his creature: and he shall order them that are left behind.
text_marked: The same is he whom God the Highest hath kept a great season, which by his own self shall deliver his creature: and he shall order them that are left behind.

text: And whereas thou sawest, that out of his mouth there came as a blast of wind, and fire, and storm;
text_marked: And whereas thou sawest, that out of his mouth there came as a blast of wind, and fire, and storm;

text: And that he held neither sword, nor any instrument of war, but that the rushing in of him destroyed the whole multitude that came to subdue him; this is the interpretation:
text_marked: And that he held neither sword, nor any instrument of war, but that the rushing in of him destroyed the whole multitude that came to subdue him; this is the interpretation:

text: Behold, the days come, when the most High will begin to deliver them that are upon the earth.
text_marked: Behold, the days come, when the most High will begin to deliver them that are upon the earth.

text: And he shall come to the astonishment of them that dwell on the earth.
text_marked: And he shall come to the astonishment of them that dwell on the earth.

text: And one shall undertake to fight against another, one city against another, one place against another, one people against another, and one realm against another.
text_marked: And one shall undertake to fight against another, one city against another, one place against another, one people against another, and one realm against another.

text: And the time shall be when these things shall come to pass, and the signs shall happen which I shewed thee before, and then shall my Son be declared, whom thou sawest as a man ascending.
text_marked: And the time shall be when these things shall come to pass, and the signs shall happen which I shewed thee before, and then shall my Son be declared, whom thou sawest as a man ascending.

text: And when all the people hear his voice, every man shall in their own land leave the battle they have one against another.
text_marked: And when all the people hear his voice, every man shall in their own land leave the battle they have one against another.

text: And an innumerable multitude shall be gathered together, as thou sawest them, willing to come, and to overcome him by fighting.
text_marked: And an innumerable multitude shall be gathered together, as thou sawest them, willing to come, and to overcome him by fighting.

text: But he shall stand upon the top of the mount Sion.
text_marked: But he shall stand upon the top of the mount Sion.

text: And Sion shall come, and shall be shewed to all men, being prepared and builded, like as thou sawest the hill graven without hands.
text_marked: And Sion shall come, and shall be shewed to all men, being prepared and builded, like as thou sawest the hill graven without hands.

text: And this my Son shall rebuke the wicked inventions of those nations, which for their wicked life are fallen into the tempest;
text_marked: And this my Son shall rebuke the wicked inventions of those nations, which for their wicked life are fallen into the tempest;

text: And shall lay before them their evil thoughts, and the torments wherewith they shall begin to be tormented, which are like unto a flame: and he shall destroy them without labour by the law which is like unto fire.
text_marked: And shall lay before them their evil thoughts, and the torments wherewith they shall begin to be tormented, which are like unto a flame: and he shall destroy them without labour by the law which is like unto fire.

text: And whereas thou sawest that he gathered another peaceable multitude unto him;
text_marked: And whereas thou sawest that he gathered another peaceable multitude unto him;

text: Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive, and he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land.
text_marked: Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive, and he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land.

text: But they took this counsel among themselves, that they would leave the multitude of the heathen, and go forth into a further country, where never mankind dwelt,
text_marked: But they took this counsel among themselves, that they would leave the multitude of the heathen, and go forth into a further country, where never mankind dwelt,

text: That they might there keep their statutes, which they never kept in their own land.
text_marked: That they might there keep their statutes, which they never kept in their own land.

text: And they entered into Euphrates by the narrow places of the river.
text_marked: And they entered into Euphrates by the narrow places of the river.

text: For the most High then shewed signs for them, and held still the flood, till they were passed over.
text_marked: For the most High then shewed signs for them, and held still the flood, till they were passed over.

text: For through that country there was a great way to go, namely, of a year and a half: and the same region is called Arsareth.
text_marked: For through that country there was a great way to go, namely, of a year and a half: and the same region is called Arsareth.

text: Then dwelt they there until the latter time; and now when they shall begin to come,
text_marked: Then dwelt they there until the latter time; and now when they shall begin to come,

text: The Highest shall stay the springs of the stream again, that they may go through: therefore sawest thou the multitude with peace.
text_marked: The Highest shall stay the springs of the stream again, that they may go through: therefore sawest thou the multitude with peace.

text: But those that be left behind of thy people are they that are found within my borders.
text_marked: But those that be left behind of thy people are they that are found within my borders.

text: Now when he destroyeth the multitude of the nations that are gathered together, he shall defend his people that remain.
text_marked: Now when he destroyeth the multitude of the nations that are gathered together, he shall defend his people that remain.

text: And then shall he shew them great wonders.
text_marked: And then shall he shew them great wonders.

text: Then said I, O Lord that bearest rule, shew me this: Wherefore have I seen the man coming up from the midst of the sea?
text_marked: Then said I, O Lord that bearest rule, shew me this: Wherefore have I seen the man coming up from the midst of the sea?

text: And he said unto me, Like as thou canst neither seek out nor know the things that are in the deep of the sea: even so can no man upon earth see my Son, or those that be with him, but in the day time.
text_marked: And he said unto me, Like as thou canst neither seek out nor know the things that are in the deep of the sea: even so can no man upon earth see my Son, or those that be with him, but in the day time.

text: This is the interpretation of the dream which thou sawest, and whereby thou only art here lightened.
text_marked: This is the interpretation of the dream which thou sawest, and whereby thou only art here lightened.

text: For thou hast forsaken thine own way, and applied thy diligence unto my law, and sought it.
text_marked: For thou hast forsaken thine own way, and applied thy diligence unto my law, and sought it.

text: Thy life hast thou ordered in wisdom, and hast called understanding thy mother.
text_marked: Thy life hast thou ordered in wisdom, and hast called understanding thy mother.

text: And therefore have I shewed thee the treasures of the Highest: after other three days I will speak other things unto thee, and declare unto thee mighty and wondrous things.
text_marked: And therefore have I shewed thee the treasures of the Highest: after other three days I will speak other things unto thee, and declare unto thee mighty and wondrous things.

text: Then went I forth into the field, giving praise and thanks greatly unto the most High because of his wonders which he did in time;
text_marked: Then went I forth into the field, giving praise and thanks greatly unto the most High because of his wonders which he did in time;

text: And because he governeth the same, and such things as fall in their seasons: and there I sat three days.
text_marked: And because he governeth the same, and such things as fall in their seasons: and there I sat three days.

text: And it came to pass upon the third day, I sat under an oak, and, behold, there came a voice out of a bush over against me, and said, Esdras, Esdras.
text_marked: And it came to pass upon the third day, I sat under an oak, and, behold, there came a voice out of a bush over against me, and said, Esdras, Esdras.

text: And I said, Here am I, Lord And I stood up upon my feet.
text_marked: And I said, Here am I, Lord And I stood up upon my feet.

text: Then said he unto me, In the bush I did manifestly reveal myself unto Moses, and talked with him, when my people served in Egypt:
text_marked: Then said he unto me, In the bush I did manifestly reveal myself unto Moses, and talked with him, when my people served in Egypt:

text: And I sent him and led my people out of Egypt, and brought him up to the mount of where I held him by me a long season,
text_marked: And I sent him and led my people out of Egypt, and brought him up to the mount of where I held him by me a long season,

text: And told him many wondrous things, and shewed him the secrets of the times, and the end; and commanded him, saying,
text_marked: And told him many wondrous things, and shewed him the secrets of the times, and the end; and commanded him, saying,

text: These words shalt thou declare, and these shalt thou hide.
text_marked: These words shalt thou declare, and these shalt thou hide.

text: And now I say unto thee,
text_marked: And now I say unto thee,

text: That thou lay up in thy heart the signs that I have shewed, and the dreams that thou hast seen, and the interpretations which thou hast heard:
text_marked: That thou lay up in thy heart the signs that I have shewed, and the dreams that thou hast seen, and the interpretations which thou hast heard:

text: For thou shalt be taken away from all, and from henceforth thou shalt remain with my Son, and with such as be like thee, until the times be ended.
text_marked: For thou shalt be taken away from all, and from henceforth thou shalt remain with my Son, and with such as be like thee, until the times be ended.

text: For the world hath lost his youth, and the times begin to wax old.
text_marked: For the world hath lost his youth, and the times begin to wax old.

text: For the world is divided into twelve parts, and the ten parts of it are gone already, and half of a tenth part:
text_marked: For the world is divided into twelve parts, and the ten parts of it are gone already, and half of a tenth part:

text: And there remaineth that which is after the half of the tenth part.
text_marked: And there remaineth that which is after the half of the tenth part.

text: Now therefore set thine house in order, and reprove thy people, comfort such of them as be in trouble, and now renounce corruption,
text_marked: Now therefore set thine house in order, and reprove thy people, comfort such of them as be in trouble, and now renounce corruption,

text: Let go from thee mortal thoughts, cast away the burdens of man, put off now the weak nature,
text_marked: Let go from thee mortal thoughts, cast away the burdens of man, put off now the weak nature,

text: And set aside the thoughts that are most heavy unto thee, and haste thee to flee from these times.
text_marked: And set aside the thoughts that are most heavy unto thee, and haste thee to flee from these times.

text: For yet greater evils than those which thou hast seen happen shall be done hereafter.
text_marked: For yet greater evils than those which thou hast seen happen shall be done hereafter.

text: For look how much the world shall be weaker through age, so much the more shall evils increase upon them that dwell therein.
text_marked: For look how much the world shall be weaker through age, so much the more shall evils increase upon them that dwell therein.

text: For the time is fled far away, and leasing is hard at hand: for now hasteth the vision to come, which thou hast seen.
text_marked: For the time is fled far away, and leasing is hard at hand: for now hasteth the vision to come, which thou hast seen.

text: Then answered I before thee, and said,
text_marked: Then answered I before thee, and said,

text: Behold, Lord, I will go, as thou hast commanded me, and reprove the people which are present: but they that shall be born afterward, who shall admonish them? thus the world is set in darkness, and they that dwell therein are without light.
text_marked: Behold, Lord, I will go, as thou hast commanded me, and reprove the people which are present: but they that shall be born afterward, who shall admonish them? thus the world is set in darkness, and they that dwell therein are without light.

text: For thy law is burnt, therefore no man knoweth the things that are done of thee, or the work that shall begin.
text_marked: For thy law is burnt, therefore no man knoweth the things that are done of thee, or the work that shall begin.

text: But if I have found grace before thee, send the Holy Ghost into me, and I shall write all that hath been done in the world since the beginning, which were written in thy law, that men may find thy path, and that they which will live in the latter days may live.
text_marked: But if I have found grace before thee, send the Holy Ghost into me, and I shall write all that hath been done in the world since the beginning, which were written in thy law, that men may find thy path, and that they which will live in the latter days may live.

text: And he answered me, saying, Go thy way, gather the people together, and say unto them, that they seek thee not for forty days.
text_marked: And he answered me, saying, Go thy way, gather the people together, and say unto them, that they seek thee not for forty days.

text: But look thou prepare thee many box trees, and take with thee Sarea, Dabria, Selemia, Ecanus, and Asiel, these five which are ready to write swiftly;
text_marked: But look thou prepare thee many box trees, and take with thee Sarea, Dabria, Selemia, Ecanus, and Asiel, these five which are ready to write swiftly;

text: And come hither, and I shall light a candle of understanding in thine heart, which shall not be put out, till the things be performed which thou shalt begin to write.
text_marked: And come hither, and I shall light a candle of understanding in thine heart, which shall not be put out, till the things be performed which thou shalt begin to write.

text: And when thou hast done, some things shalt thou publish, and some things shalt thou shew secretly to the wise: to morrow this hour shalt thou begin to write.
text_marked: And when thou hast done, some things shalt thou publish, and some things shalt thou shew secretly to the wise: to morrow this hour shalt thou begin to write.

text: Then went I forth, as he commanded, and gathered all the people together, and said,
text_marked: Then went I forth, as he commanded, and gathered all the people together, and said,

text: Hear these words, O Israel.
text_marked: Hear these words, O Israel.

text: Our fathers at the beginning were strangers in Egypt, from whence they were delivered:
text_marked: Our fathers at the beginning were strangers in Egypt, from whence they were delivered:

text: And received the law of life, which they kept not, which ye also have transgressed after them.
text_marked: And received the law of life, which they kept not, which ye also have transgressed after them.

text: Then was the land, even the land of Sion, parted among you by lot: but your fathers, and ye yourselves, have done unrighteousness, and have not kept the ways which the Highest commanded you.
text_marked: Then was the land, even the land of Sion, parted among you by lot: but your fathers, and ye yourselves, have done unrighteousness, and have not kept the ways which the Highest commanded you.

text: And forasmuch as he is a righteous judge, he took from you in time the thing that he had given you.
text_marked: And forasmuch as he is a righteous judge, he took from you in time the thing that he had given you.

text: And now are ye here, and your brethren among you.
text_marked: And now are ye here, and your brethren among you.

text: Therefore if so be that ye will subdue your own understanding, and reform your hearts, ye shall be kept alive and after death ye shall obtain mercy.
text_marked: Therefore if so be that ye will subdue your own understanding, and reform your hearts, ye shall be kept alive and after death ye shall obtain mercy.

text: For after death shall the judgment come, when we shall live again: and then shall the names of the righteous be manifest, and the works of the ungodly shall be declared.
text_marked: For after death shall the judgment come, when we shall live again: and then shall the names of the righteous be manifest, and the works of the ungodly shall be declared.

text: Let no man therefore come unto me now, nor seek after me these forty days.
text_marked: Let no man therefore come unto me now, nor seek after me these forty days.

text: So I took the five men, as he commanded me, and we went into the field, and remained there.
text_marked: So I took the five men, as he commanded me, and we went into the field, and remained there.

text: And the next day, behold, a voice called me, saying, Esdras, open thy mouth, and drink that I give thee to drink.
text_marked: And the next day, behold, a voice called me, saying, Esdras, open thy mouth, and drink that I give thee to drink.

text: Then opened I my mouth, and, behold, he reached me a full cup, which was full as it were with water, but the colour of it was like fire.
text_marked: Then opened I my mouth, and, behold, he reached me a full cup, which was full as it were with water, but the colour of it was like fire.

text: And I took it, and drank: and when I had drunk of it, my heart uttered understanding, and wisdom grew in my breast, for my spirit strengthened my memory:
text_marked: And I took it, and drank: and when I had drunk of it, my heart uttered understanding, and wisdom grew in my breast, for my spirit strengthened my memory:

text: And my mouth was opened, and shut no more.
text_marked: And my mouth was opened, and shut no more.

text: The Highest gave understanding unto the five men, and they wrote the wonderful visions of the night that were told, which they knew not: and they sat forty days, and they wrote in the day, and at night they ate bread.
text_marked: The Highest gave understanding unto the five men, and they wrote the wonderful visions of the night that were told, which they knew not: and they sat forty days, and they wrote in the day, and at night they ate bread.

text: As for me. I spake in the day, and I held not my tongue by night.
text_marked: As for me. I spake in the day, and I held not my tongue by night.

text: In forty days they wrote two hundred and four books.
text_marked: In forty days they wrote two hundred and four books.

text: And it came to pass, when the forty days were filled, that the Highest spake, saying, The first that thou hast written publish openly, that the worthy and unworthy may read it:
text_marked: And it came to pass, when the forty days were filled, that the Highest spake, saying, The first that thou hast written publish openly, that the worthy and unworthy may read it:

text: But keep the seventy last, that thou mayest deliver them only to such as be wise among the people:
text_marked: But keep the seventy last, that thou mayest deliver them only to such as be wise among the people:

text: For in them is the spring of understanding, the fountain of wisdom, and the stream of knowledge.
text_marked: For in them is the spring of understanding, the fountain of wisdom, and the stream of knowledge.

text: And I did so.
text_marked: And I did so.

text: Behold, speak thou in the ears of my people the words of prophecy, which I will put in thy mouth, saith the Lord:
text_marked: Behold, speak thou in the ears of my people the words of prophecy, which I will put in thy mouth, saith the Lord:

text: And cause them to be written in paper: for they are faithful and true.
text_marked: And cause them to be written in paper: for they are faithful and true.

text: Fear not the imaginations against thee, let not the incredulity of them trouble thee, that speak against thee.
text_marked: Fear not the imaginations against thee, let not the incredulity of them trouble thee, that speak against thee.

text: For all the unfaithful shall die in their unfaithfulness.
text_marked: For all the unfaithful shall die in their unfaithfulness.

text: Behold, saith the Lord, I will bring plagues upon the world; the sword, famine, death, and destruction.
text_marked: Behold, saith the Lord, I will bring plagues upon the world; the sword, famine, death, and destruction.

text: For wickedness hath exceedingly polluted the whole earth, and their hurtful works are fulfilled.
text_marked: For wickedness hath exceedingly polluted the whole earth, and their hurtful works are fulfilled.

text: Therefore saith the Lord,
text_marked: Therefore saith the Lord,

text: I will hold my tongue no more as touching their wickedness, which they profanely commit, neither will I suffer them in those things, in which they wickedly exercise themselves: behold, the innocent and righteous blood crieth unto me, and the souls of the just complain continually.
text_marked: I will hold my tongue no more as touching their wickedness, which they profanely commit, neither will I suffer them in those things, in which they wickedly exercise themselves: behold, the innocent and righteous blood crieth unto me, and the souls of the just complain continually.

text: And therefore, saith the Lord, I will surely avenge them, and receive unto me all the innocent blood from among them.
text_marked: And therefore, saith the Lord, I will surely avenge them, and receive unto me all the innocent blood from among them.

text: Behold, my people is led as a flock to the slaughter: I will not suffer them now to dwell in the land of Egypt:
text_marked: Behold, my people is led as a flock to the slaughter: I will not suffer them now to dwell in the land of Egypt:

text: But I will bring them with a mighty hand and a stretched out arm, and smite Egypt with plagues, as before, and will destroy all the land thereof.
text_marked: But I will bring them with a mighty hand and a stretched out arm, and smite Egypt with plagues, as before, and will destroy all the land thereof.

text: Egypt shall mourn, and the foundation of it shall be smitten with the plague and punishment that God shall bring upon it.
text_marked: Egypt shall mourn, and the foundation of it shall be smitten with the plague and punishment that God shall bring upon it.

text: They that till the ground shall mourn: for their seeds shall fail through the blasting and hail, and with a fearful constellation.
text_marked: They that till the ground shall mourn: for their seeds shall fail through the blasting and hail, and with a fearful constellation.

text: Woe to the world and them that dwell therein!
text_marked: Woe to the world and them that dwell therein!

text: For the sword and their destruction draweth nigh, and one people shall stand up and fight against another, and swords in their hands.
text_marked: For the sword and their destruction draweth nigh, and one people shall stand up and fight against another, and swords in their hands.

text: For there shall be sedition among men, and invading one another; they shall not regard their kings nor princes, and the course of their actions shall stand in their power.
text_marked: For there shall be sedition among men, and invading one another; they shall not regard their kings nor princes, and the course of their actions shall stand in their power.

text: A man shall desire to go into a city, and shall not be able.
text_marked: A man shall desire to go into a city, and shall not be able.

text: For because of their pride the cities shall be troubled, the houses shall be destroyed, and men shall be afraid.
text_marked: For because of their pride the cities shall be troubled, the houses shall be destroyed, and men shall be afraid.

text: A man shall have no pity upon his neighbour, but shall destroy their houses with the sword, and spoil their goods, because of the lack of bread, and for great tribulation.
text_marked: A man shall have no pity upon his neighbour, but shall destroy their houses with the sword, and spoil their goods, because of the lack of bread, and for great tribulation.

text: Behold, saith God, I will call together all the kings of the earth to reverence me, which are from the rising of the sun, from the south, from the east, and Libanus; to turn themselves one against another, and repay the things that they have done to them.
text_marked: Behold, saith God, I will call together all the kings of the earth to reverence me, which are from the rising of the sun, from the south, from the east, and Libanus; to turn themselves one against another, and repay the things that they have done to them.

text: Like as they do yet this day unto my chosen, so will I do also, and recompense in their bosom. Thus saith the Lord God;
text_marked: Like as they do yet this day unto my chosen, so will I do also, and recompense in their bosom. Thus saith the Lord God;

text: My right hand shall not spare the sinners, and my sword shall not cease over them that shed innocent blood upon the earth.
text_marked: My right hand shall not spare the sinners, and my sword shall not cease over them that shed innocent blood upon the earth.

text: The fire is gone forth from his wrath, and hath consumed the foundations of the earth, and the sinners, like the straw that is kindled.
text_marked: The fire is gone forth from his wrath, and hath consumed the foundations of the earth, and the sinners, like the straw that is kindled.

text: Woe to them that sin, and keep not my commandments! saith the Lord.
text_marked: Woe to them that sin, and keep not my commandments! saith the Lord.

text: I will not spare them: go your way, ye children, from the power, defile not my sanctuary.
text_marked: I will not spare them: go your way, ye children, from the power, defile not my sanctuary.

text: For the Lord knoweth all them that sin against him, and therefore delivereth he them unto death and destruction.
text_marked: For the Lord knoweth all them that sin against him, and therefore delivereth he them unto death and destruction.

text: For now are the plagues come upon the whole earth and ye shall remain in them: for God shall not deliver you, because ye have sinned against him.
text_marked: For now are the plagues come upon the whole earth and ye shall remain in them: for God shall not deliver you, because ye have sinned against him.

text: Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east:
text_marked: Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east:

text: Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots, and the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth, that all they which hear them may fear and tremble.
text_marked: Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots, and the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth, that all they which hear them may fear and tremble.

text: Also the Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood, and with great power shall they come, and join battle with them, and shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians.
text_marked: Also the Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood, and with great power shall they come, and join battle with them, and shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians.

text: And then shall the dragons have the upper hand, remembering their nature; and if they shall turn themselves, conspiring together in great power to persecute them,
text_marked: And then shall the dragons have the upper hand, remembering their nature; and if they shall turn themselves, conspiring together in great power to persecute them,

text: Then these shall be troubled bled, and keep silence through their power, and shall flee.
text_marked: Then these shall be troubled bled, and keep silence through their power, and shall flee.

text: And from the land of the Assyrians shall the enemy besiege them, and consume some of them, and in their host shall be fear and dread, and strife among their kings.
text_marked: And from the land of the Assyrians shall the enemy besiege them, and consume some of them, and in their host shall be fear and dread, and strife among their kings.

text: Behold clouds from the east and from the north unto the south, and they are very horrible to look upon, full of wrath and storm.
text_marked: Behold clouds from the east and from the north unto the south, and they are very horrible to look upon, full of wrath and storm.

text: They shall smite one upon another, and they shall smite down a great multitude of stars upon the earth, even their own star; and blood shall be from the sword unto the belly,
text_marked: They shall smite one upon another, and they shall smite down a great multitude of stars upon the earth, even their own star; and blood shall be from the sword unto the belly,

text: And dung of men unto the camel’s hough.
text_marked: And dung of men unto the camel’s hough.

text: And there shall be great fearfulness and trembling upon earth: and they that see the wrath shall be afraid, and trembling shall come upon them.
text_marked: And there shall be great fearfulness and trembling upon earth: and they that see the wrath shall be afraid, and trembling shall come upon them.

text: And then shall there come great storms from the south, and from the north, and another part from the west.
text_marked: And then shall there come great storms from the south, and from the north, and another part from the west.

text: And strong winds shall arise from the east, and shall open it; and the cloud which he raised up in wrath, and the star stirred to cause fear toward the east and west wind, shall be destroyed.
text_marked: And strong winds shall arise from the east, and shall open it; and the cloud which he raised up in wrath, and the star stirred to cause fear toward the east and west wind, shall be destroyed.

text: The great and mighty clouds shall be puffed up full of wrath, and the star, that they may make all the earth afraid, and them that dwell therein; and they shall pour out over every high and eminent place an horrible star,
text_marked: The great and mighty clouds shall be puffed up full of wrath, and the star, that they may make all the earth afraid, and them that dwell therein; and they shall pour out over every high and eminent place an horrible star,

text: Fire, and hail, and flying swords, and many waters, that all fields may be full, and all rivers, with the abundance of great waters.
text_marked: Fire, and hail, and flying swords, and many waters, that all fields may be full, and all rivers, with the abundance of great waters.

text: And they shall break down the cities and walls, mountains and hills, trees of the wood, and grass of the meadows, and their corn.
text_marked: And they shall break down the cities and walls, mountains and hills, trees of the wood, and grass of the meadows, and their corn.

text: And they shall go stedfastly unto Babylon, and make her afraid.
text_marked: And they shall go stedfastly unto Babylon, and make her afraid.

text: They shall come to her, and besiege her, the star and all wrath shall they pour out upon her: then shall the dust and smoke go up unto the heaven, and all they that be about her shall bewail her.
text_marked: They shall come to her, and besiege her, the star and all wrath shall they pour out upon her: then shall the dust and smoke go up unto the heaven, and all they that be about her shall bewail her.

text: And they that remain under her shall do service unto them that have put her in fear.
text_marked: And they that remain under her shall do service unto them that have put her in fear.

text: And thou, Asia, that art partaker of the hope of Babylon, and art the glory of her person:
text_marked: And thou, Asia, that art partaker of the hope of Babylon, and art the glory of her person:

text: Woe be unto thee, thou wretch, because thou hast made thyself like unto her; and hast decked thy daughters in whoredom, that they might please and glory in thy lovers, which have always desired to commit whoredom with thee.
text_marked: Woe be unto thee, thou wretch, because thou hast made thyself like unto her; and hast decked thy daughters in whoredom, that they might please and glory in thy lovers, which have always desired to commit whoredom with thee.

text: Thou hast followed her that is hated in all her works and inventions: therefore saith God,
text_marked: Thou hast followed her that is hated in all her works and inventions: therefore saith God,

text: I will send plagues upon thee; widowhood, poverty, famine, sword, and pestilence, to waste thy houses with destruction and death.
text_marked: I will send plagues upon thee; widowhood, poverty, famine, sword, and pestilence, to waste thy houses with destruction and death.

text: And the glory of thy Power shall be dried up as a flower, the heat shall arise that is sent over thee.
text_marked: And the glory of thy Power shall be dried up as a flower, the heat shall arise that is sent over thee.

text: Thou shalt be weakened as a poor woman with stripes, and as one chastised with wounds, so that the mighty and lovers shall not be able to receive thee.
text_marked: Thou shalt be weakened as a poor woman with stripes, and as one chastised with wounds, so that the mighty and lovers shall not be able to receive thee.

text: Would I with jealousy have so proceeded against thee, saith the Lord,
text_marked: Would I with jealousy have so proceeded against thee, saith the Lord,

text: If thou hadst not always slain my chosen, exalting the stroke of thine hands, and saying over their dead, when thou wast drunken,
text_marked: If thou hadst not always slain my chosen, exalting the stroke of thine hands, and saying over their dead, when thou wast drunken,

text: Set forth the beauty of thy countenance?
text_marked: Set forth the beauty of thy countenance?

text: The reward of thy whoredom shall be in thy bosom, therefore shalt thou receive recompence.
text_marked: The reward of thy whoredom shall be in thy bosom, therefore shalt thou receive recompence.

text: Like as thou hast done unto my chosen, saith the Lord, even so shall God do unto thee, and shall deliver thee into mischief
text_marked: Like as thou hast done unto my chosen, saith the Lord, even so shall God do unto thee, and shall deliver thee into mischief

text: Thy children shall die of hunger, and thou shalt fall through the sword: thy cities shall be broken down, and all thine shall perish with the sword in the field.
text_marked: Thy children shall die of hunger, and thou shalt fall through the sword: thy cities shall be broken down, and all thine shall perish with the sword in the field.

text: They that be in the mountains shall die of hunger, and eat their own flesh, and drink their own blood, for very hunger of bread, and thirst of water.
text_marked: They that be in the mountains shall die of hunger, and eat their own flesh, and drink their own blood, for very hunger of bread, and thirst of water.

text: Thou as unhappy shalt come through the sea, and receive plagues again.
text_marked: Thou as unhappy shalt come through the sea, and receive plagues again.

text: And in the passage they shall rush on the idle city, and shall destroy some portion of thy land, and consume part of thy glory, and shall return to Babylon that was destroyed.
text_marked: And in the passage they shall rush on the idle city, and shall destroy some portion of thy land, and consume part of thy glory, and shall return to Babylon that was destroyed.

text: And thou shalt be cast down by them as stubble, and they shall be unto thee as fire;
text_marked: And thou shalt be cast down by them as stubble, and they shall be unto thee as fire;

text: And shall consume thee, and thy cities, thy land, and thy mountains; all thy woods and thy fruitful trees shall they burn up with fire.
text_marked: And shall consume thee, and thy cities, thy land, and thy mountains; all thy woods and thy fruitful trees shall they burn up with fire.

text: Thy children shall they carry away captive, and, look, what thou hast, they shall spoil it, and mar the beauty of thy face.
text_marked: Thy children shall they carry away captive, and, look, what thou hast, they shall spoil it, and mar the beauty of thy face.

text: Woe be unto thee, Babylon, and Asia! woe be unto thee, Egypt and Syria!
text_marked: Woe be unto thee, Babylon, and Asia! woe be unto thee, Egypt and Syria!

text: Gird up yourselves with cloths of sack and hair, bewail your children, and be sorry; for your destruction is at hand.
text_marked: Gird up yourselves with cloths of sack and hair, bewail your children, and be sorry; for your destruction is at hand.

text: A sword is sent upon you, and who may turn it back?
text_marked: A sword is sent upon you, and who may turn it back?

text: A fire is sent among you, and who may quench it?
text_marked: A fire is sent among you, and who may quench it?

text: Plagues are sent unto you, and what is he that may drive them away?
text_marked: Plagues are sent unto you, and what is he that may drive them away?

text: May any man drive away an hungry lion in the wood? or may any one quench the fire in stubble, when it hath begun to burn?
text_marked: May any man drive away an hungry lion in the wood? or may any one quench the fire in stubble, when it hath begun to burn?

text: May one turn again the arrow that is shot of a strong archer?
text_marked: May one turn again the arrow that is shot of a strong archer?

text: The mighty Lord sendeth the plagues and who is he that can drive them away?
text_marked: The mighty Lord sendeth the plagues and who is he that can drive them away?

text: A fire shall go forth from his wrath, and who is he that may quench it?
text_marked: A fire shall go forth from his wrath, and who is he that may quench it?

text: He shall cast lightnings, and who shall not fear? he shall thunder, and who shall not be afraid?
text_marked: He shall cast lightnings, and who shall not fear? he shall thunder, and who shall not be afraid?

text: The Lord shall threaten, and who shall not be utterly beaten to powder at his presence?
text_marked: The Lord shall threaten, and who shall not be utterly beaten to powder at his presence?

text: The earth quaketh, and the foundations thereof; the sea ariseth up with waves from the deep, and the waves of it are troubled, and the fishes thereof also, before the Lord, and before the glory of his power:
text_marked: The earth quaketh, and the foundations thereof; the sea ariseth up with waves from the deep, and the waves of it are troubled, and the fishes thereof also, before the Lord, and before the glory of his power:

text: For strong is his right hand that bendeth the bow, his arrows that he shooteth are sharp, and shall not miss, when they begin to be shot into the ends of the world.
text_marked: For strong is his right hand that bendeth the bow, his arrows that he shooteth are sharp, and shall not miss, when they begin to be shot into the ends of the world.

text: Behold, the plagues are sent, and shall not return again, until they come upon the earth.
text_marked: Behold, the plagues are sent, and shall not return again, until they come upon the earth.

text: The fire is kindled, and shall not be put out, till it consume the foundation of the earth.
text_marked: The fire is kindled, and shall not be put out, till it consume the foundation of the earth.

text: Like as an arrow which is shot of a mighty archer returneth not backward: even so the plagues that shall be sent upon earth shall not return again.
text_marked: Like as an arrow which is shot of a mighty archer returneth not backward: even so the plagues that shall be sent upon earth shall not return again.

text: Woe is me! woe is me! who will deliver me in those days?
text_marked: Woe is me! woe is me! who will deliver me in those days?

text: The beginning of sorrows and great mournings; the beginning of famine and great death; the beginning of wars, and the powers shall stand in fear; the beginning of evils! what shall I do when these evils shall come?
text_marked: The beginning of sorrows and great mournings; the beginning of famine and great death; the beginning of wars, and the powers shall stand in fear; the beginning of evils! what shall I do when these evils shall come?

text: Behold, famine and plague, tribulation and anguish, are sent as scourges for amendment.
text_marked: Behold, famine and plague, tribulation and anguish, are sent as scourges for amendment.

text: But for all these things they shall not turn from their wickedness, nor be always mindful of the scourges.
text_marked: But for all these things they shall not turn from their wickedness, nor be always mindful of the scourges.

text: Behold, victuals shall be so good cheap upon earth, that they shall think themselves to be in good case, and even then shall evils grow upon earth, sword, famine, and great confusion.
text_marked: Behold, victuals shall be so good cheap upon earth, that they shall think themselves to be in good case, and even then shall evils grow upon earth, sword, famine, and great confusion.

text: For many of them that dwell upon earth shall perish of famine; and the other, that escape the hunger, shall the sword destroy.
text_marked: For many of them that dwell upon earth shall perish of famine; and the other, that escape the hunger, shall the sword destroy.

text: And the dead shall be cast out as dung, and there shall be no man to comfort them: for the earth shall be wasted, and the cities shall be cast down.
text_marked: And the dead shall be cast out as dung, and there shall be no man to comfort them: for the earth shall be wasted, and the cities shall be cast down.

text: There shall be no man left to till the earth, and to sow it
text_marked: There shall be no man left to till the earth, and to sow it

text: The trees shall give fruit, and who shall gather them?
text_marked: The trees shall give fruit, and who shall gather them?

text: The grapes shall ripen, and who shall tread them? for all places shall be desolate of men:
text_marked: The grapes shall ripen, and who shall tread them? for all places shall be desolate of men:

text: So that one man shall desire to see another, and to hear his voice.
text_marked: So that one man shall desire to see another, and to hear his voice.

text: For of a city there shall be ten left, and two of the field, which shall hide themselves in the thick groves, and in the clefts of the rocks.
text_marked: For of a city there shall be ten left, and two of the field, which shall hide themselves in the thick groves, and in the clefts of the rocks.

text: As in an orchard of Olives upon every tree there are left three or four olives;
text_marked: As in an orchard of Olives upon every tree there are left three or four olives;

text: Or as when a vineyard is gathered, there are left some clusters of them that diligently seek through the vineyard:
text_marked: Or as when a vineyard is gathered, there are left some clusters of them that diligently seek through the vineyard:

text: Even so in those days there shall be three or four left by them that search their houses with the sword.
text_marked: Even so in those days there shall be three or four left by them that search their houses with the sword.

text: And the earth shall be laid waste, and the fields thereof shall wax old, and her ways and all her paths shall grow full of thorns, because no man shall travel therethrough.
text_marked: And the earth shall be laid waste, and the fields thereof shall wax old, and her ways and all her paths shall grow full of thorns, because no man shall travel therethrough.

text: The virgins shall mourn, having no bridegrooms; the women shall mourn, having no husbands; their daughters shall mourn, having no helpers.
text_marked: The virgins shall mourn, having no bridegrooms; the women shall mourn, having no husbands; their daughters shall mourn, having no helpers.

text: In the wars shall their bridegrooms be destroyed, and their husbands shall perish of famine.
text_marked: In the wars shall their bridegrooms be destroyed, and their husbands shall perish of famine.

text: Hear now these things and understand them, ye servants of the Lord.
text_marked: Hear now these things and understand them, ye servants of the Lord.

text: Behold, the word of the Lord, receive it: believe not the gods of whom the Lord spake.
text_marked: Behold, the word of the Lord, receive it: believe not the gods of whom the Lord spake.

text: Behold, the plagues draw nigh, and are not slack.
text_marked: Behold, the plagues draw nigh, and are not slack.

text: As when a woman with child in the ninth month bringeth forth her son, with two or three hours of her birth great pains compass her womb, which pains, when the child cometh forth, they slack not a moment:
text_marked: As when a woman with child in the ninth month bringeth forth her son, with two or three hours of her birth great pains compass her womb, which pains, when the child cometh forth, they slack not a moment:

text: Even so shall not the plagues be slack to come upon the earth, and the world shall mourn, and sorrows shall come upon it on every side.
text_marked: Even so shall not the plagues be slack to come upon the earth, and the world shall mourn, and sorrows shall come upon it on every side.

text: O my people, hear my word: make you ready to thy battle, and in those evils be even as pilgrims upon the earth.
text_marked: O my people, hear my word: make you ready to thy battle, and in those evils be even as pilgrims upon the earth.

text: He that selleth, let him be as he that fleeth away: and he that buyeth, as one that will lose:
text_marked: He that selleth, let him be as he that fleeth away: and he that buyeth, as one that will lose:
